examples:
import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** 每个 host 独立拥有上下文、插件与交付队列。 */
const log = createLogHost({
  context: ['orders'],
  topic: 'api',
  maxPending: 10000,
  plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()]
})
log.info('created', { orderId: 'o1' })
log.log('audit', 'arbitrary tags remain valid')
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** host 拥有插件安装、日志交付与最终释放。 */
const log = createLogHost({ plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()] })
log.info('request completed', { requestId: 'r1' })
await log.flush()
await log.shutdown('manual')

import { createLogHost, levelPlugin } from '@migaia/log-host'
import { thresholdFeature, uuidFeature } from '@migaia/log-host/features'
import { consolePlugin } from '@migaia/log-plugin-console'

/** host 级策略作为每个输出端的默认值；entry 策略只执行一次。 */
const log = createLogHost({
  features: [thresholdFeature({ level: 'info' }), uuidFeature({ display: false })],
  plugins: [levelPlugin(), consolePlugin()]
})
log.debug('filtered by this output')
log.info('accepted')
await log.shutdown('manual')

members.description: Plugin release attempted all owned cleanup but at least one cleanup failed.

members.name: pluginShutdownCleanupFailed
members.description: Terminal cleanup failed; callers inspect the structured disposal result and original cause.

members.name: hookFailed
members.description: A failure listener failed while observing another failure; the terminal reporter receives it.

members.name: batchOverflow
members.description: Batch capacity dropped the oldest queued batch, or incoming data if all batches were active.

members.name: deliveryFailed
members.description: A bounded output attempt failed; cause retains the original timeout or delivery failure.

members.name: invalidRetryCount
members.description: Retry attempts must be a positive safe integer before any output is installed.

members.name: queueOverflow
members.description: Entry admission dropped the oldest unprocessed entry to maintain the pending bound.

members.name: forwardSelf
members.description: A host cannot register itself as a forwarding target.

members.name: forwardCycle
members.description: A new forwarding edge would reach its own source through existing target edges.

options: Optional level, default debug; change it later through the returned descriptor.setLevel().

import { thresholdFeature, uuidFeature } from '@migaia/log-host/features'

})

blocks.text: `projectLogEntry(entry)` 是共享结构化投影。它只把 error 替换为 utils `serializeErrorChain(entry.error.raw)`；保留 source、code、name、message、stack、cause 与 aggregate 分支，排除 raw 的自有私有字段。JSON 格式与 HTTP envelope 共用该投影，原始 entry.error.raw 不变。
日志方法与 flush/shutdown 的运行期错误不会进入业务控制流；创建配置错误与 use/unUse 的配置拒绝仍可离开调用边界。没有失败监听器时直接调用 reporter；监听器失败产生 `HOOK_FAILED`，原异常在 cause。reporter 自身抛错、then getter 失败或拒绝均被收住，终端失败不再递归上报。
`flush()` 的 3000 毫秒默认预算不证明所有日志已经送达。到期报告 `LIFECYCLE_DEADLINE` 并兑现；未完成工作的晚到拒绝仍被观察。shutdown 共享同一个 Promise，保留第一个 reason，先运行允许写最后日志的处理器，再关闭准入并释放插件。释放结果中的 `cleanupErrors` 必须由业务按需要检查。

symbols.name: ILogStore
symbols.purpose: Durable logger contract with explicit ownership and initialization.
symbols.core:
append: Capture portable JSON immediately, then atomically commit the entire batch as pending records. Empty batches allocate no sequences.
append.records: Ordered kind/payload inputs. Kinds are nonempty strings; payloads must be finite portable JSON without accessors, cycles or unsupported values.
Committed sequence numbers in input order; no partial batch becomes visible.
read: Read ascending retained snapshots without changing record state or consuming them.
read.fromSeq: Inclusive positive safe sequence, normally returned by append; a truncated prefix starts at the retained floor.
read.limit: Maximum returned records, a nonnegative safe integer; zero returns an empty array.
Detached record and JSON payload snapshots in ascending sequence order.
lastSeq: Read the permanent committed high watermark, preserved after complete prefix truncation.
Zero for a new resource, otherwise the highest committed sequence; it is never reused.
onAppend: Observe one frozen notice after each nonempty real commit; listener failures only report.
onAppend.listener: Receives frozen lastSeq/count metadata and returns void. It runs only after commit; thrown or asynchronous failures are reported.
An idempotent cancellation function that removes this listener only.
truncate: Delete only the prefix below the requested sequence while keeping sequence/time watermarks.
truncate.beforeSeq: Exclusive retained boundary, a positive safe integer at most lastSeq + 1; earlier floors are harmless no-ops.
Resolves after truncation commits; future appends keep increasing the original sequence.
setState: Advance an existing pending record to a terminal state; missing or terminal rows reject WAL_RECORD_INVALID.
setState.seq: Sequence issued by append for an existing pending record in this resource.
setState.state: LogRecordState.done or aborted ends the intent; pending leaves a still-pending row unchanged.
Resolves after the state change commits; terminal records cannot reopen.
states: Return only active pending sequence numbers in creation order, excluding terminal history.
states.filter: Only LogRecordState.pending is supported; any other filter rejects INVALID_OPTION.
An ascending snapshot of the active pending sequences.
dispose: Close admission immediately and drain accepted work before releasing the resource.
One cached explicit cleanup Promise; cleanup failure rejects and remains observable.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Share the same cleanup through a separate cached symbolic completion Promise.
Resolves after cleanup, reporting cleanup failure rather than rejecting this symbolic Promise.

path: Caller-selected SQLite filename; original resource locking rejects a competing live owner.

symbols.purpose: Creates the single hub of the page. Only the shell calls it; child apps call `getMicroHub()`. Every plugin's dependencies are checked first, and the plugins are installed only when all of them are met, so a missing dependency leaves no hub behind.

report: Receives errors that must not interrupt the current operation: exceptions from listeners and subscription callbacks, and cleanup failures. If it throws, both errors go to the default reporter.
`globalThis.reportError`, or `console.error` when that is missing.

blocks.text: 所有错误带 `source: '@migaia/micro-hub'` 和 `code`（`MicroHubErrorCode`）：`HUB_ALREADY_CREATED`、`HUB_NOT_CREATED`、`APP_ALREADY_CONNECTED`、`APP_DISCONNECTED`、`PLUGIN_MISSING`、`CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH`、`CONTRACT_OWNED`、`WRITE_DENIED`、`EMIT_DENIED`、`COMMAND_ASYNC`、`HANDLER_DUPLICATED`、`OWNER_ABSENT`、`OWNER_TIMEOUT`、`OWNER_GONE`、`INVALID_OPTION`。每个码的触发条件与处理方式见 USEGUIDE。
需要按错误分支时，比较 `error.source === MICRO_HUB_SOURCE` 和 `error.code`，不要匹配消息文字。`MicroHubErrorText` 导出全部消息文字，测试或日志需要核对原文时引用它。
listener 和订阅回调抛出的错误不会打断其它 listener，也不会抛给 emit 方，而是交给 `createMicroHub({ report })`（默认 `globalThis.reportError`）。

symbols.name: IContractView
symbols.purpose: What any connected app gets from `app.use(contract)`: readables for state and computed values, command functions, event listeners, request callers, resources and `select`.
symbols.core:
contract: The contract this view was created from, as passed to `use()` or `own()`.
state: One `IReadable` per plain state field and one `IKeyedReadable` per `keyed()` field. Each field is subscribed independently, so writing one field does not notify subscribers of another.
computed: One `IReadable` per computed value of the contract. A computed value is recalculated only when a field it actually read changes.
commands: One function per contract command, called without the leading state argument. Each call commits its patch synchronously and returns `{ revision }`. Throws `WRITE_DENIED` when the app is neither the owner nor listed in `writers`, `COMMAND_ASYNC` when the command returns a thenable, and `INVALID_OPTION` for a patch field the contract does not declare; in every failure nothing is written.
events: One `{ on(listener) }` per contract event. Listeners receive the payload; the returned function unsubscribes, and the subscription ends when the app disconnects.
requests: One `(input, options?) => Promise` per contract request, answered by the owner's handler. Rejects with `OWNER_ABSENT` when no handler is registered and `waitForOwner` is not set, `OWNER_TIMEOUT` when waiting times out, and `OWNER_GONE` when the owner leaves during the call.
resources: One `IMicroResourceView` per contract resource, filled by the `resources()` plugin.
revision: Readable count of committed commands of this contract; increases by one per commit.
select: Creates a readable derived from state. Subscribers are notified only when `equals` reports a changed result. While nobody subscribes, `get()` caches the result per revision and keeps the old reference when the new result is equal. The derived node is released when its last subscriber leaves.
select.selector: Pure function of the state values. Only the fields it reads become dependencies; reading a field and returning the whole state object still notifies when that field changes.
select.equals: Compares the previous and the next result; defaults to `Object.is`. Return `true` to suppress the notification.
An `IReadable` of the selected value. Throws `PLUGIN_MISSING` when the `state()` plugin is not installed.
symbols.advanced: A consumer app renders shared state, writes through commands it is allowed to call, and reacts to the owner's events.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

symbols.name: IOwnedContract
symbols.purpose: What the owner gets from `app.own(contract)`: the view plus emitting events, answering requests, providing resources, persistence status and `release()`.
symbols.core:
contract: The contract this view was created from, as passed to `use()` or `own()`.
state: One `IReadable` per plain state field and one `IKeyedReadable` per `keyed()` field. Each field is subscribed independently, so writing one field does not notify subscribers of another.
computed: One `IReadable` per computed value of the contract. A computed value is recalculated only when a field it actually read changes.
commands: One function per contract command, called without the leading state argument. Each call commits its patch synchronously and returns `{ revision }`. Throws `WRITE_DENIED` when the app is neither the owner nor listed in `writers`, `COMMAND_ASYNC` when the command returns a thenable, and `INVALID_OPTION` for a patch field the contract does not declare; in every failure nothing is written.
events: One `{ on(listener), emit(payload) }` per contract event. `emit` delivers synchronously in registration order; an emit made inside a listener is queued until the current delivery ends.
requests: One `(input, options?) => Promise` per contract request, answered by the owner's handler. Rejects with `OWNER_ABSENT` when no handler is registered and `waitForOwner` is not set, `OWNER_TIMEOUT` when waiting times out, and `OWNER_GONE` when the owner leaves during the call.
resources: One `IMicroResourceView` per contract resource, filled by the `resources()` plugin.
revision: Readable count of committed commands of this contract; increases by one per commit.
select: Creates a readable derived from state. Subscribers are notified only when `equals` reports a changed result. While nobody subscribes, `get()` caches the result per revision and keeps the old reference when the new result is equal. The derived node is released when its last subscriber leaves.
select.selector: Pure function of the state values. Only the fields it reads become dependencies; reading a field and returning the whole state object still notifies when that field changes.
select.equals: Compares the previous and the next result; defaults to `Object.is`. Return `true` to suppress the notification.
An `IReadable` of the selected value. Throws `PLUGIN_MISSING` when the `state()` plugin is not installed.
handle: Registers the single handler of a request. Callers waiting with `waitForOwner` are released as soon as it is registered.
handle.name: Request name declared in the contract's `requests` section.
handle.handler: Receives the caller's input and returns the output or a Promise of it; a thrown error rejects the caller's call unchanged.
A function that unregisters the handler. Throws `HANDLER_DUPLICATED` when the request already has a handler, and `EMIT_DENIED` after `release()`.
provide: Registers the fetcher of a shared resource; needs the `resources()` plugin.
provide.name: Resource name declared in the contract's `resources` section.
provide.fetcher: Fetches the value; its `signal` aborts when the request is replaced or the owner releases it.
A function that unregisters the fetcher. Throws `HANDLER_DUPLICATED` when one is already registered.
persistence: The store-persist `IPersistHandle` when `own(contract, { persist })` requested persistence; its `ready` resolves after the first successful read-back. Otherwise `undefined`.
release: Gives up ownership: owner-only members stop working, persistence stops, callers of in-flight requests get `OWNER_GONE`, and another app may own the contract. The state is kept.
Nothing; ownership has ended when the call returns. Calling it again does nothing.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: What the owner gets from `app.own(contract)`: the view plus emitting events, answering requests, providing resources, persistence status and `release()`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IOwnedContract from @migaia/micro-hub, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IOwnedContract when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IOwnedContract does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
contract: The contract this view was created from, as passed to `use()` or `own()`.
state: One `IReadable` per plain state field and one `IKeyedReadable` per `keyed()` field. Each field is subscribed independently, so writing one field does not notify subscribers of another.
computed: One `IReadable` per computed value of the contract. A computed value is recalculated only when a field it actually read changes.
commands: One function per contract command, called without the leading state argument. Each call commits its patch synchronously and returns `{ revision }`. Throws `WRITE_DENIED` when the app is neither the owner nor listed in `writers`, `COMMAND_ASYNC` when the command returns a thenable, and `INVALID_OPTION` for a patch field the contract does not declare; in every failure nothing is written.
events: One `{ on(listener), emit(payload) }` per contract event. `emit` delivers synchronously in registration order; an emit made inside a listener is queued until the current delivery ends.
requests: One `(input, options?) => Promise` per contract request, answered by the owner's handler. Rejects with `OWNER_ABSENT` when no handler is registered and `waitForOwner` is not set, `OWNER_TIMEOUT` when waiting times out, and `OWNER_GONE` when the owner leaves during the call.
resources: One `IMicroResourceView` per contract resource, filled by the `resources()` plugin.
revision: Readable count of committed commands of this contract; increases by one per commit.
select: Creates a readable derived from state. Subscribers are notified only when `equals` reports a changed result. While nobody subscribes, `get()` caches the result per revision and keeps the old reference when the new result is equal. The derived node is released when its last subscriber leaves.
select.selector: Pure function of the state values. Only the fields it reads become dependencies; reading a field and returning the whole state object still notifies when that field changes.
select.equals: Compares the previous and the next result; defaults to `Object.is`. Return `true` to suppress the notification.
An `IReadable` of the selected value. Throws `PLUGIN_MISSING` when the `state()` plugin is not installed.
handle: Registers the single handler of a request. Callers waiting with `waitForOwner` are released as soon as it is registered.
handle.name: Request name declared in the contract's `requests` section.
handle.handler: Receives the caller's input and returns the output or a Promise of it; a thrown error rejects the caller's call unchanged.
A function that unregisters the handler. Throws `HANDLER_DUPLICATED` when the request already has a handler, and `EMIT_DENIED` after `release()`.
provide: Registers the fetcher of a shared resource; needs the `resources()` plugin.
provide.name: Resource name declared in the contract's `resources` section.
provide.fetcher: Fetches the value; its `signal` aborts when the request is replaced or the owner releases it.
A function that unregisters the fetcher. Throws `HANDLER_DUPLICATED` when one is already registered.
persistence: The store-persist `IPersistHandle` when `own(contract, { persist })` requested persistence; its `ready` resolves after the first successful read-back. Otherwise `undefined`.
release: Gives up ownership: owner-only members stop working, persistence stops, callers of in-flight requests get `OWNER_GONE`, and another app may own the contract. The state is kept.
Nothing; ownership has ended when the call returns. Calling it again does nothing.

symbols.name: IReadable
symbols.purpose: Framework-neutral read contract of every value the hub exposes: `get()` plus `subscribe()`. It plugs directly into `useSyncExternalStore` and into small adapters for Vue, Svelte or Solid.
symbols.core:
get: Returns the current committed value. The same reference is returned until the next commit changes it, so `===` is a valid change check.
The committed value. Throws `APP_DISCONNECTED` after the app has disconnected.
subscribe: Calls `listener` after every later commit that changes this value. The listener gets no argument; inside it `get()` already returns the new value. Registration is tied to the app: it is released when the app disconnects.
subscribe.listener: Function called with no argument after each change; errors it throws go to the hub `report` and do not stop other listeners.
A function that unsubscribes; calling it again does nothing.

listener 和订阅回调抛出的错误不会打断其它 listener，也不会抛给 emit 方，而是交给 `createMicroHub({ report })`（默认 `globalThis.reportError`）。

symbols.purpose: Every error code this package throws. Errors keep their native type (`Error` or `TypeError`) and carry `source` and `code`; branch on `code`, not on the message.
symbols.core:
hubAlreadyCreated: `HUB_ALREADY_CREATED`: `createMicroHub` was called while a hub exists. Child apps use `getMicroHub()`.
hubNotCreated: `HUB_NOT_CREATED`: no hub exists, or it has been disposed. Create it in the shell first.
appAlreadyConnected: `APP_ALREADY_CONNECTED`: an app with the same name is still connected. Disconnect the old instance first.
appDisconnected: `APP_DISCONNECTED`: a handle or view was used after disconnecting. Connect again.
pluginMissing: `PLUGIN_MISSING`: a contract or a plugin needs a capability that is not installed. Add the plugin to `plugins`.
contractVersionMismatch: `CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH`: a contract name was used with another major version. Align the deployed versions.
contractOwned: `CONTRACT_OWNED`: the contract already has an owner. Wait for it to disconnect or call `release()`.
writeDenied: `WRITE_DENIED`: the caller is neither the owner nor in `writers`. Add it to `writers`, or use a request.
emitDenied: `EMIT_DENIED`: an owner-only member (emit, handle, provide) was called after `release()`. Claim ownership again.
commandAsync: `COMMAND_ASYNC`: a command returned a thenable; nothing was written. Finish asynchronous work before calling the command.
handlerDuplicated: `HANDLER_DUPLICATED`: `handle` or `provide` was registered twice for one name. Remove the duplicate.
ownerAbsent: `OWNER_ABSENT`: no handler or fetcher is registered. Pass `waitForOwner`, or retry later.
ownerTimeout: `OWNER_TIMEOUT`: waiting for a handler timed out. Report the failure, or retry later.
ownerGone: `OWNER_GONE`: the owner left while a request was in progress; side effects may have happened. Reconcile before retrying.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION` (`TypeError`): a name, version, contract member or patch field is invalid. Fix the call.

members.name: hubAlreadyCreated
members.description: `createMicroHub()` is called while a hub already exists in this realm. * * The package is a singleton: only the shell configures it. Child apps call `getMicroHub()`; call * `hub.dispose()` first when a fresh hub is really intended.

members.name: hubNotCreated
members.description: `getMicroHub()` is called before the shell created the hub. * * Load order is wrong: create the hub in the shell before any remote mounts, or create it in a * child's standalone development entry.

members.name: appAlreadyConnected
members.description: `connect(name)` is called while an app with the same name is still connected. * * Prevents double subscriptions after a remount. Disconnect the previous instance first.

members.name: appDisconnected
members.description: A member of an app handle, or of a view obtained from it, is used after `disconnect()` began. * * Connect again to obtain a live handle; disconnected handles are never revived.

members.name: pluginMissing
members.description: A contract needs a capability (`events`, `state`, `persist`, `resource`) the hub was created * without, or a capability plugin requires another one that is missing. * * Add the plugin to `createMicroHub({ plugins })`.

members.name: contractVersionMismatch
members.description: A contract is used with a major version different from the one already registered under the * same name. * * Two independently deployed apps disagree on the contract shape; deploy matching versions.

members.name: contractOwned
members.description: `own(contract)` is called while another connected app (or the same app) already owns it. * * Each contract has at most one owner. Wait for the current owner to disconnect.

members.name: writeDenied
members.description: A command is called by an app that is neither the owner nor listed in the contract `writers`. * * Add the app to `writers`, or route the change through the owner with a request.

members.name: emitDenied
members.description: An event is emitted by an app that does not own the contract. * * Events belong to the owner; other apps use commands or requests to reach it.

members.name: commandAsync
members.description: A command returned a thenable. Thrown as `TypeError`; no state was written. * * Commands must be synchronous pure functions so a commit is atomic. Do async work first, then * call the command with the result.

members.name: handlerDuplicated
members.description: `handle()` or `provide()` is called twice for the same request or resource of one contract. * * Each request or resource has exactly one provider; remove the duplicate registration.

members.name: ownerAbsent
members.description: A request is made while the contract has no owner (or no handler for it) and no `waitForOwner` * was given. * * Pass `waitForOwner` when the owner may mount later, or retry after it connects.

members.name: ownerTimeout
members.description: `waitForOwner` elapsed before the owner registered a handler for the request. * * The owner did not mount in time; surface the failure or retry later.

members.name: ownerGone
members.description: The owner disconnected while a request to it was in flight. * * The handler may or may not have completed its side effects; reconcile before retrying.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: An argument or option has an invalid shape: empty or dotted names, a non-positive version, * unknown fields in a command patch, a non-function command. Thrown as `TypeError`. * * Fix the call site; nothing was registered.

error: `error`: the last request failed; `error` holds why.
cancelled: `cancelled`: the request was replaced by a newer one or the owner released it.

symbols.name: createPipeline
symbols.purpose: Creates a reusable, stateless middleware runner for one execution mode. The runner owns no stage list: each `run()` receives the stages, the input value and a final callback, so one pipeline can serve many hosts and concurrent runs. A sync/async stage continues by calling `next(value)`. Generator stages must return a payload, the configured continue signal (using the last yield), or the explicit undefined signal; yielding alone followed by an implicit undefined return halts without calling done.
symbols.core:
An `IMiddlewarePipeline` for the chosen mode and TSignals control domain, separate from TValue. Options are read once and frozen; invalid values or throwing option getters produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with the original getter failure on cause.
mode: Execution mode of every run. Stages must be written for this mode or converted with `lift()`.
Choose sync for ordinary transforms, async for stages that await downstream work, generator for synchronous generator stages, or async-generator for asynchronous generators. Generator modes reduce returned values instead of calling next(). mode is required; there is no default.
onViolation: Receives `duplicate` or `late` when a stage misuses `next()`. The misuse never starts a second downstream run.
Not set: misuse is ignored silently.
Set it when diagnosing a stage that calls next() twice or after returning. duplicate means a repeated call; late means the stage already ended. Both calls are ignored, and without this callback neither is reported.
assertActive: Called on entry and after each stage; throwing stops the run before the next stage starts. Hosts use it to stop runs once they are closing.
Not set: no lifecycle check.
Use it when the host has a closing flag rather than an AbortSignal. Throw to prevent the next stage from starting. Return normally while the host is active; omitting it skips host lifetime checks.
signal: Default cancellation signal for every run; checked on entry, before and after each stage and before `done`. A run-level `signal` overrides it.
Not set: runs cannot be cancelled unless `run()` passes a signal.
signals: Replacement generator control signals `{ undefined, halt, continue }` for hosts with their own sentinels; three distinct symbols, read once at creation.
`MiddlewarePipelineGeneratorSignals` (the exported `GENERATOR_*` symbols).
combineStageAndDownstreamError: Only in async onion mode, combines independent stage and downstream failures. The same object propagated through await next is thrown once without calling the combiner; equal primitive values can still be independent failures. A successful custom result must retain both errors through cause/errors. If the combiner throws, its failure stays primary with both originals reachable.
Not set: an `AggregateError` with code `EXECUTION_FAILED` holds both errors.
Use it in async mode when a stage fails independently of downstream work and your application needs a specific combined message. Keep both original failures in cause or errors. Without it, the runner creates its own AggregateError; other modes do not use it.
symbols.advanced:
A logger runs filter, enrich and format stages before writing one entry.
A request client wraps each request in async onion middleware for auth, retry and timing.
A plugin host collects stages from installed plugins and runs them through one pipeline.
Every handler gets the same value and nobody transforms it: use `@migaia/event-subscriber`.

declaredConfiguration.name: mode
declaredConfiguration.description: Required execution mode: sync, async, generator, or async-generator. Determines stage shape, downstream timing, and whether run throws synchronously or returns a promise.

declaredConfiguration.name: next
declaredConfiguration.description: Number of values one active stage may submit; omitted preserves single semantics.

declaredConfiguration.name: onViolation
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional duplicate/late next reporter; defaults to a no-op. A rejected next never starts downstream again.

declaredConfiguration.name: assertActive
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional host lifetime assertion at entry and after successful stages. Async onion frames also check while returning, even after done ran; a later failure does not undo completed side effects.

declaredConfiguration.name: signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional default cooperative signal. A supplied run-level signal overrides it; none is created by default.

declaredConfiguration.name: signals
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional generator control symbols; defaults to MiddlewarePipelineGeneratorSignals. undefined/halt/continue must be distinct symbols, read once and snapshotted at construction.

declaredConfiguration.name: combineStageAndDownstreamError
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional async-onion dual-failure policy, called with stage failure first and downstream second. Without it, independent failures become EXECUTION_FAILED with both on AggregateError.errors. A returned custom error must retain both originals through cause/errors; a thrown combiner failure keeps the preexisting failures reachable. The same propagated object is not combined twice.

guidance.id: 创建选项及全部默认值
guidance.heading: 创建选项及全部默认值

blocks.text: `createPipeline<TValue>(options)` 必须明确选择模式。返回类型为该模式的 `IMiddlewarePipeline<TMode, TValue, TSignals>`；模式决定 stage、done、run 返回值和允许的提升方向。选项类型是 `ICreatePipelineOptions<TMode>`。

rows: `'single'` 或 `'multiple'`，对应 `MiddlewarePipelineNext`。整条 pipeline 与 lift 共用；multiple 在四种模式下都允许独立的多次遍历。
同步接收 `'duplicate'` 或 `'late'`；分别对应 `MiddlewarePipelineViolation.duplicate`、`late`。用于记录非法 next 调用，不重新执行下游。
宿主提供的同步生命周期断言。入口和每个 stage 后执行；异步模式进入下游时也会检查。抛错会阻止继续执行，包不替宿主改变状态。
默认取消信号，供未提供调用级信号的 run 使用。信号的结构和状态在 run 入口校验，不在创建时提前读取。
生成器的三个控制 symbol；字段为 `undefined`、`halt`、`continue`，必须互不相同。默认集已冻结。
把 undefined 当作显式业务值继续，而不是结束。
single 终止整条链；multiple 不增加终值遍历，也不撤销先前的 yield。
single 采用最后一次 yield 或输入；multiple 不增加终值遍历。
只用于异步洋葱执行中两个独立失败：第一个参数来自当前 stage，第二个来自它已启动的下游。返回值作为组合失败抛出；调用方要让两个原错通过 cause 或 AggregateError.errors 可达。

blocks.text: 构造选项必须是对象，不能为 null 或数组。支持的字段及自定义信号的三个属性只读取一次，再冻结内部快照；修改调用方对象不会改变已创建的 pipeline。`mode` 属性发布的就是这一份已验证值。非法模式、next 取值、回调、控制对象、信号结构、信号集或提升方向以原生 `TypeError` 和 `INVALID_OPTION` 报告。选项 getter 抛错时，原始失败保留在 `cause`。

symbols.purpose: Options of createPipeline(); mode is required. Every public option and control getter is read once for its snapshot; getter failure becomes TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with cause. The validated mode is the value published by the runner.
symbols.core:
mode: Execution mode of every run. Stages must be written for this mode or converted with `lift()`.
Choose sync for ordinary transforms, async for stages that await downstream work, generator for synchronous generator stages, or async-generator for asynchronous generators. Generator modes reduce returned values instead of calling next(). mode is required; there is no default.
onViolation: Receives `duplicate` or `late` when a stage misuses `next()`. The misuse never starts a second downstream run.
Not set: misuse is ignored silently.
Set it when diagnosing a stage that calls next() twice or after returning. duplicate means a repeated call; late means the stage already ended. Both calls are ignored, and without this callback neither is reported.
assertActive: Called on entry and after each stage; throwing stops the run before the next stage starts. Hosts use it to stop runs once they are closing.
Not set: no lifecycle check.
Use it when the host has a closing flag rather than an AbortSignal. Throw to prevent the next stage from starting. Return normally while the host is active; omitting it skips host lifetime checks.
signal: Default cancellation signal for every run; checked on entry, before and after each stage and before `done`. A run-level `signal` overrides it.
Not set: runs cannot be cancelled unless `run()` passes a signal.
signals: Replacement generator control signals `{ undefined, halt, continue }` for hosts with their own sentinels; three distinct symbols, read once at creation.
`MiddlewarePipelineGeneratorSignals` (the exported `GENERATOR_*` symbols).
combineStageAndDownstreamError: Only in async onion mode, combines independent stage and downstream failures. The same object propagated through await next is thrown once without calling the combiner; equal primitive values can still be independent failures. A successful custom result must retain both errors through cause/errors. If the combiner throws, its failure stays primary with both originals reachable.
Not set: an `AggregateError` with code `EXECUTION_FAILED` holds both errors.
Use it in async mode when a stage fails independently of downstream work and your application needs a specific combined message. Keep both original failures in cause or errors. Without it, the runner creates its own AggregateError; other modes do not use it.

symbols.name: IMiddlewarePipeline
symbols.purpose: The stateless runner returned by `createPipeline()`. It keeps only the mode and options; stages and values are supplied per run, so runs are isolated from each other.
symbols.core:
mode: The execution mode chosen at creation (`sync`, `async`, `generator`, `async-generator`); it never changes.
lift: Converts a stage written for another mode into this pipeline mode, in lossless directions only: sync into any mode, generator into async-generator. A lifted sync stage keeps its behaviour: code after `next()` still runs before downstream.
lift.stage: The stage to convert.
lift.from: Mode the stage was written for (`MiddlewarePipelineMode.*`).
A stage of this pipeline mode; same-mode lift preserves the stage. Sync-to-generator adapters use the configured runner halt/continue symbols, so no control symbol reaches done as payload and halt never calls done. Unsupported directions throw INVALID_OPTION.
Reuse simple sync stages (trim, validate, tag) in async or generator pipelines.
run: Runs `stages` in order on `value`. Sync and async stages call `next(value)` to continue; omitting it stops the run. Generator modes continue or stop according to the final return value or control symbol; yielding alone does not advance downstream. After the last stage, `done(value)` receives the final value. In `sync` mode `next()` only hands the value over and downstream starts after the stage returns; in `async` mode `next()` starts downstream immediately and returns its Promise (onion model).
run.stages: Stages of this mode (lift others first); read only for this run.
run.value: Input value of the first stage.
run.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops or a generator returns `GENERATOR_HALT`.
run.control: Optional `{ signal }` for this run. `control.signal` defaults to the construction-time signal when omitted; with neither, no signal or context is supplied. A supplied run signal overrides the construction signal and is visible as `context.signal`.
`void` in sync/generator and Promise<void> in async/async-generator. Error cancellation reasons retain native identity when writable; unclassified reasons receive ABORTED, foreign identities stay unchanged, and primitive or undefined reasons use ordinary Error with cause. Every async outer stage checks activity after returning, even after done; rejection does not undo done.

A logger runs filter, enrich and format stages before writing one entry.
A request client wraps each request in async onion middleware for auth, retry and timing.
A plugin host collects stages from installed plugins and runs them through one pipeline.

guidance.id: 失败-原始错误与错误码
guidance.heading: 失败、原始错误与错误码

blocks.text: `MIDDLEWARE_PIPELINE_SOURCE` 的值是 `'middleware.pipeline'`。`MiddlewarePipelineErrorCode` 是唯一的公开错误码表：

rows: stage、done、宿主断言、违约回调或组合器的未分类失败；两个独立异步失败默认合为 AggregateError。
多个 sync 或提升的 sync 遍历失败，或多个 async 遍历失败且没有被观察；AggregateError.errors 按登记或启动顺序保留原错误。
非法选项、模式、回调、signal/control、信号集或 lift 方向；类型为 TypeError，存在原始读取或验证失败时由 cause 保留。
合作式取消；可附码且尚未分类的 Error reason 加此码，其余原因保留在 cause。
取消主错与生成器清理同时失败，按主错在前的顺序聚合。

blocks.text: stage、done、`assertActive` 的原生 Error 尽量保留对象、类型和 stack；没有完整语义 source/code 时附 `EXECUTION_FAILED`，已有完整外部身份则不改写。不可修改错误或非 Error 值保留在包装错误的 cause 中。取消的 Error reason 同样尽量保留；字符串、undefined 等其他 reason 放在普通 Error 的 cause 中，不保证是原生 AbortError。reason 的 getter 抛出时，抛出值按 reason 处理。
异步 stage 和 runner 仍负责的下游分别失败时（multiple 仅保留未观察的分支拒绝），默认 `EXECUTION_FAILED` 的 AggregateError.errors 按 stage、downstream 顺序保留两者。若只是 await next 传播同一个对象失败，不再造两个相同错误项；相等的 primitive 仍可能是独立失败，不按值合并。
自定义组合器返回的结果用于失败传播；调用方必须自行保证两个原始错误仍可通过 cause 或 errors 找到。组合器自己抛错时，其原始失败尽量作为主错误，两个已经发生的失败仍会附到 errors/cause 链，不能把它们丢掉。

symbols.name: MiddlewarePipelineErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Every error code of this package. Errors keep their native type (`TypeError`, `AggregateError`, `AbortError`) and carry `source` and `code`.
symbols.core:
executionFailed: EXECUTION_FAILED classifies unowned stage, done, host-active and violation callback failures. Writable native errors retain identity; foreign identities stay unchanged, immutable/primitive values remain on cause. Independent async onion failures form AggregateError without a combiner. A late next callback failure after run completion escapes on the caller stack; report there.
invalidOption: `INVALID_OPTION`: an invalid mode, callback, signal, control object, signal set or `lift` direction. Fix the input; retrying will fail again.
aborted: ABORTED classifies an unowned cancellation reason. Native Error reasons can retain their exact object and type; primitive/undefined reasons use ordinary Error with cause. Existing foreign source/code remain unchanged; AbortError is not guaranteed.
abortCleanupFailed: `ABORT_CLEANUP_FAILED`: cancelling the run and its cleanup both failed; inspect `errors` in order.

members.name: executionFailed
members.description: Reports failure in both the current stage and its started downstream when no error combiner is * supplied. Also identifies unclassified stage, terminal, host, violation callback, or combiner * failures while preserving native identity where possible and retaining original failures. * Inspect both independent failures in `AggregateError.errors`, or supply an error combiner that * retains them through cause/errors when a domain-specific error is required.

members.name: multipleDownstreamFailed
members.description: Several independent sync traversals or unobserved async traversals failed. Inspect submission * order; each entry is the original failure, independent of its settlement order.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Invalid mode, onViolation or other callback, signal/control shape, signals, or lift target. The * caller must correct the supplied option rather than retrying the same input.

members.name: aborted
members.description: A cooperative checkpoint observes cancellation. Unclassified Error reasons gain identity where * attachable; other reasons remain on cause. Started work is awaited, not forcibly interrupted.

members.name: abortCleanupFailed
members.description: Iterator cleanup failed during cancellation. errors contains abort first, then cleanup failure.

symbols.name: defineFeature
symbols.purpose:
Defines an opaque Feature, a synchronous factory whose output supplies a plugin capability. Construction records the factory and dependencies without invoking them; installation resolves the dependency graph and freezes each output object.

Examples create a host with host.execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs set to 5000 ms, the same as their defaults; false removes the corresponding active-mutation or pipeline-drain deadline. The graph orders capability startup, not reactive data changes.
symbols.core:
factory: Required synchronous (core, dependencies) => object. core contains only featureExpose, the registration-owned method facade; no onDispose, host mutation or pipeline capability is supplied. Output must be a non-thenable object; its methods may be asynchronous.
dependencies: Optional own-enumerable-data alias map, default {}. Each value is a local defineFeature result or provider.getFeature(name) reference. The factory receives outputs under those aliases; references are required by default, while getFeature(name, { optional: true }) can resolve to undefined.
descriptor: Alternate object form { install, dependencies? }; install is the same required synchronous factory and dependencies defaults to {}. These must be own data fields, not accessors.
A trusted frozen opaque IFeature identity for a plugin features record. Invalid definitions throw INVALID_OPTION; missing required providers reject installation directly with PREREQUISITE_MISSING before installers run.
A Feature is a capability one plugin provides to other plugins, not to application code. Declared in a provider `features` record, consumers reference it with `provider.getFeature(name)`; the host then installs providers first, injects the output as `core.features.<name>`, and refuses to remove or disable a provider that is still required.
symbols.advanced:
`host.use(consumer, provider)` installs in dependency order; a cycle throws `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`.
Removing or disabling a required provider is rejected (`DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED`) unless `policy` is `cascade` or `suspend`; installing a consumer without its provider throws `PREREQUISITE_MISSING`.
`host.replace(provider)` rebinds consumers with `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others.
A `batch` plugin shares its scheduler with `http` and `file` sinks.
A storage backend provides a reactive adapter Feature consumed by a live-query plugin.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates one frozen managed handle without subclassing. TPublicSurface, the optional fourth generic, adds domain-owned surface descriptors before freezing; accessors stay live and fluent pipeline registration returns the same handle with its domain members and issued identity. Canonical Host keys take precedence. Domain core and disposal callbacks remain options.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import defineHost from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use defineHost when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when defineHost does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

declaredConfiguration.name: host
declaredConfiguration.description: Forwarded to the host unchanged; identical in shape to the class constructor's options. Omission uses every Host default.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.identity
declaredConfiguration.type: Readonly<{ /** Defaults to DEFAULT; a supplied label must be a nonempty string and need not be unique. */ readonly name?: string; }>
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional human-readable Host identity label; uniqueness is supplied by the runtime id.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.identity.name
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to DEFAULT; a supplied label must be a nonempty string and need not be unique.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.execution
declaredConfiguration.type: { /** * Maximum time for one admitted install, update, or removal hook. Defaults to 5000 ms; `false` * waits without a deadline. Numeric values must be finite and nonnegative. */ readonly mutationTimeoutMs?: number | false; /** * Maximum time to drain active pipeline leases before logical removal continues. Defaults to * 5000 ms; `false` waits until zero. Numeric values must be finite and nonnegative. */ readonly pipelineDrainTimeoutMs?: number | false; }
declaredConfiguration.description: Operation and pipeline drain budgets; each defaults to 5000 ms, `false` waits unbounded.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.execution.mutationTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum time for one admitted install, update, or removal hook. Defaults to 5000 ms; `false` * waits without a deadline. Numeric values must be finite and nonnegative.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum time to drain active pipeline leases before logical removal continues. Defaults to * 5000 ms; `false` waits until zero. Numeric values must be finite and nonnegative.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.pipeline
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional runner configuration; omission selects mode sync.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.pipeline.mode
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to sync; accepts sync, async, generator or async-generator.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.pipelines
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional immutable named declarations; absence creates no additional execution resources.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.diagnostic
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to a no-op; contains cleanup, late rejection and queue-wait observations.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.onDiagnosticFailure
declaredConfiguration.description: Terminal sink for failures of `diagnostic` itself (it threw or rejected). Receives the exact failure object; when absent, or when it throws too, the failure goes to the runtime's `globalThis.reportError` if one exists. Never affects Host control flow.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Clock and scheduling source shared by the queue watchdog and disposal timeouts. Defaults to systemScheduler from the shared scheduler package.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.queueAdmissionTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Admission wait limit. `undefined` reports without rejecting; `false` disables timers, reports, and rejection; a number rejects and removes timed-out work.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Diagnostic wait threshold when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is omitted. `false` disables its timer. Defaults to 1000 milliseconds; an explicit admission timeout takes precedence.

declaredConfiguration.name: host.disposeStepTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum wait for one disposal step. `false` waits indefinitely without triggering forced release. Defaults to 5000 milliseconds and never forcibly interrupts running JavaScript.

declaredConfiguration.name: pipelines
declaredConfiguration.description: Named payload declarations inferred independently of the default pipeline value.

declaredConfiguration.name: surface
declaredConfiguration.type: (TPublicSurface & { readonly [K in keyof IHostHandle<Record<string, never>, never, readonly []>]?: never; }) | IHostSurfaceFactory<TDomainCore, TValue, TPublicSurface, TPipelines>
declaredConfiguration.description: Domain-owned public descriptors installed before the single canonical handle is frozen. Object-form canonical keys stay reserved. A factory borrows native use/unUse and may replace only those two methods; domain methods and fluent host entries still share one identity.

declaredConfiguration.name: domainCore
declaredConfiguration.description: Replaces the `protected createPluginDomainCore` override; absent means an empty object.

declaredConfiguration.name: translateDisposalError
declaredConfiguration.description: Retained option corresponding to the protected class hook. The default structured cleanup result path does not invoke it; it is not a callback for translating each cleanupErrors entry.

declaredConfiguration.name: dispose
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional disposal middleware, invoked once inside the shared disposal Promise. Call next() to include canonical runtime cleanup; its result is shared and cleanup is not repeated. Middleware may reject, unlike ordinary collected cleanup failures in the default disposal result.

guidance.id: 隔离配置与调用者后续修改
guidance.heading: 隔离配置与调用者后续修改

blocks.text: 插件定义捕获应用设置后，调用者在安装前修改了原设置对象；安装后的配置应反映定义时的快照，而不是后来的外部修改。
浅拷贝只分离最外层对象，嵌套设置仍为共享引用，修改内层限制会悄悄改变后续安装器读到的内容。
`definePlugin` 在创建定义时对接纳的配置数据做快照并递归冻结，传入普通数据记录或数组，宿主随后通过 `config.get(path)` 读取自己的配置。
`config` 可选、默认空配置，本例字段为 `settings.limit: 3`；定义时捕获嵌套对象。`host.config.get(path)` 的必填路径 `meter.settings.limit` 依次选择插件、设置记录和限制值，未知路径返回 undefined。
输出：

blocks.code:
3
true true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `3`、`true true`；把外部 `settings.limit` 改为 `99` 没有改变安装值，捕获配置的两层对象也均已冻结。
省略 `config` 时使用空配置，这不是 JSON 序列化：支持的函数叶值保留身份，不支持的原型、访问器、符号、类 `Promise` 对象（带可调用 `then` 的对象）与环会被拒绝，已提交配置应通过 `host.config.update()` 修改。

guidance.heading: 创建 Host 与全部选项

blocks.text: 类入口可重写 `createPluginDomainCore()`，每次安装创建一份领域 core。默认返回空对象。领域 core 必须是普通对象、可枚举 data property，不能覆盖 `config`、`onDispose`、`pipeline` 或四个 `use*Pipeline` core 保留成员；无效表面以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。
函数入口 `defineHost(options)` 返回冻结的 canonical handle。它提供与类入口相同的功能，并把类上的 protected `useSync`、`runPipeline` 暴露给持有 handle 的 owner。选项 `host` 可选，形状与类构造选项一致；其余字段如下：

rows: 可选；省略返回空对象。request 的 `pluginName`、从零开始的批内 `batchIndex`、`batch` 身份均由宿主提供
可选；省略保留原 PluginHostError；默认结构化结果路径不调用此钩子，也不逐项转换 cleanupErrors
可选；自定义释放中间件，回调自行调用 `next()` 纳入内核清理；重复内核释放仍复用原 Promise
可选；默认无领域公开成员，第四类型参数默认空表面
可选；真实 `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)` 组成的固定命名映射；defineHost 在顶层传入。

blocks.text: `surface` 支持对象或工厂。对象形式的自有描述符在获取 Runtime 之前读取一次，访问器保持动态，所有 canonical Host 键（包括 identity、use、unUse）仍为保留键。工厂形式 `surface: (native) => ({ ... })` 在创建最终 handle 时执行一次，收到冻结的原生 `use`、`unUse`，可组合并替换这两个方法；其他 canonical Host 键仍不能替换。领域方法、Host 身份、共享出口和 fluent 管线方法属于同一个冻结 handle，组合方应通过 surface 提供方法，不能复制返回的 handle。surface 读取或工厂失败保持原错，经 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 边界分类。旧对象写法和三类型参数调用仍有效。
类构造 `options` 可选，defineHost 的 `host` 同样可选；全部省略时使用下表默认值：

rows: 可读名称可选，宿主另分配唯一 id
本次变更 hook 的执行预算；`false` 无期限
pipeline 租约排空预算；`false` 等真实排空
接收诊断及被包含的原始失败对象
诊断器自身 throw/reject 的终端出口
默认只诊断；数值表示排队拒绝阈值；false 关闭相关计时与诊断
仅未配置排队拒绝阈值时生效；false 关闭诊断计时器
单个普通释放步骤的等待预算；false 无期限

blocks.text: 所有时间数值须有限、非负；非法选项、非函数回调或不满足 scheduler 协议的对象以 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。直接导入 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 的消费项目需直接安装 utils。

guidance.id: 命名管道-类型-权限与生命周期
guidance.heading: 命名管道：类型、权限与生命周期

blocks.text: 在函数入口的顶层 `pipelines`，或类构造选项的 `pipelines`，声明一个固定的“名字 → `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)`”映射。每条管道独立推断载荷和 mode；名字是非空的自有可枚举字符串键，值必须来自真实 `pipelineSpec`，不能用结构相同的普通对象替代。说明对象被冻结；Host 的声明在构造时固定；插件也可在 `definePlugin({ pipelines })` 声明自己的组，随安装创建、失败回滚、卸载按原预算排空后删除。插件不能覆盖 Host 的同名管道，冲突以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。

rows: `'sync'`、`'async'`、`'generator'`、`'async-generator'`；决定 stage 及 run 返回类型。
`'single'` 或 `'multiple'`；直接采用 middleware-pipeline 的四模式继续及失败规则。
`'install'` 按分配顺序，`'reverse'` 按其逆序；同一插件在所有管道共享原排序 slot。

blocks.text: 持有函数 handle 的 owner 调用 `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)` 或 `.run(value, done)`；类 owner 使用 protected `pipeline(name)`。安装中的插件和 Feature core 只有 `use(stage)`、`through(name)` 登记权，没有 run。两种命名登记都返回带幂等 `remove()` 的句柄；移除影响后续运行，已取得的快照仍由原生命周期排空。

插件和它的 Feature 用原名访问 Host 管道、用短名访问自己的管道，并通过既有 Feature 依赖用 `插件名.管道名` 访问提供方的组。无依赖关系的插件不能访问别人的组。`IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` 适合仅使用 Host 声明的 core；声明插件自己的管道时，保留 install 参数的推导，避免 Host-only 注解遮掉自己的短名。未知或不可见名字同步抛 `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN`；诊断包含查询的插件或 Feature、请求名和可见的 Host、本插件、依赖插件范围。

sync、generator 的命名 run 返回 `TResult | undefined`；async、async-generator 返回 `Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>`。短路返回 undefined，每次到达末端的遍历各调用一次 done。multiple 不返回结果数组；需要每次结果时，在 done 中明确收集。multiple 模式下，stage 可以处理经 next 的 then/await 观察到的分支失败；未观察的失败仍由 runner 拒绝，多个原错按启动顺序保留在 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED` 中。generator 用 throw 把失败交回 yield；sync 遍历全部登记值后汇总错误。

所有管道在同一 Host 事务中提交；每条管道在同一可见 stage 修订内复用编译快照，reverse 也只在编译时处理。没有可见 stage 时直接调用终点，不取快照或 lease。有 stage 时，所有管道复用同一套登记、排序和 quiescence/lease owner。安装失败回滚、unUse、replace、禁用和挂起在一次提交中作用于该插件的全部管道；已有运行持有原快照和分管道的代际 lease，drain 等待这些实际运行，清理和排空预算仍由既有生命周期配置控制。任何管道执行期间，owner 向任一管道注册 stage 都会抛 `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`。

Host 未声明 pipelines 时，其命名轴默认为 `Record<never, never>`；已知插件定义仍能推出其限定名。Host 和插件都没有命名组时，不分配额外的命名 runner、lane 或 lease key。原 `TValue`、`pipeline.mode`、四个 use*Pipeline、runPipeline/runPipelineSync/runPipelineAsync、pipelineMode 都只操作默认管道，原有显式泛型调用不变。默认管道使用内部 symbol，不占用任何字符串名字。显式填写 defineHost 泛型并同时声明命名管道时，要在第五个泛型参数传 `typeof pipelines`；省略它会保留空轴，pipeline(name) 只接受 never。

非法 map、名字、spec、order 以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 在构造时拒绝，不返回 handle；mode 非法仍是 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。next 非法的外层码为 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`，cause 保留 middleware-pipeline 的 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION`。spec 配置 getter 抛错时也以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 保留原 cause。

PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `plugin.host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。

symbols.purpose:
Defines a plugin without running installation hooks. Function form builds a fresh descriptor per registration; object form also declares configuration, setup and lifecycle hooks. Config is captured when defining, not when the caller later mutates it.

Examples pass host.execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs as 5000 ms, the same as their defaults; false explicitly removes either deadline. host.config.get(path) uses plugin-name dot paths and returns undefined for an absent path.
symbols.core:
name: Required function-form nonempty name, unique per host and without a dot.
descriptorFactory: Required synchronous function-form callback receiving the install core. Return an object with optional install(), expose() and featureExpose() hooks, all omitted by default. install may be awaitable through use(); expose and featureExpose must be synchronous. install/expose extension keys must be disjoint.
featureRecord: Optional function-form root Feature record; omitted means no roots. Dependencies are declared inside each defineFeature dependency map.
definition: Required object-form own-data definition; fields and hook inputs are documented below.
A plugin definition (`IDefinedPluginConstraint`) with `name`, the declared fields, and `getFeature(name)` for consumers. Invalid fields throw `INVALID_OPTION`; retired fields such as `shared` throw `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`.
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Optional configuration: definePlugin snapshots and recursively freezes it at definition time; installation creates a registration-owned copy. Plain records/arrays and supported primitive or function leaves are admitted, while invalid values and cycles reject. Read core.config.get() or host.config.get(path); commit changes with host.config.update().
Omitted; the public definition.config is undefined and the host uses an empty configuration record.
features: Record of named roots created by defineFeature. Their dependency maps can reference provider.getFeature(name). The host installs required providers first and injects resolved root outputs as core.features.<name>.
Omitted; no Feature roots.
install: Required object-form hook. Receives the domain core plus config, operation, lifecycle, onDispose and pipeline registration methods; declared Feature outputs are ready. Return an extension record, or an awaitable record through asynchronous use(). Own enumerable data properties must be configurable; frozen extension records are rejected.
install.core: Registration-local capabilities. onDispose(resource) is allowed only during install: pass a void/PromiseLike<void> cleanup function or a disposable object; resources are released in reverse order after the plugin disposer.
install.setupOutput: Second argument only when setup is declared; exact resolved setup output. Otherwise install receives only core.
setup: Optional preparation hook before Feature construction and install. Receives config.get(), operation.signal/deadlineAt/now(), lifecycle.signal and onDispose(resource), but no Features or pipeline registration. Its exact resolved result becomes the second install/featureExpose argument.
Omitted; no preparation phase or second hook argument.
featureExpose: Optional object of methods or synchronous hook producing it. Feature factories receive only this explicit read-only method facade, not the whole install core; methods are revoked when the registration ends.
Omitted; an empty expose object.
activation: When the plugin installs: `eager` installs during `use()`; `lazy` only registers it and installs on `host.activate(name)` or when an eager plugin requires it.
`eager`: installed by `use()`.
Install immediately in `use()`.
Register only; install on first `activate()` or when required.
update: Called by `host.config.update(name, recipe)` with the candidate configuration `next` (read-only). Returning normally commits `next`; throwing or rejecting keeps the old configuration.
onEnable: Notification after the plugin becomes reachable: once after install, then after every real `enable`. Failures are only reported through `diagnostic`.
onDisable: Notification after the plugin was disabled (resources are kept). Failures are only reported.
onDependencyReplaced: Called on a dependent when a provider it requires was replaced with `host.replace()`. Rebinding to the new `outputs` here avoids a restart; without this hook (or when it throws) the dependent is restarted.
dispose: Plugin-level cleanup run on removal or host disposal, after `beforeRelease` and before resources registered with `onDispose` are released. Bounded by `disposeStepTimeoutMs`.
beforeRelease: Called once before an installed generation is released, while it can still serve calls; use it to flush or hand off work. `context.signal`, `deadlineAt` and `remainingMs()` describe the time budget. Failures are collected and release continues.
A plugin definition does nothing until installed. After `host.use(plugin)` the host gains: the object returned by `install` (and `expose`) on `handle.extensions` (derived hosts such as Logger also put these methods on the host itself); the pipeline stages the plugin registered; its Features for other plugins; its configuration under `host.config`; and cleanup of every resource it registered when it is removed.
symbols.advanced:
Stages registered with `core.usePipeline*` join every later host pipeline run in first-registration order.
Resources registered with `core.onDispose` or `context.onDispose` are released in reverse order when the plugin is removed or the host is disposed.
Package an optional capability (colored output, remote sink, cache) that users install only when needed.
Open a connection in async `setup`, publish typed methods in `install`, and let removal close it.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content:
Defines a plugin without running installation hooks. Function form builds a fresh descriptor per registration; object form also declares configuration, setup and lifecycle hooks. Config is captured when defining, not when the caller later mutates it.

Examples pass host.execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs as 5000 ms, the same as their defaults; false explicitly removes either deadline. host.config.get(path) uses plugin-name dot paths and returns undefined for an absent path.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import definePlugin from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use definePlugin when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when definePlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
name: Required function-form nonempty name, unique per host and without a dot.
descriptorFactory: Required synchronous function-form callback receiving the install core. Return an object with optional install(), expose() and featureExpose() hooks, all omitted by default. install may be awaitable through use(); expose and featureExpose must be synchronous. install/expose extension keys must be disjoint.
featureRecord: Optional function-form root Feature record; omitted means no roots. Dependencies are declared inside each defineFeature dependency map.
definition: Required object-form own-data definition; fields and hook inputs are documented below.
A plugin definition (`IDefinedPluginConstraint`) with `name`, the declared fields, and `getFeature(name)` for consumers. Invalid fields throw `INVALID_OPTION`; retired fields such as `shared` throw `PLUGIN_DEFINITION_INVALID`.
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Optional configuration: definePlugin snapshots and recursively freezes it at definition time; installation creates a registration-owned copy. Plain records/arrays and supported primitive or function leaves are admitted, while invalid values and cycles reject. Read core.config.get() or host.config.get(path); commit changes with host.config.update().
Omitted; the public definition.config is undefined and the host uses an empty configuration record.
features: Record of named roots created by defineFeature. Their dependency maps can reference provider.getFeature(name). The host installs required providers first and injects resolved root outputs as core.features.<name>.
Omitted; no Feature roots.
install: Required object-form hook. Receives the domain core plus config, operation, lifecycle, onDispose and pipeline registration methods; declared Feature outputs are ready. Return an extension record, or an awaitable record through asynchronous use(). Own enumerable data properties must be configurable; frozen extension records are rejected.
install.core: Registration-local capabilities. onDispose(resource) is allowed only during install: pass a void/PromiseLike<void> cleanup function or a disposable object; resources are released in reverse order after the plugin disposer.
install.setupOutput: Second argument only when setup is declared; exact resolved setup output. Otherwise install receives only core.
setup: Optional preparation hook before Feature construction and install. Receives config.get(), operation.signal/deadlineAt/now(), lifecycle.signal and onDispose(resource), but no Features or pipeline registration. Its exact resolved result becomes the second install/featureExpose argument.
Omitted; no preparation phase or second hook argument.
featureExpose: Optional object of methods or synchronous hook producing it. Feature factories receive only this explicit read-only method facade, not the whole install core; methods are revoked when the registration ends.
Omitted; an empty expose object.
activation: When the plugin installs: `eager` installs during `use()`; `lazy` only registers it and installs on `host.activate(name)` or when an eager plugin requires it.
`eager`: installed by `use()`.
Install immediately in `use()`.
Register only; install on first `activate()` or when required.
update: Called by `host.config.update(name, recipe)` with the candidate configuration `next` (read-only). Returning normally commits `next`; throwing or rejecting keeps the old configuration.
onEnable: Notification after the plugin becomes reachable: once after install, then after every real `enable`. Failures are only reported through `diagnostic`.
onDisable: Notification after the plugin was disabled (resources are kept). Failures are only reported.
onDependencyReplaced: Called on a dependent when a provider it requires was replaced with `host.replace()`. Rebinding to the new `outputs` here avoids a restart; without this hook (or when it throws) the dependent is restarted.
dispose: Plugin-level cleanup run on removal or host disposal, after `beforeRelease` and before resources registered with `onDispose` are released. Bounded by `disposeStepTimeoutMs`.
beforeRelease: Called once before an installed generation is released, while it can still serve calls; use it to flush or hand off work. `context.signal`, `deadlineAt` and `remainingMs()` describe the time budget. Failures are collected and release continues.
A plugin definition does nothing until installed. After `host.use(plugin)` the host gains: the object returned by `install` (and `expose`) on `handle.extensions` (derived hosts such as Logger also put these methods on the host itself); the pipeline stages the plugin registered; its Features for other plugins; its configuration under `host.config`; and cleanup of every resource it registered when it is removed.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Stages registered with `core.usePipeline*` join every later host pipeline run in first-registration order.
Resources registered with `core.onDispose` or `context.onDispose` are released in reverse order when the plugin is removed or the host is disposed.
Package an optional capability (colored output, remote sink, cache) that users install only when needed.
Open a connection in async `setup`, publish typed methods in `install`, and let removal close it.

guidance.id: 隔离配置与调用者后续修改
guidance.heading: 隔离配置与调用者后续修改

blocks.text: 插件定义捕获应用设置后，调用者在安装前修改了原设置对象；安装后的配置应反映定义时的快照，而不是后来的外部修改。
浅拷贝只分离最外层对象，嵌套设置仍为共享引用，修改内层限制会悄悄改变后续安装器读到的内容。
`definePlugin` 在创建定义时对接纳的配置数据做快照并递归冻结，传入普通数据记录或数组，宿主随后通过 `config.get(path)` 读取自己的配置。
`config` 可选、默认空配置，本例字段为 `settings.limit: 3`；定义时捕获嵌套对象。`host.config.get(path)` 的必填路径 `meter.settings.limit` 依次选择插件、设置记录和限制值，未知路径返回 undefined。
输出：

blocks.code:
3
true true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `3`、`true true`；把外部 `settings.limit` 改为 `99` 没有改变安装值，捕获配置的两层对象也均已冻结。
省略 `config` 时使用空配置，这不是 JSON 序列化：支持的函数叶值保留身份，不支持的原型、访问器、符号、类 `Promise` 对象（带可调用 `then` 的对象）与环会被拒绝，已提交配置应通过 `host.config.update()` 修改。

guidance.id: 命名管道-类型-权限与生命周期
guidance.heading: 命名管道：类型、权限与生命周期

blocks.text: 在函数入口的顶层 `pipelines`，或类构造选项的 `pipelines`，声明一个固定的“名字 → `pipelineSpec<TPayload>()(config)`”映射。每条管道独立推断载荷和 mode；名字是非空的自有可枚举字符串键，值必须来自真实 `pipelineSpec`，不能用结构相同的普通对象替代。说明对象被冻结；Host 的声明在构造时固定；插件也可在 `definePlugin({ pipelines })` 声明自己的组，随安装创建、失败回滚、卸载按原预算排空后删除。插件不能覆盖 Host 的同名管道，冲突以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 拒绝。

rows: `'sync'`、`'async'`、`'generator'`、`'async-generator'`；决定 stage 及 run 返回类型。
`'single'` 或 `'multiple'`；直接采用 middleware-pipeline 的四模式继续及失败规则。
`'install'` 按分配顺序，`'reverse'` 按其逆序；同一插件在所有管道共享原排序 slot。

blocks.text: 持有函数 handle 的 owner 调用 `host.pipeline(name).use(stage)` 或 `.run(value, done)`；类 owner 使用 protected `pipeline(name)`。安装中的插件和 Feature core 只有 `use(stage)`、`through(name)` 登记权，没有 run。两种命名登记都返回带幂等 `remove()` 的句柄；移除影响后续运行，已取得的快照仍由原生命周期排空。

插件和它的 Feature 用原名访问 Host 管道、用短名访问自己的管道，并通过既有 Feature 依赖用 `插件名.管道名` 访问提供方的组。无依赖关系的插件不能访问别人的组。`IPluginHostCoreFor<typeof host>` 适合仅使用 Host 声明的 core；声明插件自己的管道时，保留 install 参数的推导，避免 Host-only 注解遮掉自己的短名。未知或不可见名字同步抛 `PIPELINE_UNKNOWN`；诊断包含查询的插件或 Feature、请求名和可见的 Host、本插件、依赖插件范围。

sync、generator 的命名 run 返回 `TResult | undefined`；async、async-generator 返回 `Promise<Awaited<TResult> | undefined>`。短路返回 undefined，每次到达末端的遍历各调用一次 done。multiple 不返回结果数组；需要每次结果时，在 done 中明确收集。multiple 模式下，stage 可以处理经 next 的 then/await 观察到的分支失败；未观察的失败仍由 runner 拒绝，多个原错按启动顺序保留在 `MULTIPLE_DOWNSTREAM_FAILED` 中。generator 用 throw 把失败交回 yield；sync 遍历全部登记值后汇总错误。

所有管道在同一 Host 事务中提交；每条管道在同一可见 stage 修订内复用编译快照，reverse 也只在编译时处理。没有可见 stage 时直接调用终点，不取快照或 lease。有 stage 时，所有管道复用同一套登记、排序和 quiescence/lease owner。安装失败回滚、unUse、replace、禁用和挂起在一次提交中作用于该插件的全部管道；已有运行持有原快照和分管道的代际 lease，drain 等待这些实际运行，清理和排空预算仍由既有生命周期配置控制。任何管道执行期间，owner 向任一管道注册 stage 都会抛 `PIPELINE_EXECUTING`。

Host 未声明 pipelines 时，其命名轴默认为 `Record<never, never>`；已知插件定义仍能推出其限定名。Host 和插件都没有命名组时，不分配额外的命名 runner、lane 或 lease key。原 `TValue`、`pipeline.mode`、四个 use*Pipeline、runPipeline/runPipelineSync/runPipelineAsync、pipelineMode 都只操作默认管道，原有显式泛型调用不变。默认管道使用内部 symbol，不占用任何字符串名字。显式填写 defineHost 泛型并同时声明命名管道时，要在第五个泛型参数传 `typeof pipelines`；省略它会保留空轴，pipeline(name) 只接受 never。

非法 map、名字、spec、order 以原生 TypeError / `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 在构造时拒绝，不返回 handle；mode 非法仍是 `INVALID_PIPELINE_MODE`。next 非法的外层码为 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION`，cause 保留 middleware-pipeline 的 TypeError / `INVALID_OPTION`。spec 配置 getter 抛错时也以 `INVALID_PIPELINE_OPTION` 保留原 cause。

members.description: 正式 SLA：单个 disposer（pipeline disposer / 插件 dispose 钩子 / resource disposer） 等待超过阈值仍未 settle，包括该 * disposer 反过来 await 了同一次 dispose() 调用自身这种 循环等待。不会中断 disposer 的执行（JS 无法安全撤销已经在跑的 Promise 链），只是停止 * 等待并把这一步计为失败，让整个 dispose 事务仍能收敛到 disposed。

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Canonical English error text and message factories exported by the root entry. Downstream diagnostic adapters can reuse stable Host wording; error handling still branches on source/code rather than comparing message text.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ERROR_TEXT from @migaia/plugin-host, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ERROR_TEXT when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ERROR_TEXT does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content: Canonical English error text and message factories exported by the root entry. Downstream diagnostic adapters can reuse stable Host wording; error handling still branches on source/code rather than comparing message text.

blocks.text: PluginHostError 继承 Error，携带只读 source、code、可选 detail；source 为 `plugin.host`，原始失败通过 cause/errors 可达。可写 native 回调错误原位附身份，不可写或非 Error 值保留在 cause，完整外包身份保留原 owner。INVALID_OPTION 形状错误保留 TypeError；配置值与循环错误是 PluginHostError。不要仅按类名处理所有错误，也不要解析诊断文案。

安装主错不被回滚失败覆盖。PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED.detail 包含 failedName、按回滚顺序的 rollbackErrors；异步 use 的 detail 已完成且冻结，同步 useSync 先公布冻结快照，通过 detail.completion 返回最终冻结详情。需要完整次错身份的转换应先 await completion。回滚失败另报 PLUGIN_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED。

diagnostic 的第三参数保留原失败身份；诊断回调自身失败不会改变 Host 控制流，而交给 onDiagnosticFailure，再失败或省略时交给宿主存在的 globalThis.reportError。Node 需要这类观测时显式提供 onDiagnosticFailure。PluginHostStatus 为 active/closing/disposed；PluginHostRegistrationLifecycle 为 idle/install/dispose。ERROR_TEXT 是根命名导出的稳定英文消息表，MiddlewarePipelineMode/Violation 属于 middleware-pipeline。
`PluginHostDisposalNodeKind` 区分清理错误、聚合及 disposer 包装；`readPluginHostDisposalProvenance(error)` 只读取本物理包登记的追溯信息，未知错误或重复包副本返回 undefined，不按形状猜测。它用于诊断，不替代 source/code/cause 分类。

rows: 宿主已终态，创建新 Host，不能复用。
宿主正在关闭，不能开始新变更。
同一名称已占用或在批次中重复。
目标名称不存在，或句柄已无对应安装。
插件禁用中，先恢复再调用。
必需 provider 不可用使插件挂起，先恢复依赖。
lazy 插件未激活，先 await activate。
请求了未声明的 Feature 名称。
必需 provider 从未安装，安装前直接拒绝。
必需 provider 已禁用，启用后重试。
必需 provider 已卸载，需要重新安装。
Feature 跨插件引用成环，任何 install 前拒绝。
变更会遗留必需依赖者，detail.blockedBy 列出传递闭包。
替换候选名称不同，未安装候选。
新 provider 已提交但依赖者重装失败，cause.errors 首项为重装失败。
退役或不支持的定义字段、非法依赖或非 canonical core，保留 TypeError。
安装/发布失败，原错在 cause，回滚详情保留次错。
即时 useSync 安装遇到 setup，改用异步 use。
仅诊断：回滚也失败，不替换原安装主错。
install 结果自带 then，或同步路径得到异步结果，不发布此扩展。
beforeRelease 或插件释放步骤失败，cause 保留原错，其余清理继续。
扩展键已占用，Host 保留键优先分类为 EXTENSION_RESERVED。
扩展使用 Host 协议键、then 或清理 symbol。
仅诊断：有意忽略非枚举扩展键。
core 在安装窗口外拒绝且不接管；setup 关闭后的有效资源先释放再拒绝。
生命周期同步重入，或 setup / beforeRelease 等待期发起变更，不能执行。
构造时 mode 非四种合法值。
声明非法、插件覆盖 Host 名字、through 的 next 不兼容或成环；保留已有 cause。
名字未声明或对当前注册不可见；诊断包含调用方与可见范围。
默认同步入口遇到可见 async stage；任何 stage 或终点执行前拒绝。
stage 无法提升，或 through 的两条管道 mode 不同；提升失败保留上游 TypeError。
同次 stage 重复调用 next，不重复派发。
仅诊断：stage 已结束后调用 next，忽略此调用。
管线执行期间注册新 stage。
async 双失败，AggregateError.errors 固定为 stage、downstream。
已配置准入期限且排队到限，任务移出并不再执行。
beforeRelease 或普通释放步骤超预算，结束等待并继续清理，不强行取消。
入参形状不合法，保留原生 TypeError，修正输入。
配置不满足普通数据语法，detail 含 path/reason。
配置含引用环，提供无环值图。
未分类配置、surface 读取或 defineHost disposal 回调失败；保留原错或 cause。
hook 执行到限，丧失提交权限，迟到结果不能提交。
已取出的扩展属于已卸载或替换的旧注册。
普通卸载排空超预算，ok false，继续有界清理并诊断。
逻辑关闭已提交，清理有错或仍未完成；读取结果与 continuation。
组合目标非本物理包登记的 Host，不做结构兼容。

symbols.name: IDefinedPluginConstraint
symbols.purpose: The definition returned by `definePlugin()`: every `IPlugin` field plus `getFeature(name)` for consumers that depend on this plugin.
symbols.core:
name: Unique plugin name within a host. It addresses the plugin in `unUse`, `replace`, `config.get("name.key")` and Feature references, so it must not contain `.`.
config: Optional configuration: definePlugin snapshots and recursively freezes it at definition time; installation creates a registration-owned copy. Plain records/arrays and supported primitive or function leaves are admitted, while invalid values and cycles reject. Read core.config.get() or host.config.get(path); commit changes with host.config.update().
Omitted; the public definition.config is undefined and the host uses an empty configuration record.
features: Record of named roots created by defineFeature. Their dependency maps can reference provider.getFeature(name). The host installs required providers first and injects resolved root outputs as core.features.<name>.
Omitted; no Feature roots.
install: Required object-form hook. Receives the domain core plus config, operation, lifecycle, onDispose and pipeline registration methods; declared Feature outputs are ready. Return an extension record, or an awaitable record through asynchronous use(). Own enumerable data properties must be configurable; frozen extension records are rejected.
install.core: Registration-local capabilities. onDispose(resource) is allowed only during install: pass a void/PromiseLike<void> cleanup function or a disposable object; resources are released in reverse order after the plugin disposer.
install.setupOutput: Second argument only when setup is declared; exact resolved setup output. Otherwise install receives only core.
setup: Optional preparation hook before Feature construction and install. Receives config.get(), operation.signal/deadlineAt/now(), lifecycle.signal and onDispose(resource), but no Features or pipeline registration. Its exact resolved result becomes the second install/featureExpose argument.
Omitted; no preparation phase or second hook argument.
featureExpose: Optional object of methods or synchronous hook producing it. Feature factories receive only this explicit read-only method facade, not the whole install core; methods are revoked when the registration ends.
Omitted; an empty expose object.
activation: When the plugin installs: `eager` installs during `use()`; `lazy` only registers it and installs on `host.activate(name)` or when an eager plugin requires it.
`eager`: installed by `use()`.
Install immediately in `use()`.
Register only; install on first `activate()` or when required.
update: Called by `host.config.update(name, recipe)` with the candidate configuration `next` (read-only). Returning normally commits `next`; throwing or rejecting keeps the old configuration.
onEnable: Notification after the plugin becomes reachable: once after install, then after every real `enable`. Failures are only reported through `diagnostic`.
onDisable: Notification after the plugin was disabled (resources are kept). Failures are only reported.
onDependencyReplaced: Called on a dependent when a provider it requires was replaced with `host.replace()`. Rebinding to the new `outputs` here avoids a restart; without this hook (or when it throws) the dependent is restarted.
dispose: Plugin-level cleanup run on removal or host disposal, after `beforeRelease` and before resources registered with `onDispose` are released. Bounded by `disposeStepTimeoutMs`.
beforeRelease: Called once before an installed generation is released, while it can still serve calls; use it to flush or hand off work. `context.signal`, `deadlineAt` and `remainingMs()` describe the time budget. Failures are collected and release continues.
getFeature: Creates a reference to one Feature this plugin declares, for use in another plugin `defineFeature(factory, { name: reference })`. The reference makes this plugin a provider the consumer depends on.
getFeature.name: Name of a Feature in this plugin `features` record.
getFeature.options: `{ optional: true }` makes the dependency optional: the consumer installs even without this provider.
An `IFeatureReference` (provider name, feature name, optional flag). Unknown names throw `FEATURE_NOT_DECLARED`.
