blocks.text: verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

blocks.text: verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

symbols.name: createRpcIdempotencyStore
symbols.purpose: Creates a bounded in-memory execution/outcome store with post-settlement retention. Byte pressure evicts completed bodies while retaining execution tombstones, so missing bodies do not authorize re-execution.
symbols.core:
IRpcIdempotencyStore with no timers or dispose obligation; the session/provider owner controls scope/key admission.
retentionMs: Positive safe-integer milliseconds retained after settlement; pending execution does not expire by this policy.
Default 300000; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.
maxEntries: Positive safe-integer total original entry capacity.
Default 1024; invalid nonpositive or unsafe integers fail INVALID_CONFIG.

blocks.text: verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

status: Discriminates claimed, pending, done and full branches; narrow before using branch-specific methods.
This exact claim owns the first business execution.
Original business is still running; await its existing outcome.
Original business already settled; replay or report unavailable body.
No execution reservation was admitted at the current quota.
settle: On a claimed branch, settles once with the original portable business outcome and starts retention at the supplied time.
settle.outcome: Actual IRpcIdempotencyOutcome returned by the original business execution.
settle.now: Current monotonic milliseconds from the same clock used for claim.
Original waiters receive the result or unavailable marker; stale settlement does not reacquire ownership.
release: On a claimed branch, abandons the original unexecuted reservation and wakes waiters without an outcome.
The original reservation is removed; this is not a retry of already executed business.
outcome: Pending returns the original completion Promise; done contains retained outcome or unavailable when its body was evicted.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: One store claim owns execution, waits on original work, replays retained outcome, or refuses capacity; each status has a distinct available surface.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
status: Discriminates claimed, pending, done and full branches; narrow before using branch-specific methods.
This exact claim owns the first business execution.
Original business is still running; await its existing outcome.
Original business already settled; replay or report unavailable body.
No execution reservation was admitted at the current quota.
settle: On a claimed branch, settles once with the original portable business outcome and starts retention at the supplied time.
settle.outcome: Actual IRpcIdempotencyOutcome returned by the original business execution.
settle.now: Current monotonic milliseconds from the same clock used for claim.
Original waiters receive the result or unavailable marker; stale settlement does not reacquire ownership.
release: On a claimed branch, abandons the original unexecuted reservation and wakes waiters without an outcome.
The original reservation is removed; this is not a retry of already executed business.
outcome: Pending returns the original completion Promise; done contains retained outcome or unavailable when its body was evicted.

methods: Application method-name filter for method-bearing logical/envelope observations; methodless controls remain visible.

sample: Application probability strictly greater than zero and at most one; deterministic sender/message correlation selects matching events.

emit: Receives a reused mutable view valid only during this synchronous callback; snapshot before retaining. Throws are isolated through onError.

onError: Receives a coded PROBE_FAILED wrapper retaining the original callback failure as cause; a secondary throw is forwarded to hostRethrowReporter without changing business settlement.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxBufferedBytesPerSource

declaredConfiguration.name: schedule
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional timer admission callback; omission uses the host timeout path.

declaredConfiguration.name: cancel
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional cancellation for scheduled handles; omission uses the host timeout cancellation.

blocks.text: verifier 或凭据解析器抛出、拒绝时，auth 在本地错误的 `cause` 上保留原始错误。用 `errorMapFeature(map)` 决定对端能看到哪些错误信息，例如把含凭据的细节换成公开提示。本地抛出的错误、`report`、警告和只读观察插件看到的仍是原始错误，与插件安装先后无关。它可放在宿主 `plugins` 或传输 `features`，传输级覆盖宿主级。

`map(error, context)` 必须同步返回 `Error`、可移植值或 `undefined`。返回值就是发给对端的错误内容，不自动附加原错的原因链。回调抛错或返回值无法序列化时，报告映射失败，并按未映射时的规则发送原错误。返回 Promise/thenable 时报告 `INVALID_CONFIG`，立即按原规则发送，不等待它，因此同一会话的后续消息不会被它卡住；迟到的 Promise 拒绝仍会单独报告。
没有 `errorMapFeature` 时，未认证对端收到的握手拒绝默认隐藏细节；其他错误保留完整的原因链。跨进程或线程会还原成新对象，不保证与发送方原错 `===`。需要隐藏对端可见信息时配置映射，本地日志和原因链仍可用于排查。
连接或 Auth 安装在验签中途关闭时，这次入站处理按取消结束，不再报告为认证失败；原始取消原因仍保留，真正的验签失败照常报告。直接执行 Auth SDK 阶段的调用者，在安装关闭后会得到现有的 `UtilsAbortError` 及原始 `cause`，而不是 `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`。

blocks.text: `FeatureScope` 唯一解析覆盖顺序：单次调用 `options.timeout/retry`、所在传输 plugin 的 feature、链路策略 plugin。单次值只接受完整 feature 实例或 `false`，不接受数字或配置对象。`timeout: false` 不启用 feature 超时，持续等待响应；已经继承的上游剩余期限仍递减。`retry: false` 禁用重试。只有发起方的标量调用和 group 重试，stream 从不重放、只使用 timeout；转发跳不重新开始预算。
进入 provider 前剩余截止时间已经耗尽的调用，以 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 拒绝，不执行 provider；`before-start` 的取消语义保持不变。
所有调用种类支持 `signal`，单向调用物理发送之后也能向下游传播取消。provider 读取自己的 `context.signal`。取消不等于杀进程，也不回滚业务副作用。
按 `source/code` 识别错误，保留原生类型、`stack`、`cause` 和 `AggregateError.errors`。超时或断开不证明业务未执行；非幂等操作须先对账再考虑重试。

`send`、`request` 等返回 Promise 的调用通过拒绝传播非法 `idempotencyKey`、transfer 准入被拒绝或命名空间已关闭的错误，保留各入口原有的 `source/code` 和 `cause`；非法 key 仍为 `CONTRACT_INVALID`。使用 `await` 或 `Promise.catch` 处理失败。`dispatch` 仍同步返回 `void` 并向 reporter 交付失败，`stream` 与 `streamTo` 仍返回延迟启动的异步迭代器。
公开 provider 注册失败以 `INVALID_CONFIG` 拒绝，原注册错误直接保留在 `cause`；错误说明不通过调用异常的字符串转换来生成。关闭后，待决调用以 `ENDPOINT_DISPOSED` 结算，实际载体关闭会拒绝仍被挂住的写入；不要求任意业务 Promise 因关闭而强行完成。

自定义 plugin 作者从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 开始。观察入口是 `/plugins/probe`；旧 `/plugin`、`/probe`、endpoint、per-session Peer 和 v1/JSON-RPC profile 已删除。rpc 家族可以直接依赖 `@migaia/rpc-contract`；只需错误码时导入 `/error-code`，不会带入协议与编解码执行代码。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
observation: Optional actual native observation port; absence must not be advertised as carrier-stage capability.
No native observation subscription.
id: Correlation id issued by the originating call or control owner and echoed by its terminal.
nativeBinary: True only for a carrier with genuine native backing support; caller metadata cannot enable it.
codecs: Ordered real codec proposals including mandatory json bootstrap.
codec: Actual executing codec for this physical carrier.
assertTransfer: Reject explicit transfer when this acquired medium cannot perform it.
Normal return proves support, without creating caller permission.
subscribe: Install the Host receiver on this actual connection.
subscribe.receiver: Host-owned frame/close/error callbacks for this binding.
Exact native listener cleanup owned by this installation.
write: Hand one opaque codec frame to the real ordered physical writer.
write.frame: Frame from the same carrier codec or a negotiated frame plugin.
write.options: Optional local signal, transfer, lane, trace and handoff notification.
Completes at physical acceptance, not queue insertion; failures retain their original diagnostic.
close: Close the actual resource and borrow its original idempotent completion.
close.reason: Original local reason from the closing or departing owner.
The resource-owned close Promise; cleanup failures retain their original cause/errors chain.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
scope: Original metric denominator, such as endpoint-client, execution-unit, process or thread.
pid: Original native process id when observed.
sharedPid: Actual shared host process id for a non-isolated native unit, not a claim of process isolation.
threadId: Original actual native thread identity when observed.
rssBytes: Original RSS byte metric in the declared native scope, or unavailable.
heapUsedBytes: Original sampled used heap bytes; no aggregate substitution.
heapTotalBytes: Original sampled total heap bytes; no invented zero.
cpu: Original user/system CPU-time metrics in microseconds, or explicit unavailable state.
elu: Original event-loop active/idle milliseconds and dimensionless utilization, distinct from CPU time.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Sample the exact native unit and discard results if identity changed during awaiting.

rejection: Actual provider refusal reason, never inferred from a shared error code.

listenerAlreadyBound: `LISTENER_ALREADY_BOUND`: the SharedWorker scope already has a listener; close it first.
invalidPeerSource: `INVALID_PEER_SOURCE`: give exactly one supported `connect` or `listen`.
messageDecodeFailed: `MESSAGE_DECODE_FAILED`: an RTC message is not valid JSON; see `cause`.

symbols.core:
methods: Exact method path filter supplied by the application; methodless control events remain observable.
No method filter; all method-bearing events are eligible.
sample: Deterministic sampling fraction in the interval greater than zero through one, using sender/message identity rather than random per-stage decisions.
`1`, retaining all eligible identities before retention limits.
capture: Explicit stages whose content may be read. Select names from RpcProbeStageName in @migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe and keep capture within initially subscribed stages.
No content capture; observation remains metadata-only.
redact: Synchronous callback receiving numeric RpcProbeStage and captured content. Return the retained replacement; never retain the reusable event view. Collector executes it during ingestion, log executes it at the canonical emitter.
redact.stage: Numeric stage from RpcProbeStage supplied by the observing emitter.
redact.content: Captured caller-owned content reference from an explicitly enabled stage.
Replacement content, including undefined to discard it. Synchronous throws discard content and are reported; asynchronous redaction is not awaited.
No redactor; explicitly captured content retains its original reference.
Set it when explicitly captured content contains data that should not be retained or logged. Return a replacement, or `undefined` to discard content. Omitting it retains the captured reference unchanged; a thrown error is reported and that content is dropped.
onError: Synchronous observer receiving an original diagnostic error. Return nothing; observer failures are reported through the host failure channel without changing the RPC operation.
onError.error: Original collector observation failure supplied by its owning component.
No result is used and no asynchronous work is awaited by this callback boundary.
Uses the Core hostRethrowReporter failure channel.
Set this callback when a diagnostic failure should reach the application monitor. It receives collector observation failures without replacing a business result. Omission keeps the documented host reporter for the owning component.
stages: Initial stage names from Core RpcProbeStageName; physical stages require explicit selection and selection alone never enables capture.
`["message", "peer"]`; physical stages are not subscribed.
Logical request, response and control observations.
Connection lifecycle observations.
Envelope observations; explicit opt-in.
Encoded content observations; explicit opt-in.
Frame observations; explicit opt-in.
Protected content observations; explicit opt-in.
Physical carrier observations; explicit opt-in.
Use `message` for logical calls and `peer` for connection lifecycle. Add `envelope`, `encoded`, `frame`, `protected` or `carrier` to inspect those physical processing steps. Omission selects message and peer; choosing a stage never enables content capture by itself.
maxEvents: Main-ring positive safe integer capacity, at most the JavaScript array length limit; newest events evict oldest events.
10000 retained events in the main ring.
maxContentBytes: Nonnegative safe integer budget for content retained by the main query ring; independent recording/watch references and opaque-object sizing are outside this byte total. It is not a process-wide memory ceiling; excess content drops while metadata stays.
8388608 bytes, or eight mebibytes.
maxInterned: Positive safe integer reader name-table bound, at most floor(sqrt(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) minus one; overflow uses an explicit marker.
65536 names; ingestion itself retains raw string references.
exposeContent: Allows captured content across the portable service boundary; local query and stopped recordings already use their retained captured content.
false; service responses omit captured content.

methods: Exact method path filter supplied by the application; methodless control events remain observable.
No method filter; all method-bearing events are eligible.
sample: Deterministic sampling fraction in the interval greater than zero through one, using sender/message identity rather than random per-stage decisions.
`1`, retaining all eligible identities before retention limits.
capture: Explicit stages whose content may be read. Select names from RpcProbeStageName in @migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe and keep capture within initially subscribed stages.
No content capture; observation remains metadata-only.
redact: Synchronous callback receiving numeric RpcProbeStage and captured content. Return the retained replacement; never retain the reusable event view. Collector executes it during ingestion, log executes it at the canonical emitter.
redact.stage: Numeric stage from RpcProbeStage supplied by the observing emitter.
redact.content: Captured caller-owned content reference from an explicitly enabled stage.
Replacement content, including undefined to discard it. Synchronous throws discard content and are reported; asynchronous redaction is not awaited.
No redactor; explicitly captured content retains its original reference.
Set it when explicitly captured content contains data that should not be retained or logged. Return a replacement, or `undefined` to discard content. Omitting it retains the captured reference unchanged; a thrown error is reported and that content is dropped.
onError: Synchronous observer receiving an original diagnostic error. Return nothing; observer failures are reported through the host failure channel without changing the RPC operation.
onError.error: Original collector observation failure supplied by its owning component.
No result is used and no asynchronous work is awaited by this callback boundary.
Uses the Core hostRethrowReporter failure channel.
Set this callback when a diagnostic failure should reach the application monitor. It receives collector observation failures without replacing a business result. Omission keeps the documented host reporter for the owning component.
stages: Initial stage names from Core RpcProbeStageName; physical stages require explicit selection and selection alone never enables capture.
`["message", "peer"]`; physical stages are not subscribed.
Logical request, response and control observations.
Connection lifecycle observations.
Envelope observations; explicit opt-in.
Encoded content observations; explicit opt-in.
Frame observations; explicit opt-in.
Protected content observations; explicit opt-in.
Physical carrier observations; explicit opt-in.
Use `message` for logical calls and `peer` for connection lifecycle. Add `envelope`, `encoded`, `frame`, `protected` or `carrier` to inspect those physical processing steps. Omission selects message and peer; choosing a stage never enables content capture by itself.
maxEvents: Main-ring positive safe integer capacity, at most the JavaScript array length limit; newest events evict oldest events.
10000 retained events in the main ring.
maxContentBytes: Nonnegative safe integer budget for content retained by the main query ring; independent recording/watch references and opaque-object sizing are outside this byte total. It is not a process-wide memory ceiling; excess content drops while metadata stays.
8388608 bytes, or eight mebibytes.
maxInterned: Positive safe integer reader name-table bound, at most floor(sqrt(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) minus one; overflow uses an explicit marker.
65536 names; ingestion itself retains raw string references.
exposeContent: Allows captured content across the portable service boundary; local query and stopped recordings already use their retained captured content.
false; service responses omit captured content.

members.name: stats
members.description: Returns a new frozen instantaneous snapshot; reading it neither subscribes nor changes capacity.

members.name: resize
members.description: Queues a positive-integer target change in call order. Shrink prefers idle members and waits for occupied retirees without interrupting their calls; expansion acquires only the missing members. Factory/cleanup failures reject, and failed expansion restores the old target while still open. Closing pools reject resize with POOL_CLOSED.

members.name: close
members.description: Synchronously enters closing, rejects new admission and drains already accepted operations and acquisitions before closing owned Peers. Streams must finish/return/throw or settle their cancellation; no pool drain timeout is added. Repeated calls share one Promise. All member closes are attempted; failures from this closing phase reject as CLOSE_FAILED AggregateError with original errors and the first failure on cause, even though state has become closed. Completed open-phase resize/idle failures have already been delivered and are not replayed.

symbols.name: IProcessPluginCommonOptions
symbols.purpose: Cold native options borrowing original policy and reporter owners.
symbols.core:
base: Module URL used to resolve a relative `entry`.
Omitted: resolve from the genuine main-entry URL when relative paths require a base.
command: Executable to run instead of `entry`, e.g. `python3`.
Omitted: use the selected runtime executable and resolve the module entry.
args: Arguments of `command`, or extra arguments.
Explicit entry or command: empty arguments. Self-spawn without args: retain parent script arguments.
cwd: Working-directory path passed to the native child launcher; controls child-process relative paths without changing the local module-resolution base.
Omitted: retain the native launcher working-directory default.
env: `{ inherit, set }`: variable names to inherit and values to set.
Omitted: inherit PATH only and set no additional variables.
wrap: Rewrites the computed launch command (e.g. to run inside `sandbox-exec` or `bwrap`) on every launch, restart and replace. Must keep stdin/stdout and environment, and forward the exit code.
Omitted: launch the originally computed command without rewriting it.
Use a native sandbox or wrapper executable while preserving the original arguments, environment, stdio channel and exit status. The wrapper runs on each native launch.
stdio: stdio routing; default `{ stdin: "channel", stdout: "channel", stderr: "drain" }`.
Omitted: stdin and stdout use channel; stderr is drained.
limits: Limits such as `callWallTimeMs` per call.
Omitted: request no explicit native resource limits through this field.
permissions: Runtime permissions (Deno).
Omitted: supply no explicit permission arguments to the selected runtime.
token: Shared secret checked in the handshake; required for TCP, explicit socket paths and Windows pipes. Generate it per deployment and never log it.
Not set: named endpoints rely on OS user permissions.
Use the application-owned value shown here when configuring this connection. Omitted optional values keep their documented defaults.
supervision: Overrides the original supervisor restart, startup, stop and other policies; retains the same execution-unit owner without installing another supervisor.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: One cold native transport using original bootstrap, supervision, drain and native exit owners. Both sides provide methods over the same actual host endpoint.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import processPlugin from @migaia/rpc-plugin-process, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use processPlugin when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when processPlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

declaredConfiguration.name: base
declaredConfiguration.description: Explicit base for resolving relative entry paths; omission uses the main entry.

declaredConfiguration.name: command
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional executable override; supplying it bypasses module-entry resolution.

declaredConfiguration.name: args
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to [] for an explicit entry/command; spawn:true forwards the parent's script arguments.

declaredConfiguration.name: cwd
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional working directory forwarded unchanged to the native process specification.

declaredConfiguration.name: env
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to inherit:['PATH'] and set:{}; selected additions override inherited names.

declaredConfiguration.name: wrap
declaredConfiguration.description: Rewrite the command once per launch; throws/invalid returned data reject with PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION.

declaredConfiguration.name: stdio
declaredConfiguration.description: Defaults to stdin:'channel', stdout:'channel', stderr:'drain'; channel/bootstrap ownership stays local.

declaredConfiguration.name: limits
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional supervision limits; unsupported native enforcement follows the selected isolation policy.

declaredConfiguration.name: permissions
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional permissions forwarded to supervision; they do not grant an adapter unsupported capabilities.

declaredConfiguration.name: token
declaredConfiguration.description: Credential for explicit addresses; same-user Unix named endpoints have an OS-isolated default.

declaredConfiguration.name: supervision
declaredConfiguration.description: Overrides the default one-unit, best-effort process supervisor and its generated specification.

declaredConfiguration.name: onNotice
declaredConfiguration.description: Receive expected unsupported-termination notices; omission uses the configured/default reporter.

declaredConfiguration.name: verify
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional listener verifier; omission compares the configured token and returns the local principal.

declaredConfiguration.name: connectTimeoutMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Finite nonnegative named-local rendezvous wait, default 5000ms; explicit addresses do not retry.

symbols.core:
usageSampleFailed: `PROCESS_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED`: CPU or memory sampling failed; show unavailable.
hostInvalidOption: `PROCESS_HOST_INVALID_OPTION`: a host option is invalid; fix the named field.
hostClosed: `PROCESS_HOST_CLOSED`: the outlet is releasing; use a new host or Peer.
handshakeTimeout: `PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT`: the handshake did not finish in time; open a new channel.
authRejected: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED`: the credential was refused; do not retry with it.
channelClosed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED`: work on a closed channel; reconnect and reconcile.
connectFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`: connecting to the other process, starting it, or setting up part of the channel failed. If the system call that starts the process or opens its streams throws, you get that same error object with its type, stack and fields intact. Its `source` becomes this package and its system `code` (such as `ENOENT`) becomes `PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED`, one stable value to check. An already wrapped failure keeps the original on `cause`.
listenFailed: `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED`: preparing to listen, or binding the listening address, failed. You receive the same system error object, with its type, stack and other fields unchanged; it only gains this package as `source` and `PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED` as `code`. Both the reported error and the rejected promise keep the original `cause` chain.
pluginInvalidOption: `PROCESS_PLUGIN_INVALID_OPTION`: a plugin or source option is invalid.
resilienceInvalidOption: `PROCESS_RESILIENCE_INVALID_OPTION`: a governance limit is invalid.
connectionLimit: `PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT`: connection, rate or payload limit; the call did not run.
instanceUnhealthy: `PROCESS_INSTANCE_UNHEALTHY`: the target is suspended until a healthy replacement is ready.
healthPingFailed: `PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED`: a health ping failed; supervision restarts it.
terminalCall: `PROCESS_TERMINAL_CALL`: the registration is terminal and refuses calls.
liquidated: `PROCESS_LIQUIDATED`: the registration was liquidated; create a new one.

members.description: Native PID sampling failed; report its cause and display unavailable without retrying.

members.name: hostInvalidOption
members.description: Host options are invalid before launch; callers must correct the named field.

members.name: hostClosed
members.description: Facade release has begun; callers must create a new facade instead of enqueueing work.

members.name: handshakeTimeout
members.description: Handshake exceeded its scheduler deadline; caller must open a new channel.

members.name: authRejected
members.description: Peer authorization failed; caller must not retry without valid credentials.

members.name: channelClosed
members.description: A closed channel rejected work or its close observer/resource cleanup failed; inspect * cause/errors.

members.name: connectFailed
members.description: Dial or launch could not establish a channel; caller may inspect the original cause.

members.name: listenFailed
members.description: The requested local listener could not bind; caller must choose an available address.

members.name: pluginInvalidOption
members.description: Invalid process-plugin options are rejected before launch; caller must correct the named field.

members.name: resilienceInvalidOption
members.description: Invalid resilience limits, ownership, or health configuration; correct the named field before * opening a connection.

members.name: connectionLimit
members.description: A connection, call-rate, or payload limit rejected admission before provider execution.

members.name: instanceUnhealthy
members.description: A shared target is suspended after an explicit instance-health event until a ready replacement * exists.

members.name: healthPingFailed
members.description: An enabled native health ping returned false before its supervision deadline; the owner must * restart the unit.

members.name: terminalCall
members.description: A terminal registration rejects new remote calls before they reach its inactive generation.

members.name: liquidated
members.description: A liquidated registration cannot restart; the caller must create a new registration.

blocks.text: 单次调用传 `signal`，以及完整的 `timeoutFeature({ ms })`、`retryFeature({ attempts })` 实例或 `false`。策略优先级是单次调用、transport feature、链路策略 plugin；未选择策略时不自动加超时或重试。取消是协作信号，不会抢占同步死循环。
Thread 的原生 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 是独立硬上限；显式 `timeout: false` 只关闭可选业务 timeout，不能延长该上限。它由真实 launch spec 与同一 scheduler 创建的完整 timeout 实例执行。
`notify` 等物理写出，`request` 等业务结果。原生监管负责重启与替换；连接恢复不代表业务可安全重放。原生错误、调用错误和远端错误保留自己的 source/code/cause，跨线程传递的错误图保留 name/message/stack 与聚合成员。
根入口公开 `threadPlugin`、`isThreadChild`、选项与错误身份。自定义原始载体使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`；只读观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。关闭流、取消调用、关闭 namespace、关闭 Host 和终止 Worker 是不同操作。资源与恢复示例见使用指南。

blocks.text: 单次调用传 `signal`，以及完整的 `timeoutFeature({ ms })`、`retryFeature({ attempts })` 实例或 `false`。策略优先级是单次调用、transport feature、链路策略 plugin；未选择策略时不自动加超时或重试。取消是协作信号，不会抢占同步死循环。
Thread 的原生 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 是独立硬上限；显式 `timeout: false` 只关闭可选业务 timeout，不能延长该上限。它由真实 launch spec 与同一 scheduler 创建的完整 timeout 实例执行。
`notify` 等物理写出，`request` 等业务结果。原生监管负责重启与替换；连接恢复不代表业务可安全重放。原生错误、调用错误和远端错误保留自己的 source/code/cause，跨线程传递的错误图保留 name/message/stack 与聚合成员。
根入口公开 `threadPlugin`、`isThreadChild`、选项与错误身份。自定义原始载体使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`；只读观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。关闭流、取消调用、关闭 namespace、关闭 Host 和终止 Worker 是不同操作。资源与恢复示例见使用指南。

symbols.name: emitOutput
symbols.purpose: Synchronously emits a complete management projection as JSON, YAML or TOML. Copies own enumerable data without invoking getters or serialization hooks; rejects cycles, nonfinite numbers and unsupported values before producing output.
symbols.core:
value: Required caller-owned data: `null`, booleans, finite numbers, strings, dense arrays or plain/null-prototype records recursively containing these values. Own enumerable fields must be data properties; accessors, symbol keys, undefined, bigint, functions, cycles and class instances are rejected. TOML further requires a record root, no nested `null`, and Unicode scalar strings. The caller chooses field names such as `theme` and `retries`; they are not emitter options.
format: Optional `SerializeTextFormat`: `json` (the default) emits one JSON value, `yaml` emits valid flow-style YAML, and `toml` emits record assignments. These are the only three values. This selects a text emitter, not an input parser or registry plugin.
One complete string. Rejected format or graph throws native TypeError with INVALID_OPTION and no partial output.
parameters: value: unknown
format: ISerializeTextFormat (optional)
symbols.returns: string
examples:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

guidance.id: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式
guidance.heading: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式

blocks.text: 配置下载需要 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，分别拼接文本时，对输入值的接受规则不同，同一份设置可能得到不一致的内容。
手写格式化会把值校验、引号转义和嵌套集合语法混在一起，增加格式时容易顺带改变保留哪些字段或怎样转义字符串。
把配置交给 `emitOutput()`，用 `SerializeTextFormat` 选择格式。三种格式共用普通数据接纳规则，每次调用都会先对输入校验并投影，再输出所选格式；省略格式时使用 JSON。
emitOutput 的第一个参数是普通自有数据，第二个 format 可省略，默认 json；SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml 分别选择另外两种输出。theme 和 retries 是业务字段。格式全集为 json/yaml/toml，YAML/TOML 只生成文本，不提供反向 parser。

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: 输出：
依次输出 `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`、`YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`，然后三行 `TOML:`、`"theme" = "dark"`、`"retries" = 2`。
三种输出保留了传入字段，YAML 使用合法的流式集合语法。这是文本生成工具，不是 YAML 或 TOML 解析器。TOML 要求根值为记录并拒绝 null，其余格式也会拒绝不支持的值，不会悄悄省略。

guidance.id: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式
guidance.heading: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式

blocks.text: 配置下载需要 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，分别拼接文本时，对输入值的接受规则不同，同一份设置可能得到不一致的内容。
手写格式化会把值校验、引号转义和嵌套集合语法混在一起，增加格式时容易顺带改变保留哪些字段或怎样转义字符串。
把配置交给 `emitOutput()`，用 `SerializeTextFormat` 选择格式。三种格式共用普通数据接纳规则，每次调用都会先对输入校验并投影，再输出所选格式；省略格式时使用 JSON。
emitOutput 的第一个参数是普通自有数据，第二个 format 可省略，默认 json；SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml 分别选择另外两种输出。theme 和 retries 是业务字段。格式全集为 json/yaml/toml，YAML/TOML 只生成文本，不提供反向 parser。

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: 输出：
依次输出 `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`、`YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`，然后三行 `TOML:`、`"theme" = "dark"`、`"retries" = 2`。
三种输出保留了传入字段，YAML 使用合法的流式集合语法。这是文本生成工具，不是 YAML 或 TOML 解析器。TOML 要求根值为记录并拒绝 null，其余格式也会拒绝不支持的值，不会悄悄省略。

tagMissing: An input has no tag and no read-only legacy fallback is configured.
tagInvalid: A recognized tag header is malformed; it never falls back to the legacy reader.
tagUnknown: A well-formed tag identifies an unregistered codec revision.
portableValueInvalid: Used when input or decoded output lies outside the accepted portable profile.

symbols.name: IPortableWalkerStrategy
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned synchronous traversal policy captured once by createPortableWalker. Hooks receive the current node and invocation context; callbacks must return synchronously, and the violation hook throws the caller-owned coded error with the original cause.
symbols.core:
maxDepth: Maximum admitted traversal depth, where root depth defaults to zero. Finite limits must be nonnegative safe integers.
Infinity, so no strategy depth ceiling is imposed.
scalar: Synchronous hook receiving primitive candidate value and walker context. Return a primitive or { value, violation? }; a deferred violation is raised after projection, while context.reject fails immediately.
scalar.value: Primitive node supplied by traversal from the caller input graph.
scalar.context: Invocation tools: reject(reason, cause?), isAncestor(object), isUint8Array, bytesToBase64url and isCanonicalBase64url; these are synchronous and reject throws.
Projected scalar or deferred scalar result; a throw aborts the traversal.
record: Synchronous hook receiving an object and context. Return undefined for array handling, or entries with optional output. A tag emits an inline bytes object instead of traversing entries; hasBinary marks an existing binary tag, and validate checks the completed record. Entry children are traversed by the walker; missing output validates without constructing a record.
record.value: Current object node supplied by traversal.
record.context: Current invocation rejection, ancestor and binary helper tools.
Record admission or undefined. Optional validate(output) synchronously returns a violation reason or undefined; any throw aborts traversal through policy handling.
binary: Synchronous hook receiving an object and context before record or array handling. Return inline text or native storage for an atomic binary node, or undefined for ordinary traversal.
binary.value: Object candidate supplied by traversal before container admission.
binary.context: Current rejection, ancestor, byte detection and canonical base64url helper tools.
IPortableBinaryResult or undefined. Without nativeByteLength only inline strings are supported; a throw stops traversal.
nativeByteLength: Synchronous hook receiving admitted Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer and returning its byte length through the owner intrinsic accessor. Required only for strategies returning native binary storage.
nativeByteLength.value: Native binary storage returned by the same strategy binary callback.
Native byte count used in byteUpperBound; a throw becomes a traversal policy failure.
Absent; the binary hook is then restricted to inline strings or undefined.
array: Synchronous array hook receives value, visit(child) and context. Visit each child with the supplied callback; return the projected array or { value, length?, violation? }. It cannot be supplied with arrayValue.
array.value: Input array node supplied by traversal.
array.visit: Synchronous child visitor owned by the walker; returns one projected child and propagates traversal failures.
array.context: Current invocation rejection and binary helper tools.
Projected array or array admission; thrown errors stop traversal.
Uses value.map(visit), retaining native map, species and hole behavior.
arrayValue: Alternative synchronous raw array hook receiving value, owned visit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds and context. Invoke visit(child, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds) for children; cannot coexist with array.
arrayValue.value: Input array node from traversal.
arrayValue.visit: Owned synchronous visitor accepting child, depth, ancestors, guard and bounds and returning a projected child.
arrayValue.childDepth: Walker-computed depth for immediate array children.
arrayValue.ancestors: Invocation-owned active ancestor set; pass it to the supplied visitor.
arrayValue.guard: Optional caller-supplied native-binary rejection guard; defaults to absent.
arrayValue.bounds: Whether this invocation collects byte metadata rather than value only.
arrayValue.context: Invocation-owned rejection and binary helper tools.
The projected array value without an admission wrapper; errors propagate through policy handling.
Absent; ordinary array handling is used instead.
key: Synchronous hook receiving each record key and context before writing its child. Return nothing; reject or throw to forbid a field name.
key.key: Record key yielded by the strategy entries iterable.
key.context: Current invocation tools whose reject method throws a policy violation.
No result is used; normal return admits the key.
No key policy; all keys supplied by record entries are admitted.
write: Synchronous hook receiving output record, admitted key and projected child. Write the field using strategy-owned prototype and property semantics; a throw stops traversal.
write.output: Output record returned by the strategy record callback.
write.key: Admitted entry key from the record entries iterable.
write.child: Child value already projected by the walker.
No result is used; the output record is updated in place.
Defines an own enumerable writable configurable data property, including safe handling of __proto__.
finish: Synchronous hook applied after each array, record or inline bytes-tag projection; primitive and native-binary nodes bypass it. Receives that node and its native-binary descendant flag; return the published node, or throw to stop.
finish.value: Container or inline bytes-tag projection already produced for the current node.
finish.hasNativeBinary: True when native binary storage occurs below this projected container node.
Final caller-selected projection; identity finish retains the projected value.
Identity callback returns the projected value unchanged.
violation: Required synchronous failure hook receiving reason and optional original cause. Must throw the caller-owned coded native error; no recovery value is accepted.
violation.reason: Walker-owned classification such as depth, cycle, access, scalar, prototype, binary, tag or sparse.
violation.cause: Original failure captured during traversal, absent when the violation has no underlying throw.
Never returns: throws the chosen error, retaining the supplied cause where present.

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 serialization，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。
TAG_MISSING：无标签输入缺少显式 untagged 读取器。
TAG_UNKNOWN：合法标签没有对应的登记版本。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (foundation.utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

symbols.purpose: Adaptively slices an application array, encodes each slice through a registry and yields ordered chunks with bounded in-flight encoding. Pair it with a registry created by `createSerializeRegistry` and an installed parser such as `jsonPlugin`; the example consumes each chunk directly with `chunkToText`. items: Caller-owned array to divide into slices; each slice is encoded as an independent array value.

targetMs: Positive finite consumer processing budget in milliseconds; measured elapsed time adjusts the next slice size.

minItems: Positive safe integer lower bound on items per slice, reducing overhead from very small batches.

maxItems: Positive safe integer upper bound on items per slice; must be at least `minItems`.

initialItems: Positive safe integer initial size before consumer timing is available; clamped between the item bounds.

declaredConfiguration.name: type
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional plugin route, defaulting through each registry call to primaryType.

declaredConfiguration.name: context
declaredConfiguration.description: Diagnostic label, default stream.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxInFlight
declaredConfiguration.description: Backpressure limit for concurrent requests. Defaults to 1, waiting for each encoded slice before encoding the next. Only one slice is in flight at that setting. Higher limits overlap encoding with worker processing at the cost of retaining more slices in memory.

declaredConfiguration.name: targetMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.

declaredConfiguration.name: minItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Minimum slice size, default 64; must be a positive safe integer.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum slice size, default 250000; must be a positive safe integer at least minItems.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial size, default 2048; a positive safe integer clamped to the configured min/max bounds.

declaredConfiguration.name: yieldTo
declaredConfiguration.description: Yield mechanism. Defaults to `scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)`. Can use `scheduler.yield()` for finer scheduling or requestIdleCallback for a more conservative yield. A custom callback owns its own cancellation and settlement; it cannot forcibly interrupt consumer work.

declaredConfiguration.name: signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional cooperative cancellation signal, default undefined; checked between slice admissions.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Required runtime-neutral scheduler. Core has no default timer and never directly accesses host `setTimeout`, `performance`, or `Date.now`.

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。
TAG_MISSING：无标签输入缺少显式 untagged 读取器。
TAG_UNKNOWN：合法标签没有对应的登记版本。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (foundation.utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。

members.name: decodeFailed
members.description: Thrown when the parser's `decode` or streaming decoding fails. * * `cause` retains the original exception. Use `chunkIndex` and `bytesConsumed` to locate the * failure.

members.description: Thrown for an invalid chunk: a malformed `[type, data]` pair, incorrect text or byte payload, * unknown kind, or a value chunk used by a carrier that accepts only wire data. * * Check parser output and input chunks. members.name: aborted
members.description: Thrown when encoding or decoding is cancelled through an abort signal. * * Treat this as cancellation and retry with a fresh signal when appropriate. It differs from * unrecoverable `ENCODE_FAILED` and `DECODE_FAILED` errors.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Text emitters also reject nonportable own data and values the selected format cannot express.

members.description: Thrown when `createSerializeRegistry` cannot obtain host `TextEncoder` or `TextDecoder` * capabilities. members.name: tagMissing

members.name: tagInvalid

symbols.name: sliceByFrameBudget
symbols.purpose: Yields array slices and measures consumer work between yield and resume to adjust the next slice size. It waits between slices using an injected scheduler or yield callback; a target duration is adaptive rather than preemptive.
symbols.core:
items: Caller-owned source array; each yielded slice is a shallow array copy with original item references.
AsyncGenerator of readonly array slices. Invalid options throw INVALID_OPTION; an aborted signal throws ABORTED. Early return stops future slices.
targetMs: Positive finite consumer processing budget in milliseconds; measured elapsed time adjusts the next slice size.
`8` milliseconds per slice; this is a target rather than a hard execution deadline.
minItems: Positive safe integer lower bound on items per slice, reducing overhead from very small batches.
`64` items, including the lower clamp applied to the initial slice.
maxItems: Positive safe integer upper bound on items per slice; must be at least `minItems`.
`250000` items; adaptive growth never exceeds this upper bound.
initialItems: Positive safe integer initial size before consumer timing is available; clamped between the item bounds.
`2048` items before clamping to `minItems` and `maxItems`.
yieldTo: Optional no-argument async callback invoked between slices. Resolve after yielding execution; a throw or rejection stops iteration.
A `Promise<void>` whose fulfillment permits the next slice; rejection reaches the stream consumer.
Schedules a zero-delay task with the supplied scheduler; its wait observes cancellation.
Use a host task or frame callback when consumers must let other work run between slices. The callback returns Promise<void>; rejection stops iteration. Omission schedules a zero-delay task through scheduler and observes cancellation.
signal: Caller-owned structural `IAbortSignal`, usually from `createAbortController().signal`, requests cooperative cancellation.
`undefined`: no caller cancellation signal is installed.
scheduler: Required `IScheduler`, with no default: `now()` returns finite monotonic milliseconds; `schedule(callback, delayMs)` asynchronously schedules the no-argument callback and returns a task with idempotent `cancel()` and optional `unref()`. An optional `defer(callback)` is part of the scheduler contract but is not required for slicing. Use `systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler` for host scheduling.
parameters: items: readonly T[]
options: IFrameBudgetOptions
symbols.returns: AsyncGenerator<readonly T[], void, undefined>

declaredConfiguration.name: targetMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Target duration per slice. Defaults to 8 ms, leaving about half a 16.7 ms frame at 60 fps for rendering and other work.

declaredConfiguration.name: minItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Minimum slice size, default 64; must be a positive safe integer.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Maximum slice size, default 250000; must be a positive safe integer at least minItems.

declaredConfiguration.name: initialItems
declaredConfiguration.description: Initial size, default 2048; a positive safe integer clamped to the configured min/max bounds.

declaredConfiguration.name: yieldTo
declaredConfiguration.description: Yield mechanism. Defaults to `scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)`. Can use `scheduler.yield()` for finer scheduling or requestIdleCallback for a more conservative yield. A custom callback owns its own cancellation and settlement; it cannot forcibly interrupt consumer work.

declaredConfiguration.name: signal
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional cooperative cancellation signal, default undefined; checked between slice admissions.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Required runtime-neutral scheduler. Core has no default timer and never directly accesses host `setTimeout`, `performance`, or `Date.now`.

blocks.text: SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 serialization，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。
TAG_MISSING：无标签输入缺少显式 untagged 读取器。
TAG_UNKNOWN：合法标签没有对应的登记版本。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (foundation.utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

sections.content:
chunk: Wire chunk returned by registry encoding or read from a carrier.
decoder: Required ITextDecoder, commonly a new host TextDecoder; used only for byte chunks.
Existing text or decoded bytes. Value chunks throw TypeError with INVALID_CHUNK; decoder failures receive `DECODE_FAILED` while retaining native identity where possible; wrappers keep the original on `cause`.

symbols.name: createSerializeRegistry
symbols.purpose: Creates a registry owning a nonempty plugin set and parser cleanup. The first plugin selects default writes and reads; types and methods are captured at construction and duplicate types reject. Chunks carry only kind and payload, so older formats must be selected using their separately stored `type`. The migration case uses JSON parser options `replacer` and `reviver`: both receive the current property key (including an empty root key) and value, synchronously return its replacement, and default to `undefined`. The old reader maps numeric theme 0 to light through its reviver; `space` defaults to undefined (compact output), and `decoder` defaults to a host TextDecoder when bytes are decoded. Returning undefined from the replacer omits an object property. These plugin options are separate from registry options below.
symbols.core:
plugins: Required nonempty ordered `ISerializePlugin` array. Every descriptor requires unique `type` matching `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i` and `parser`. A parser requires diagnostic `name`, callable `encode(value, context)` and `decode(chunk, context)`; optional zero-argument `dispose()` defaults to absent. Context has required `signal` and string `context`. Encoding returns a chunk, Promise of one, or sync/async iterable of chunks; decoding returns a value or Promise. Chunk kinds are `["text", string]`, `["bytes", Uint8Array]` and `["value", unknown]`. There are no defaults for required fields. Shared parser objects are disposed once. The first type selects default writes and reads; persist the type separately when formats coexist.
ISerializeRegistry with close and promise-idempotent dispose. Invalid lists or capabilities throw INVALID_OPTION; missing host encoding capabilities throw ENV_UNSUPPORTED. Construction validates before taking parser ownership.
scheduler: Fixed `IScheduler` for disposal deadlines; provide it from `@migaia/utils/scheduler` or a compatible monotonic clock implementation.
`systemScheduler` from `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
encoder: Fixed `ITextEncoder` used to merge mixed text and byte parser output; its encode method retains the original receiver.
A host `TextEncoder`; construction throws `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` when unavailable.
decoder: Fixed `ITextDecoder` capability captured and validated at construction; JSON plugin byte decoding has its own decoder option.
A host `TextDecoder`; construction throws `ENV_UNSUPPORTED` when unavailable.
cleanup: Controls parser-disposer failure handling: throw retains cleanup failures in disposal rejection; report sends one diagnostic and preserves the primary outcome.
`{ policy: "throw" }`, so unhandled parser cleanup failures reject disposal.
Choose throw, the default, when callers should catch parser-disposal failures. Choose report with a required report callback when the application owns a separate cleanup error sink. Both policies keep an earlier primary failure intact.
cleanup.policy: Chooses the cleanup error boundary; report requires cleanup.report and never changes an existing primary failure.
Use throw to reject disposal after parser cleanup fails. Use report only with cleanup.report to observe the failure without making it the disposal rejection. Omission of the cleanup object selects throw.
cleanup.report: Synchronous callback used only by report policy. Receives `d: ISerializeCleanupError` once after cleanup failure, returns nothing; thrown reporter failures are contained.
cleanup.report.d: Cleanup diagnostic created by the registry with package source and original cleanup error.
No return value is used; throwing does not change the disposal result.
Provide it when cleanup.policy is report. It receives the registry cleanup diagnostic once and returns void; its own throw is contained. It is unused with throw policy and mandatory with report policy.
onDrainTimeout: Synchronous observer receiving `d: ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic` when draining reaches its deadline. Returns nothing; thrown observer failures are contained.
onDrainTimeout.d: Registry-created diagnostic with deadline and current pending count.
No return value is used; parser cleanup proceeds even if the observer throws.
A fixed no-op observer; deadline behavior remains unchanged.
Use it to record pending work when disposal reaches its deadline. It does not cancel an uncooperative parser or prevent cleanup. Without it the deadline still works, but no application observer receives the diagnostic.
report: Callback receiving secondary iterator-cleanup and detached late failures immediately, including after cancellation but before disposal completes; detached `ABORTED` remains observable. No return value changes the operation.
report.error: Failure observed at the registry boundary after a primary result or cleanup boundary. Parser failures may be SerializeCodecError values retaining the original failure on cause.
No return value is used and the primary operation outcome is unchanged.
A fixed no-op reporter; supply a callback when late failure visibility is required.
Use it for failures that arrive after cancellation or an iterator cleanup boundary. Return void; reporting does not replace the operation result. Without it the fixed no-op reporter drops these diagnostics.
parameters: plugins: readonly ISerializePlugin[]
options: ISerializeRegistryOptions (optional)
symbols.returns: ISerializeRegistry

declaredConfiguration.name: onDrainTimeout
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional drain-timeout observer, default no-op; synchronous observer failure does not prevent cleanup.

declaredConfiguration.name: report
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional reporter for secondary or late registry failures. Defaults to a fixed static no-op. Reports iterator `return()` failures during active draining through `drainAsyncIterable`. Also reports late rejections from detached work after the deadline and cleanup through `track`. Late work does not rejoin the registry lifecycle. Neither report changes the primary rejection or terminal state.

symbols.name: ITaggedCodec
symbols.purpose: Frozen synchronous routing codec with id tagged and version 1. encode adds the first writer tag; decode routes by the exact registered revision, retaining inner failure identity or cause.
symbols.core:
id: Stable router identity tagged, independent of the inner writer id.
version: Stable framing revision 1; inner codec revisions remain in their own tags.
encodedType: Declares the runtime representation produced by encoding so a transport can admit the correct payload shape.
Identity representation preserves any input without changing object identity.
Text representation emitted by the JSON format codec.
Byte representation emitted by CBOR, MessagePack and Protobuf codecs.
encode: Synchronously converts the supplied application value to the codec representation; built-in format failures carry package codes and original causes.
encode.value: Application value admitted by this codec; portable formats accept `ICodecValue`, while Protobuf accepts its generated message shape.
The encoded `TEncoded` value; identity returns the input itself, while format codecs return text or bytes.
decode: Synchronously restores the application value from this codec representation; invalid portable data or malformed format data throws.
decode.value: Encoded value returned by the matching codec encode operation, or received from a carrier using that format and version.
The decoded `TValue`; identity returns the same object, portable formats validate the result and Protobuf returns its message shape.
symbols.advanced: Deploy a new writer without losing readers for earlier saved revisions.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this type.

blocks.text: `StorageContractError` 保持 `source: 'storage.contract'`、公开 code、原 `cause`、原 stack 与扩展 details。未改名或新增错误码。`INVALID_ARGUMENT` 表示输入结构问题，`INVALID_KEY` 表示 typed-key 域问题，`UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` 表示缺少已请求能力；执行拥有者继续使用本包既有生命周期、并发、查询和迁移码。
错误实例保留既有冻结行为，cause 对象不会随之冻结。归档迁移的进度错误通过既有 `onArchiveRunError` 通道报告，不修改已冻结错误实例。codec 不承诺冻结或复制：纯 `assertCodec` 只校验；host `snapshotCodec` 校验后返回同一实例，使 `#private` 方法保持 receiver。
普通 store/options/query 与输入快照不作为冻结协议。需要跨排队、native await 或公开返回值边界隔离可变 Date、bytes、数组、RDF term 时，由相应 host 作者入口说明并执行必要复制。公开锁诊断的键必须与仍活动的原 lease 分离。

capabilities: Backend-supplied `IStorageCapabilities` describing callable channels and their limits; admission snapshots these facts once.

set: Writes one string value through the supplied backend’s commit path and selected existing-key policy.
set.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.

sourceReason: Optional reason why this native source or index was selected, captured without I/O.
sourceCandidates: Detached readonly index/reason candidates explaining alternatives considered by the original source author.
pushed: Ordered operations executed by the native source before returning candidate rows.
client: Ordered client remainder with reasons.
fullScan: Whether the declared native plan must visit the complete source candidate domain.
source: Captured native source label.
index: Optional native index identity declared by the source; it is not a portable index manager.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
all: Collect every row left by the query plan and await original cursor cleanup.
all.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An array in final query order; source, mapping and cleanup failures reject the promise.
first: Read at most the first matching row, then close the original cursor early.
first.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The first final row, or undefined when the query has no results.
maybe: Read the first matching row through the canonical tagged Maybe result.
maybe.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A { some: true, value } result or { some: false }; undefined values are not confused with absence.
firstOrThrow: Read the first row and reject an empty result instead of returning an optional value.
firstOrThrow.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The first row; an empty query rejects with QUERY_EMPTY_RESULT after original cursor cleanup.
pluck: Collect one typed field from each final result while retaining query order.
pluck.field: An own result-field name selected by the caller from the current row type.
pluck.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An array of the selected field values in the same order as all().
exists: Determine whether any row survives the plan, stopping the original reader early when possible.
exists.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
True for at least one final row, otherwise false; declared native reduction may answer directly.
count: Count final query rows, using a declared native scalar reduction when the complete plan permits it.
count.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The number of rows after filtering, bounds, distinct and projection semantics.
each: Visit final rows sequentially and await each callback before advancing the original cursor.
each.fn: Caller callback receiving the current row and zero-based result index; a returned promise is awaited.
each.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The number of visited rows; a callback failure rejects after original cleanup.
chunk: Deliver bounded batches of final rows in order, awaiting the consumer before reading the next batch.
chunk.size: Caller-selected positive safe integer bounding the number of rows per callback.
chunk.fn: Caller callback receiving a readonly batch; the final batch may be smaller and returned promises are awaited.
chunk.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The total number of rows delivered across all completed batches.
stream: Expose the shared query reader as a storage iterator with original cancellation and cleanup ownership.
stream.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An IStorageIterator over final rows; finish iteration or await dispose() when stopping early.
explain: Inspect captured native and client plan steps without opening a backend cursor or performing I/O.
An IQueryPlan with pushed/client steps, source identity and conservative fullScan information.
where: Append an object condition, typed path condition or client predicate without executing the query.
where.condition: Caller-authored IWhere object over the filter row type; the planner captures canonical field conditions.
where.path: Caller-selected typed object path in the filter row; vector queries address payload fields.
where.operator: A field-compatible operator such as eq, gte, has or startsWith, selected for the path value type.
where.value: Caller operand whose type matches the chosen path and operator; collection operators use their declared element domain.
where.predicate: Caller predicate over the filter row; JavaScript predicates stay on the client and cannot be pushed down.
A new query branch retaining its family and installed Feature methods; the source branch is unchanged.
select: Apply one field projection or awaited mapper and transition to a read-only selected-result shape.
select.fields: One or more caller-selected field names from the current result row type.
select.mapper: Caller mapping function over a row; promised outputs are awaited and infer the selected result type.
A typed IQueryResult retaining installed Feature methods; select and later where refinements are absent.
distinct: Retain the first current-order row for each SameValueZero identity of a selected field.
distinct.field: Caller-selected field name from the current row type whose values determine duplicate identity.
A new query branch with distinct applied at this position in the ordered plan.
requirePushdown: Require a completely native plan; a terminal rejects client work before opening the source.
A new query branch carrying the native-only requirement without performing I/O.
min: min computes its numeric aggregate over final query rows, reusing a declared native scalar reduction when available.
min.field: Caller-selected numeric field of the current result type; optional numeric fields are accepted.
min.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A tagged Maybe containing the aggregate, or { some: false } when no numeric samples remain.
max: max computes its numeric aggregate over final query rows, reusing a declared native scalar reduction when available.
max.field: Caller-selected numeric field of the current result type; optional numeric fields are accepted.
max.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
sum: sum computes its numeric aggregate over final query rows, reusing a declared native scalar reduction when available.
sum.field: Caller-selected numeric field of the current result type; optional numeric fields are accepted.
sum.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The numeric sum; a query with no numeric samples returns 0.
avg: avg computes its numeric aggregate over final query rows, reusing a declared native scalar reduction when available.
avg.field: Caller-selected numeric field of the current result type; optional numeric fields are accepted.
avg.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
limit: Retain at most the caller-selected number of rows at this step of the query plan.
limit.count: A caller-selected nonnegative safe integer; zero produces an empty result without consuming rows.
A new branch retaining the current query family and its original Feature methods.
skip: Discard a nonnegative number of rows at this plan position; client offset work is explicitly O(n).
skip.count: Caller-selected nonnegative safe integer counting rows to discard before later plan steps.
A new branch with the ordered offset step; explain reports client work when not natively supported.
after: Resume strictly after an opaque keyset anchor produced by a compatible page operation.
after.cursor: The next value returned by page() for the same source and compatible conditions/order; never serialize or forge it.
A new query branch with the validated continuation anchor; incompatible cursors reject before reading.
page: Read a bounded page and one lookahead to determine whether a next cursor is needed.
page.size: Caller-selected positive safe integer specifying the maximum items in this page.
page.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
Readonly page metadata with items and optional next; reuse next only with the same compatible source, conditions and ordering.
delete: Delete distinct rows selected by the complete query inside the original backend write transaction.
delete.ctx: Caller operation context and optional original concurrency policy; transaction-bound queries accept only undefined and inherit their scope.
The number of distinct selected drafts accepted for deletion; a root call waits for native commit confirmation.
update: Apply one detached partial-record patch to distinct query-selected rows through the original transaction.
update.patch: Caller partial record whose fields replace corresponding fields of selected rows; the original backend codec validates values.
update.ctx: Caller operation context and optional original concurrency policy; transaction-bound queries accept only undefined and inherit their scope.
The number of distinct selected drafts accepted for update, after native root commit confirmation.
orderBy: Append a canonical storage-key selector ordering with deterministic primary-key tie breaking.
orderBy.selector: Caller function mapping a row to an IStorageKey; retain the canonical supported key domain.
orderBy.direction: Caller choice asc or desc; omitted defaults to ascending order for this selector.
A new selector-ordered branch preserving original Feature methods; comparator ordering is no longer available.
