symbols.whenToUse: Persist structured data while keeping the consumer independent of memory or browser database implementations.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Base store plus independent byte and structured-record channels, bounded iteration and backend-owned transactional callbacks.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IRecordStore from @migaia/storage-contract, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IRecordStore when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IRecordStore does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
backend: Implementation family declared by the backend; use capabilities rather than this label to choose optional operations.
Local browser key-value storage whose data normally survives browsing sessions.
Session-scoped browser key-value storage with the host’s session lifetime.
Cookie storage subject to document visibility, scope and small value limits.
Structured browser database backend; inspect capability flags before using record extensions.
In-process memory implementation whose data lifetime is owned by the concrete backend.
capabilities: Backend-supplied `IStorageCapabilities` describing callable channels and their limits; admission snapshots these facts once.
get: Reads a string value from the L0 channel of the supplied backend, using optional operation intent.
get.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
get.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A promise of the stored string, or null when the key is absent; backend failures reject.
set: Writes one string value through the supplied backend’s commit path and selected existing-key policy.
set.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
set.value: Application-produced string payload; encode non-string data before using this channel.
set.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IWriteOptions`: `signal` has boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID. These fields default to `undefined`. `conflictPolicy` is `conflict` (reject an existing key) or `replace` (allow replacement). Snapshot helpers retain an omitted policy as `undefined`; the writing backend applies its conflict default.
A `Promise<void>` settling with the backend write; a conflict or backend failure rejects.
remove: Removes the application-selected string entry from the supplied backend’s value channel.
remove.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
remove.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` indicating removal has settled; backend failures reject.
has: Checks whether one string-channel key currently exists in the backend.
has.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
has.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A promise of the existence flag for the selected key.
keys: Lists visible string-channel keys from the backend; visibility and opaque entries remain backend capabilities.
keys.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A promise of visible string keys; ordering is not fixed by this interface.
clearValues: Clears the backend’s string value channel while leaving distinct byte and record channels to their own clear operations.
clearValues.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` settling after value-channel clearing.
clearAll: Clears every data channel owned by the concrete store, including record and byte channels when present.
clearAll.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` for the concrete backend’s full clear operation.
dispose: Release accepted work and original native resources without acquiring any new close authority.
The original cached main cleanup Promise; native cleanup failure rejects with its original reachable cause.
sync: Optional synchronous string channel supplied only by synchronous backends; asynchronous stores expose undefined.
Absent when the backend does not provide synchronous access.
getBytes: Reads one binary value from the record-capable backend’s separate byte channel.
getBytes.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
getBytes.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A promise of `Uint8Array` bytes or null when absent.
setBytes: Writes bytes through the binary channel with explicit existing-key conflict handling.
setBytes.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
setBytes.value: Caller-supplied `Uint8Array` payload for the byte channel.
setBytes.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IWriteOptions`: `signal` has boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID. These fields default to `undefined`. `conflictPolicy` is `conflict` (reject an existing key) or `replace` (allow replacement). Snapshot helpers retain an omitted policy as `undefined`; the writing backend applies its conflict default.
A `Promise<void>` settling with the binary write.
removeBytes: Deletes only this key from the byte channel, leaving text values and records alone. A missing key succeeds without change, so repeated deletion is idempotent; asynchronous backends resolve after the deletion commits.
removeBytes.key: String key selected by the application for this channel; the same spelling identifies a later read or removal.
removeBytes.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` settling once the byte entry is gone or was already missing.
clearBytes: Clears the backend’s byte channel without selecting the separate record or text channels.
clearBytes.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` completing byte-channel clearing.
getRecord: Reads a structured record by the caller’s backend-neutral key, preserving the backend’s stored value type.
getRecord.key: Application-selected `IStorageKey`, or a key returned by the same backend’s record write; preserve its logical value across later operations.
getRecord.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A promise of the record or undefined when absent.
putRecord: Writes one structured record and returns its actual record key; key generation is owned by the backend.
putRecord.value: Application-created record matching the store’s TValue type.
putRecord.key: Optional application-selected key or a key from an earlier write; omission requests the backend’s key-selection behavior.
putRecord.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IWriteOptions`: `signal` has boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID. These fields default to `undefined`. `conflictPolicy` is `conflict` (reject an existing key) or `replace` (allow replacement). Snapshot helpers retain an omitted policy as `undefined`; the writing backend applies its conflict default.
A promise of the actual `IStorageKey`; use that result for later reads and deletion.
deleteRecord: Deletes one structured record using the same key domain as record reads and writes.
deleteRecord.key: Application-selected `IStorageKey`, or a key returned by the same backend’s record write; preserve its logical value across later operations.
deleteRecord.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` settling with the backend’s record deletion.
clearRecords: Clears structured records while keeping the backend’s independent string and byte channels separate.
clearRecords.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<void>` completing record-channel clearing.
metadata: Optional backend-owned maintenance channel with async get, set and delete by string key. Get resolves unknown or undefined; writes accept normal write options. Metadata lifetime belongs to the backend.
Omitted: this backend provides no public maintenance metadata channel.
iterateRecords: Streams key-record pairs within optional key bounds; the backend owns paging and iterator cleanup.
iterateRecords.range: Optional caller-authored `IKeyRange`; omitted means no explicit bounds.
iterateRecords.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An `IStorageIterator` of `[IStorageKey, TValue]`; stop consumption normally so backend cleanup can run.
transaction: Runs a caller-authored callback with an `ITransactionScope` supplied by the backend. The backend owns commit and rollback; callback rejection aborts that transaction path.
transaction.run: Synchronous, asynchronous or PromiseLike `(tx) => result` callback; tx comes from this transaction and must not escape its callback lifetime.
transaction.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
A `Promise<Awaited<TResult>>` for the callback result after the backend’s transaction outcome is known; failure rejects.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Use the original asynchronous resource-disposal protocol after accepted work drains.
The separately cached symbolic Promise reports cleanup failure and resolves, without replacing the main cleanup Promise.

sections.content: Bounded queries preserve payload, explicit vector state and Feature types. TGroupable alone grants scalar payload grouping; portable rerank returns a read-only stage whose grouping observes only retained topN hits.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import IVectorQuery from @migaia/storage-contract, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use IVectorQuery when its type contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when IVectorQuery does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained type example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.content:
all: Collect every row left by the query plan and await original cursor cleanup.
all.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An array in final query order; source, mapping and cleanup failures reject the promise.

Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The first final row, or undefined when the query has no results.
maybe: Read the first matching row through the canonical tagged Maybe result.

A { some: true, value } result or { some: false }; undefined values are not confused with absence.

Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The first row; an empty query rejects with QUERY_EMPTY_RESULT after original cursor cleanup.
pluck: Collect one typed field from each final result while retaining query order.
pluck.field: An own result-field name selected by the caller from the current row type.
pluck.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An array of the selected field values in the same order as all().
exists: Determine whether any row survives the plan, stopping the original reader early when possible.
exists.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
True for at least one final row, otherwise false; declared native reduction may answer directly.
count: Count final query rows, using a declared native scalar reduction when the complete plan permits it.
count.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The number of rows after filtering, bounds, distinct and projection semantics.
each: Visit final rows sequentially and await each callback before advancing the original cursor.
each.fn: Caller callback receiving the current row and zero-based result index; a returned promise is awaited.
each.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The number of visited rows; a callback failure rejects after original cleanup.
chunk: Deliver bounded batches of final rows in order, awaiting the consumer before reading the next batch.
chunk.size: Caller-selected positive safe integer bounding the number of rows per callback.
chunk.fn: Caller callback receiving a readonly batch; the final batch may be smaller and returned promises are awaited.
chunk.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
The total number of rows delivered across all completed batches.
stream: Expose the shared query reader as a storage iterator with original cancellation and cleanup ownership.
stream.ctx: Optional caller-authored `IOperationContext`: `signal` is an object with boolean `aborted` and callable `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`; `timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer including 0; `pageSize` is an integer from 1 to 4096. `orgId` is an optional canonical lowercase UUID, including the zero UUID. Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.
An IStorageIterator over final rows; finish iteration or await dispose() when stopping early.
explain: Inspect captured native and client plan steps without opening a backend cursor or performing I/O.
An IQueryPlan with pushed/client steps, source identity and conservative fullScan information.
where: Filter payload fields before ranking when natively translatable; client predicates filter original topK hits without refilling them.
where.condition: Caller-authored IWhere object over the filter row type; the planner captures canonical field conditions.
where.path: Caller-selected typed object path in the filter row; vector queries address payload fields.
where.operator: A field-compatible operator such as eq, gte, has or startsWith, selected for the path value type.
where.value: Caller operand whose type matches the chosen path and operator; collection operators use their declared element domain.
where.predicate: Caller predicate over the filter row; JavaScript predicates stay on the client and cannot be pushed down.
A new query branch retaining its family and installed Feature methods; the source branch is unchanged.
select: Apply one field projection or awaited mapper and transition to a read-only selected-result shape.
select.fields: One or more caller-selected field names from the current result row type.
select.mapper: Caller mapping function over a row; promised outputs are awaited and infer the selected result type.
A typed IQueryResult retaining installed Feature methods; select and later where refinements are absent.
distinct: Retain the first current-order row for each SameValueZero identity of a selected field.
distinct.field: Caller-selected field name from the current row type whose values determine duplicate identity.
A new query branch with distinct applied at this position in the ordered plan.
requirePushdown: Require a completely native plan; a terminal rejects client work before opening the source.
A new query branch carrying the native-only requirement without performing I/O.
topK: Declare or refine the native ranking bound, enabling read terminals only after this finite bound exists.
topK.count: Caller-selected positive safe integer limiting original native ranked hits before client post-processing.
A bounded vector query retaining payload inference, vector-return state and original Feature methods.
minScore: Declare the final finite score threshold passed to the original native ranking operation.
minScore.score: Caller-selected finite numeric threshold in the selected engine’s native score domain.
A new vector branch retaining its current bounded or pre-topK state.
withVector: Request vectors from the native engine and include vector in the inferred hit type.
A new vector branch whose hits carry readonly numeric vectors; original payload and Feature types remain intact.
rerank: Apply one portable client scorer to the actual bounded engine candidates, preserve their engine scores, retain stable descending rerankScore order and then truncate to topN.
rerank.scorer: Application scorer receiving readonly origin and hit wrappers plus the same caller AbortSignal. Return a dense array with one finite score per input hit; synchronous throws and rejected Promises retain their cause under RERANK_FAILED.
rerank.options: Optional IVectorRerankOptions from the application; topN defaults to the actual stage bound and must be a positive safe integer no greater than that bound.
A new immutable read-only query. Invalid bounds reject before I/O; malformed scores use RERANK_RESULT_INVALID, cancellation uses ABORTED. No delete, watch or requirePushdown method remains.
delete: Delete distinct rows selected by the complete query inside the original backend write transaction.
delete.ctx: Caller operation context and optional original concurrency policy; transaction-bound queries accept only undefined and inherit their scope.
The number of distinct selected drafts accepted for deletion; a root call waits for native commit confirmation.
groupBy: Group original topK hits by an own scalar payload field with an explicit per-group bound.
groupBy.field: Caller-selected own scalar payload field; only explicitly groupable sources expose this method.
groupBy.options: Required caller object containing perGroup, a positive safe integer bounding retained hits in each group; no default exists.
A selected result of { group, hits } rows retaining original ranking; grouping never refills hits beyond topK.

execute: Execute the native engine query and return its original ranked cursor without JavaScript rescoring.

symbols.name: RecordQueryMethod
symbols.purpose: Canonical built-in record query names; Feature methods with these names reject before source execution.
symbols.core:
where: Reserve declarative and client predicate filtering; Feature admission rejects this native name.
select: Reserve field selection or mapping; the actual query family decides its available projection form.
all: Reserve the terminal collecting current rows; callers await the original reader and cleanup.
first: Reserve the first-result terminal, returning undefined when the query has no match.
maybe: Reserve the explicit Maybe result carrying either an item or the empty branch.
firstOrThrow: Reserve required-first reading, which rejects an empty result with QUERY_EMPTY_RESULT.
pluck: Reserve the terminal extracting one selected field from each result row.
exists: Reserve existence reduction; the original reader may stop after the first accepted row.
count: Reserve row counting; this reserved word does not grant statistics to every query family.
each: Reserve sequential callback consumption through the original managed row iterator.
chunk: Reserve bounded chunk consumption without inventing a second row-source lifetime.
min: Reserve the numeric minimum reduction on the family that exposes statistics.
max: Reserve the numeric maximum reduction on the family that exposes statistics.
sum: Reserve numeric summation; actual source support controls native or client execution.
avg: Reserve numeric averaging through the original reduction owner.
explain: Reserve pure plan inspection without opening a native data source.
requirePushdown: Reserve strict native execution selection; unsupported client steps reject before I/O.
stream: Reserve the original storage iterator terminal with its existing cleanup ownership.
limit: Reserve a finite result bound that remains part of the immutable query descriptor.
orderByComparator: Reserve comparator ordering, executable only with the required finite result bound.
orderBy: Reserve selector ordering by canonical storage keys rather than arbitrary comparison sorting.
distinct: Reserve canonical field-value deduplication through the original query reader.
skip: Reserve offset skipping within the existing ordered query operation sequence.
after: Reserve keyset continuation from an opaque cursor bound to the original query source.
page: Reserve bounded keyset pages and their original continuation cursor.
delete: Reserve selected-row deletion through the actual backend mutation owner.
update: Reserve record updates through the original writer; this does not add vector update semantics.
watch: Reserve native invalidation watching only when the actual source exposes change-feed support.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.

symbols.name: StorageContractError
symbols.purpose: Constructs and freezes a native Error carrying storage-contract source, semantic code and optional backend/key context. The native stack and exact original cause remain reachable after construction.
symbols.core:
code: Required semantic value from `StorageContractErrorCode`: input, key, capability, resource, cancellation, envelope and migration failures. The producer chooses the code matching the failed contract.
details: Optional producer-authored details, default `{}`. Optional `backend` is the caller’s open diagnostic backend name; optional `key` is a string or `IStorageKey`; optional `cause` is any original thrown value. All fields default to `undefined`; key and cause are retained by reference without validation or copying.
message: Optional producer-selected diagnostic message; default is exactly `[storage-contract] ${code}` using the supplied semantic code.
A frozen `StorageContractError`; backend and key are direct fields, while cause uses the native Error chain.
fromVersion: Archive version immediately before the failed migration step or reset, retained on the original error when supplied.
toVersion: Target version of the failed migration step or reset, retaining the attempted upgrade boundary for diagnostics.
capability: Optional missing capability name retained before the original error is frozen; the name grants no authority.
keys: Detached read-only lock identities on LOCK_REJECTED and LOCK_TIMEOUT; physical timeout carries declared keys.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Constructs and freezes a native Error carrying storage-contract source, semantic code and optional backend/key context. The native stack and exact original cause remain reachable after construction.

code: Required semantic value from `StorageContractErrorCode`: input, key, capability, resource, cancellation, envelope and migration failures. The producer chooses the code matching the failed contract.

Optional `backend` is the caller’s open diagnostic backend name; optional `key` is a string or `IStorageKey`; optional `cause` is any original thrown value. All fields default to `undefined`; key and cause are retained by reference without validation or copying.
message: Optional producer-selected diagnostic message; default is exactly `[storage-contract] ${code}` using the supplied semantic code.
A frozen `StorageContractError`; backend and key are direct fields, while cause uses the native Error chain.
fromVersion: Archive version immediately before the failed migration step or reset, retained on the original error when supplied.
toVersion: Target version of the failed migration step or reset, retaining the attempted upgrade boundary for diagnostics.
capability: Optional missing capability name retained before the original error is frozen; the name grants no authority.

blocks.text: 既有错误实例仍冻结，cause 与 stack 保留。归档迁移通过原 `onArchiveRunError` 报告进度，不向错误实例添加状态。

`StorageContractError` 保持 `source: 'storage.contract'`、公开 code、原 `cause`、原 stack 与扩展 details。未改名或新增错误码。`INVALID_ARGUMENT` 表示输入结构问题，`INVALID_KEY` 表示 typed-key 域问题，`UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` 表示缺少已请求能力；执行拥有者继续使用本包既有生命周期、并发、查询和迁移码。
错误实例保留既有冻结行为，cause 对象不会随之冻结。归档迁移的进度错误通过既有 `onArchiveRunError` 通道报告，不修改已冻结错误实例。codec 不承诺冻结或复制：纯 `assertCodec` 只校验；host `snapshotCodec` 校验后返回同一实例，使 `#private` 方法保持 receiver。
普通 store/options/query 与输入快照不作为冻结协议。需要跨排队、native await 或公开返回值边界隔离可变 Date、bytes、数组、RDF term 时，由相应 host 作者入口说明并执行必要复制。公开锁诊断的键必须与仍活动的原 lease 分离。

pluck: Reserve the terminal extracting one selected field from each result row.

each: Reserve sequential callback consumption through the original managed row iterator.
chunk: Reserve bounded chunk consumption without inventing a second row-source lifetime.
min: Reserve the numeric minimum reduction on the family that exposes statistics.
max: Reserve the numeric maximum reduction on the family that exposes statistics.
sum: Reserve numeric summation; actual source support controls native or client execution.
avg: Reserve numeric averaging through the original reduction owner.
explain: Reserve pure plan inspection without opening a native data source.
requirePushdown: Reserve strict native execution selection; unsupported client steps reject before I/O.
stream: Reserve the original storage iterator terminal with its existing cleanup ownership.
limit: Reserve a finite result bound that remains part of the immutable query descriptor.

skip: Reserve offset skipping within the existing ordered query operation sequence.
after: Reserve keyset continuation from an opaque cursor bound to the original query source.
page: Reserve bounded keyset pages and their original continuation cursor.
delete: Reserve selected-row deletion through the actual backend mutation owner.

watch: Reserve native invalidation watching only when the actual source exposes change-feed support.
topK: Reserve the required finite vector ranking bound.
minScore: Reserve filtering by the native vector score threshold.
withVector: Reserve explicit vector inclusion in returned hits.
rerank: Reserve the portable client scorer available only after topK; its result is read-only and retains original engine scores.

skip: Reserve offset skipping within the existing ordered query operation sequence.

members.name: unavailable
members.description: A storage backend is unavailable because a private-mode probe fails or localStorage, IndexedDB, * or `document` is disabled or missing. * * The caller selects another installed backend or asks the user to enable storage access, rather * than retrying the same unavailable backend. Enforces the availability probe contract.

members.name: quotaExceeded
members.description: A write reaches the browser quota, such as `QuotaExceededError` or Firefox's * `NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED`. * * The caller removes unneeded data or selects IndexedDB. The failure persists until storage * conditions change.

members.name: valueTooLarge
members.description: A serialized cookie assignment exceeds the 4 KB limit. * * The caller shortens the value, name, or attributes, or stores the data in IndexedDB. The * library does not silently truncate the assignment.

members.name: serializeFailed
members.description: A native IndexedDB record or byte write fails while snapshotting its payload with * `structuredClone`, before asynchronous admission or physical mutation. * * The caller checks whether the value can be serialized. This is a data shape failure rather than * a backend failure.

members.name: deserializeFailed
members.description: A decoded IndexedDB cross-instance notification contains an invalid encoded key hint. * * The caller checks whether an external writer or newer version changes the stored data.

members.name: transactionFailed
members.description: A transaction or exclusive entity commit fails, including IndexedDB creation/commit, host * coordination, or a callback error outside the storage error family. * * The caller checks whether the transaction crosses the automatic commit boundary or its scope * escapes. Transient concurrency failures can be retried.

members.name: duplicateKey
members.description: A logical key conflicts across the value, bytes, and record channels without `conflictPolicy: * 'replace'`. * * The caller changes the key or explicitly selects `replace` to atomically remove the same key * from other channels.

members.name: versionUnsupported
members.description: The native IndexedDB schema version exceeds the version known to the current adapter. * * The caller upgrades the code or downgrades the data. Older code must not misread or overwrite * data from a newer version.

members.name: extensionFailed
members.description: An extension such as schema, codec, `namespaceCodec`, comparator, or diagnostic throws an * unclassified exception. * * The caller checks the extension implementation. `extensionStage` identifies the failed * extension, and `cause` retains the original exception.

members.name: writeFailed
members.description: A cookie is not visible after a write because the browser silently rejects it. * * The caller checks cookie attributes (`path`, `domain`, `SameSite`, and `secure`) and capacity. * Privacy policies may still remove the cookie asynchronously.

members.name: cookieScopeAmbiguous
members.description: Multiple visible cookie scopes share a name, so the target value's scope is ambiguous. * * The caller gives each scope a unique cookie name or fixes the scope at construction to avoid * ambiguity.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: Web adapter input or configuration validation fails. Covers cookie `SameSite`, `Secure`, * `Partitioned`, and scope settings; IndexedDB factory, store names, and `IDBKeyRange`; namespace * codecs; and browser backend options. * * Contract shape validation uses `storage-contract`'s `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. This code covers * adapter configuration only, as a local exception to unified argument validation. * * The caller corrects the configuration before retrying. The argument or configuration failure * persists until it changes.

members.name: indexOrphan
members.description: IndexedDB sidecar contains an index row whose authoritative record is absent. Callers should * repair or rebuild the index rather than treating the skipped row as a successful query result.

members.name: indexUniqueConflict
members.description: An indexed mutation would assign one logical unique key to two authoritative records. * Uniqueness is enforced inside the record/sidecar transaction; callers must choose a different * indexed value or remove the competing record before retrying.

members.name: indexQueryInvalidated
members.description: A native `iterateRecordIndex` page observed the global or scope mutation epoch change between * pages. Each page validates a short readonly transaction, then closes it before yielding; * callers must restart the query rather than trust a mixed snapshot.

members.name: liveQueryDisposed
members.description: A live-query consumer attempted to refresh after terminal disposal. Disposal cannot revive * subscriptions or owned reactive state; callers must create a new live query instead of reusing * the disposed handle.

members.name: indexBackfillStale
members.description: A backfill operation presented an expired owner, stale generation, or conflicting checkpoint. * The batch must be rejected and rolled back; callers should retry through a fresh repository * operation after the current handle is reacquired.

members.name: indexBackfillFailed
members.description: Secondary-index backfill failed and persisting its failed readiness also failed. The caller * inspects the native aggregate's original cause/errors before retrying; neither the primary * failure nor the persistence failure may be discarded.

members.name: liveQueryDisposeFailed
members.description: Live-query request or owned reactive cleanup collected one or more failures. Callers must treat * the query as terminal and inspect AggregateError.errors.

members.name: reactiveFeatureInvalid
members.description: A reactive feature descriptor, brand, provider seam, or adapter result is invalid. Callers must * correct the exact feature/backend pairing before retrying.

members.name: reactiveAdapterNotInstalled
members.description: The requested backend lacks its reactive adapter or is not installed. Callers must use an * installed adapter-bound backend ID, with no default fallback.

members.name: reactiveAdapterFailed
members.description: A reactive adapter event, poll, or authoritative read failed. Callers should observe the query * error state and allow a later invalidation or poll to recover.

members.name: reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed
members.description: Reactive adapter, poller, query, or service cleanup collected failures. Callers must treat the * adapter as terminal and inspect AggregateError.errors.

members.name: backendDisposeFailed
members.description: Direct backend quiescence, transport, connection, or channel cleanup collected failures. * Callers must treat the backend as terminal and inspect all errors.

members.name: indexedDbFeatureNotInstalled
members.description: An optional IDB operation lacks its explicit Feature; install the named assembly before use. * Enforces round3 explicit assembly.

symbols.name: StorageContractErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Frozen table of stable contract error codes. The source/code pair identifies input, key, capability, lifecycle and cancellation failures independently of a concrete backend implementation.
symbols.core:
rerankFailed: The application scorer threw or rejected; inspect the original error on cause without treating it as a native engine failure.
rerankResultInvalid: The scorer result is not a dense array containing one finite numeric score for every candidate; correct the scorer output.
queryEmptyResult: A required-first terminal exhausted its original query; choose first or maybe when absence is expected.
changeCursorExpired: A durable replay cursor was evicted; invalidate the full cache and subscribe from the current position.
queryNotPushable: Strict execution includes client steps; inspect explain before reading.
concurrencyPolicyFailed: A policy threw or returned an invalid decision; inspect its original cause.
lockTimeout: Logical admission budget or physical deadline expired after cleanup.
lockRejected: Policy rejected an actual acquisition conflict.
writeConflict: Policy rejected a commit conflict after completed rollback.
lockLost: A backend proved its own expired lease was replaced.
invalidArgument: A public descriptor, context, synchronous write option or callback shape is invalid; correct the input before retrying.
invalidKey: A record key violates its type, finiteness, array, depth, node or binary-size domain.
unsupported: The supplied backend lacks the required capability or callable methods; select a suitable implementation.
disposed: A caller uses a backend after its disposal; create or obtain a new store.
envelopeInvalid: Archive envelope shape is invalid.
versionUnsupported: Archive version is outside the supported plan range.
migrationGap: Migration target versions contain a gap or noncanonical key.
migrationFailed: A migration step failed; the original error remains on cause.
aborted: A signal or timeout cancels waiting; writes already in atomic commit report the actual commit outcome.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.name: invalidArgument
members.description: A public argument or descriptor fails contract shape validation. Applies to codec descriptors, * capability descriptors, key domains, transaction options, and operation contexts. * * Enforces runtime public argument and contract shape validation. Adapter-specific configuration * validation uses the web `INVALID_CONFIG` code instead. * * The caller corrects the argument before retrying. The failure persists until the argument * changes.

members.name: invalidKey
members.description: An `IStorageKey` violates the key domain through an invalid type, excessive depth, node count * or binary bytes, a cycle, or an empty array. * * Enforces contract key validation. * * The caller corrects the key rather than retrying the same invalid key.

members.name: unsupported
members.description: An operation requires a capability that the current backend does not provide. Examples include * failed `asRecordStore` narrowing and a structured codec on a text-only backend. * * Enforces contract capability narrowing. * * The caller checks `capabilities` or `isRecordStore`, or selects a backend with the required * capability. The operation does not silently fall back.

members.name: disposed
members.description: A storage operation runs after the store is disposed, violating the lifecycle contract. * * Enforces contract lifecycle semantics. * * The caller creates a new store instead of reusing the closed instance.

members.name: aborted
members.description: `IOperationContext.signal` cancels an operation or `timeoutMs` expires. * * Enforces contract cancellation semantics. * * The caller handles the result as cancellation. A write that has entered atomic commit reports * the actual commit result rather than claiming rollback.

members.name: queryNotPushable
members.description: A strict query contains client-only steps; inspect its plan or remove strictness before * reading.

members.name: queryEmptyResult
members.description: FirstOrThrow exhausted the query; use first or maybe when absence is expected.

members.name: rerankFailed
members.description: A bounded vector scorer threw or rejected; inspect its unchanged original cause.

members.name: rerankResultInvalid
members.description: A scorer must return one finite numeric score per actual hit; correct its result.

members.name: changeCursorExpired
members.description: A durable replay cursor was evicted; invalidate the full cache and subscribe from now.

members.name: concurrencyPolicyFailed
members.description: A genuine policy threw or returned an invalid/inapplicable decision; correct the policy.

members.name: lockTimeout
members.description: A logical admission or physical operation deadline expired; resources have finished cleanup.

members.name: lockRejected
members.description: A real acquisition conflict was rejected by policy; choose a different key or retry later.

members.name: writeConflict
members.description: A completed rollback reported a write conflict that policy declined to retry; reload data.

members.name: lockLost
members.description: A backend confirmed another attempt replaced its expired lock; retry with a fresh attempt.

members.name: envelopeInvalid
members.description: Saved data is not an own-property version/state envelope; correct the archive or writer.

members.name: versionUnsupported
members.description: The archive is newer than this code or older than its migration range; update the plan.

members.name: migrationGap
members.description: Migration target keys contain a gap, alias, or out-of-range version; correct the steps.

members.name: migrationFailed
members.description: A migration step failed or returned a thenable to the sync entry; inspect the original cause.

sections.content:
rerankFailed: The application scorer threw or rejected; inspect the original error on cause without treating it as a native engine failure.
rerankResultInvalid: The scorer result is not a dense array containing one finite numeric score for every candidate; correct the scorer output.
queryEmptyResult: A required-first terminal exhausted its original query; choose first or maybe when absence is expected.
changeCursorExpired: A durable replay cursor was evicted; invalidate the full cache and subscribe from the current position.
queryNotPushable: Strict execution includes client steps; inspect explain before reading.
concurrencyPolicyFailed: A policy threw or returned an invalid decision; inspect its original cause.
lockTimeout: Logical admission budget or physical deadline expired after cleanup.
lockRejected: Policy rejected an actual acquisition conflict.
writeConflict: Policy rejected a commit conflict after completed rollback.
lockLost: A backend proved its own expired lease was replaced.
invalidArgument: A public descriptor, context, synchronous write option or callback shape is invalid; correct the input before retrying.
invalidKey: A record key violates its type, finiteness, array, depth, node or binary-size domain.
unsupported: The supplied backend lacks the required capability or callable methods; select a suitable implementation.
disposed: A caller uses a backend after its disposal; create or obtain a new store.
envelopeInvalid: Archive envelope shape is invalid.
versionUnsupported: Archive version is outside the supported plan range.
migrationGap: Migration target versions contain a gap or noncanonical key.
migrationFailed: A migration step failed; the original error remains on cause.
aborted: A signal or timeout cancels waiting; writes already in atomic commit report the actual commit outcome.

members.name: journalNotAssembled
members.description: Journal configuration requires the explicit /journal plugin before backend installation.

members.name: changeControllerNotAssembled
members.description: Notification construction requires an explicit controller factory or backend Feature.

members.name: changeIteratorNotAssembled
members.description: Change-feed calls require the explicit iterator Feature before creating an iterator.

members.name: backendIdInvalid
members.description: A backend definition contains an invalid identifier. Callers must correct the bounded backend * ID before retrying installation.

members.name: backendDuplicate
members.description: A backend ID is already present in the host install batch or registry. Callers must use a * distinct ID or wait for the existing batch before retrying.

members.name: backendNotInstalled
members.description: A lookup requested a valid backend ID that has not been installed. Callers must install that * exact backend or select an installed ID.

members.name: backendPluginInvalid
members.description: A backend plugin or store failed its runtime contract check. Callers must repair the plugin * definition rather than relying on an unvalidated store.

members.name: backendInstallFailed
members.description: Backend creation, preparation, or PluginHost installation failed. Callers may retry after * fixing the cause, while the failed batch remains unpublished.

members.name: backendInUse
members.description: `host.unUse(id)` targeted a backend that another installed plugin still borrows through * `getPublishedBackend`, such as a cache tier or an archive source. Removing it would leave the * borrower with a closed store; callers must `unUse` the borrower first.

members.name: storageHostDisposed
members.description: A host or its public operation was used after sealing or terminal disposal. Callers must create * a new host instead of reviving this one.

members.name: storageHostDisposeFailed
members.description: Host cleanup collected failures or a controlled backend finalizer rejected without a semantic * identity. Callers inspect the original cleanup cause and treat that resource as terminal.

members.name: orgDeleteFailed
members.description: Some organization targets failed deletion after all targets were attempted; inspect errors and * retry.

members.name: backendKindMismatch
members.description: A backend token does not match the installed store or selected Feature.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: Schema or codec configuration is malformed; repair its descriptor before retrying.

members.name: entityFeatureRequired
members.description: An entity optional operation or declaration lacks its explicit subpath Feature; install the * named unit before retrying.

members.name: validationFailed
members.description: A schema rejects a value or returns invalid output; inspect the original validation cause.

members.name: serializeFailed
members.description: Encoding rejects the value before backend I/O; inspect the codec failure on cause.

members.name: deserializeFailed
members.description: Decoding rejects a stored representation; retain the original data and inspect cause.

members.name: duplicateKey
members.description: A different channel already owns this logical key; select replace to remove that owner.

members.name: indexUniqueConflict
members.description: A projected unique index key belongs to a different record; repair the proposed commit.

members.name: indexBackfillFailed
members.description: Backfill and persisting its failed readiness both failed; inspect every original cause.

members.name: migrationFailed
members.description: An entity migration step failed; retry only after correcting the original application cause.

members.name: versionUnsupported
members.description: Stored entity data is newer than this definition; use a definition that understands it.

members.name: transactionFailed
members.description: A native memory transaction failed; inspect its original cause before retrying.

members.name: journalRecordInvalid
members.description: Private journal bytes are malformed; stop opening this journal and retain its original bytes.

members.name: journalRecoveryFailed
members.description: Recovery or a journal commit is uncertain; close this handle and reopen from its durable head.

members.name: undoConflict
members.description: Current value or full revision differs from the stored final image; no restore was written.

members.name: undoNotFound
members.description: The selected target has no committed images for this txId; inspect the target and log.

members.name: extensionFailed
members.description: A user extension failed; inspect its original cause and operation context before retrying.

configuration.name: report
configuration.description: 观察事件只通过 `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/probe` 的 `storageProbe(handlers)` 订阅，宿主没有 `hooks` 选项，也没有 `host.hooks`。probe 放进 `createStorageHost` 的 plugins 时，从这一批的第一个安装事件起就能收到；安装后用 `host.extensions.observe(name, handler)` 追加监听，返回值是退订函数。在非默认组织的视图上调用时只收到该组织的事件。一个宿主只装一个 probe；监听器失败交给 `report`，不改变存储结果。

symbols.name: IStorageHookMap
symbols.purpose: The single augmentable event map shared by host construction, stage adapters and hooks.on; observers cannot veto storage.
symbols.core:
onEvict: Committed native eviction count for one channel; emitted after actual commit.
beforeHostInstall: Original initial or later install batch is about to run.
afterHostInstall: The original plugin tuple committed and became published.
onHostInstallError: The original install batch failed; payload contains its semantic failure code.
beforeBackendPluginInstall: Observe exact backend identity before its original plugin installation.
afterBackendPluginInstall: Original backend plugin preparation completed successfully.
onBackendPluginInstallError: Original backend plugin installation failed with a normalized code.
beforeHostClose: Original close begins with the current registered backend count.
afterHostClose: Original host cleanup finished; the lifecycle remains terminal.
onHostCloseError: Original host cleanup collected failures; observer only reports its code.
beforeEnvelopeCheck: Known target version before the original archive validation.
afterEnvelopeCheck: Archive validation succeeded and the stored version is now known.
onVersionRejected: The original archive version check rejected the supplied data.
beforeMigrationStep: Original ordered migration step is about to receive its input.
afterMigrationStep: Original migration step completed successfully.
afterMigrate: Original migration plan or reset completed with its actual elapsed time.
beforeEncode: Original codec is about to encode the proposed value.
afterEncode: Original codec encoding completed successfully.
onEncodeError: Original codec encoding failed with its normalized semantic code.
beforeDecode: Original codec is about to decode persisted input.
afterDecode: Original codec decoding completed successfully.
onDecodeError: Original codec decoding failed with its normalized code.
beforeQuery: Original query plan has been prepared before its native cursor opens.
afterQuery: Original query completed with actual result and execution counts.
onQueryError: Original query failed; observation reports its semantic code.
beforeTransaction: Before the original native transaction is created.
onTransactionStart: Original native transaction has been registered with its authentic id.
beforeTxOperation: Before one already-admitted authentic transaction operation.
afterTxOperation: After one original transaction operation settles.
beforeCommit: Original final-check boundary immediately before native commit.
afterCommit: Original native owner confirmed commit and actual changed-key count.
afterRollback: Original native rollback completed with its primary failure retained.
onTransactionClose: Original native transaction resource reached its actual end.
beforePersistFlush: Before the original transactional persistence flush.
afterPersistFlush: Encoding and native requests completed; this alone is not a commit certificate.
beforeBackendCreate: Before original native backend construction acquires resources.
afterBackendCreate: Original backend construction returned its actual native object.
onBackendRejected: Original runtime backend admission rejected its candidate.
afterBackendInstall: Original backend and its selected capabilities were installed.
onBackendDisposeStart: Original backend cleanup started after admission was sealed.
afterBackendDispose: Original backend cleanup reached its terminal boundary.
beforeSql: Before the actual native SQL request; only statement bytes and parameter count are observed.
afterSql: After actual native SQL execution with elapsed time and affected rows.
onSqlError: Actual native SQL execution failed; only the normalized code is exposed.
beforeStorageOperation: Before the original public endpoint’s actual work.
afterStorageOperation: The original endpoint settled successfully with actual count and elapsed time.
onStorageOperationError: Original endpoint failed and retained its primary failure.
onStorageIterationClose: Original storage iterator closed with its actual consumed-row count.
beforeLockAcquire: Original policy is selected before canonical lock admission.
onLockAcquired: Original owner acquired the actual canonical locks for this attempt.
onLockConflict: Actual acquisition or commit conflict with its original holder facts.
onLockWait: Original attempt waited on the existing admission owner.
onConcurrencyDecision: Original policy returned its authentic next decision.
onRetry: Original loop will retry after its declared delay and classified reason.
onLockReleased: Original owner released this attempt’s actual keys.
onLockLost: Native owner proved the original lease was replaced.
beforeLockInspect: Before the original readonly lock inspection.
afterLockInspect: Original lock inspection returned its actual count.
onLockInspectError: Original lock inspection failed with its coded error.
beforeLogOpen: Original logger store or durable resource is about to open.
afterLogOpen: Original durable log resource opened successfully.
onLogOpenError: Original durable log opening failed.
beforeLogOperation: Before the original durable log operation.
afterLogOperation: Original durable log operation completed.
onLogOperationError: Original durable log operation failed.
beforeLogClose: Original durable log resource begins cleanup.
afterLogClose: Original durable log cleanup finished.
onLogCloseError: Original durable log resource cleanup failed.
onAppend: Original logger append published committed records.
onWalPending: Original WAL owner observed its actual pending record.
onBinlogAppendError: External commit-only publication failed after an actual business commit.
beforeJournalRecover: Before matching-target original journal recovery.
afterJournalRecover: Original matching-target recovery completed with actual count and duration.
onJournalRecoverError: Original matching-target recovery failed.
beforeDetect: Before the original installed backend environment checks.
afterDetect: Original detection completed with actual check count and elapsed time.
onDetectError: Original environment detection failed with its semantic code.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
onEvict: Committed native eviction count for one channel; emitted after actual commit.
beforeHostInstall: Original initial or later install batch is about to run.
afterHostInstall: The original plugin tuple committed and became published.
onHostInstallError: The original install batch failed; payload contains its semantic failure code.
beforeBackendPluginInstall: Observe exact backend identity before its original plugin installation.
afterBackendPluginInstall: Original backend plugin preparation completed successfully.
onBackendPluginInstallError: Original backend plugin installation failed with a normalized code.
beforeHostClose: Original close begins with the current registered backend count.
afterHostClose: Original host cleanup finished; the lifecycle remains terminal.
onHostCloseError: Original host cleanup collected failures; observer only reports its code.
beforeEnvelopeCheck: Known target version before the original archive validation.
afterEnvelopeCheck: Archive validation succeeded and the stored version is now known.
onVersionRejected: The original archive version check rejected the supplied data.
beforeMigrationStep: Original ordered migration step is about to receive its input.
afterMigrationStep: Original migration step completed successfully.
afterMigrate: Original migration plan or reset completed with its actual elapsed time.
beforeEncode: Original codec is about to encode the proposed value.
afterEncode: Original codec encoding completed successfully.
onEncodeError: Original codec encoding failed with its normalized semantic code.
beforeDecode: Original codec is about to decode persisted input.
afterDecode: Original codec decoding completed successfully.
onDecodeError: Original codec decoding failed with its normalized code.
beforeQuery: Original query plan has been prepared before its native cursor opens.
afterQuery: Original query completed with actual result and execution counts.
onQueryError: Original query failed; observation reports its semantic code.
beforeTransaction: Before the original native transaction is created.
onTransactionStart: Original native transaction has been registered with its authentic id.
beforeTxOperation: Before one already-admitted authentic transaction operation.
afterTxOperation: After one original transaction operation settles.
beforeCommit: Original final-check boundary immediately before native commit.
afterCommit: Original native owner confirmed commit and actual changed-key count.
afterRollback: Original native rollback completed with its primary failure retained.
onTransactionClose: Original native transaction resource reached its actual end.
beforePersistFlush: Before the original transactional persistence flush.
afterPersistFlush: Encoding and native requests completed; this alone is not a commit certificate.
beforeBackendCreate: Before original native backend construction acquires resources.
afterBackendCreate: Original backend construction returned its actual native object.
onBackendRejected: Original runtime backend admission rejected its candidate.
afterBackendInstall: Original backend and its selected capabilities were installed.
onBackendDisposeStart: Original backend cleanup started after admission was sealed.
afterBackendDispose: Original backend cleanup reached its terminal boundary.
beforeSql: Before the actual native SQL request; only statement bytes and parameter count are observed.
afterSql: After actual native SQL execution with elapsed time and affected rows.
onSqlError: Actual native SQL execution failed; only the normalized code is exposed.
beforeStorageOperation: Before the original public endpoint’s actual work.
afterStorageOperation: The original endpoint settled successfully with actual count and elapsed time.
onStorageOperationError: Original endpoint failed and retained its primary failure.
onStorageIterationClose: Original storage iterator closed with its actual consumed-row count.
beforeLockAcquire: Original policy is selected before canonical lock admission.
onLockAcquired: Original owner acquired the actual canonical locks for this attempt.
onLockConflict: Actual acquisition or commit conflict with its original holder facts.
onLockWait: Original attempt waited on the existing admission owner.
onConcurrencyDecision: Original policy returned its authentic next decision.
onRetry: Original loop will retry after its declared delay and classified reason.
onLockReleased: Original owner released this attempt’s actual keys.
onLockLost: Native owner proved the original lease was replaced.
beforeLockInspect: Before the original readonly lock inspection.
afterLockInspect: Original lock inspection returned its actual count.
onLockInspectError: Original lock inspection failed with its coded error.
beforeLogOpen: Original logger store or durable resource is about to open.
afterLogOpen: Original durable log resource opened successfully.
onLogOpenError: Original durable log opening failed.
beforeLogOperation: Before the original durable log operation.
afterLogOperation: Original durable log operation completed.
onLogOperationError: Original durable log operation failed.
beforeLogClose: Original durable log resource begins cleanup.
afterLogClose: Original durable log cleanup finished.
onLogCloseError: Original durable log resource cleanup failed.
onAppend: Original logger append published committed records.
onWalPending: Original WAL owner observed its actual pending record.
onBinlogAppendError: External commit-only publication failed after an actual business commit.
beforeJournalRecover: Before matching-target original journal recovery.
afterJournalRecover: Original matching-target recovery completed with actual count and duration.
onJournalRecoverError: Original matching-target recovery failed.
beforeDetect: Before the original installed backend environment checks.
afterDetect: Original detection completed with actual check count and elapsed time.
onDetectError: Original environment detection failed with its semantic code.

symbols.core:
hooks: The original typed synchronous observer registry; failures only report.
extensions: Frozen installed plugin extensions; explicitly contextual methods use this fixed organization.
api: Per-backend selected Feature API, preserving original client and authentic transaction projection.
detect: Run only the registered original backend checks and await their cleanup.
Completes detection or rejects its original coded failure.
org: Return a new immutable business view under this root lifecycle, retaining exact plugin inference.
org.orgId: Caller-created canonical UUID, normally returned by createOrgId.
A fixed-org view with no installation, deletion or disposal authority.
dropOrg: Attempt every admitted backend target for this organization without closing existing business views.
dropOrg.orgId: Canonical UUID returned by createOrgId or an existing org view.
Completes all deletions; failures aggregate original errors and successful targets are not rolled back.
use: Atomically install one readonly tuple through the original PluginHost batch and rollback failed preparation.
use.plugins: Original handles returned by definePlugin or native backend plugin factories.
The same runtime host with the widened installed tuple; await detect after later native installation. Duplicate or overlapping batches reject.
backend: Look up the exact original admitted backend by its installed literal id.
backend.id: Literal id returned on the originally installed plugin handle.
Exact native store with selected Features; org views return a close-free fixed-org borrow.
hasBackend: Check original published membership without preparing or opening a backend.
hasBackend.id: Candidate id chosen by the caller from installed plugin ids.
True narrows the id to this host’s published registry keys.
backends: Return the current readonly membership snapshot with exact admitted backend values.
Readonly map; org views project each value into the same fixed organization.
dispose: Seal the original host, drain accepted work and release installed resources in their existing order.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Canonical host messages and parameterized text factories; applications branch on semantic codes rather than these diagnostic strings. The vectorMmr entry diagnoses invalid MMR lambda, topN or hit vectors from the independent scorer.

members.signature: use<const TPlugins extends readonly IStorageBackendPluginHandle[]>(...plugins: IRejectInstalledOrDuplicateIds<{ [N in P[number]['id']]: true; }, TPlugins>): Promise<IStorageHost<readonly [...P, ...TPlugins]>>;
members.description: Install one atomic native plugin batch; publication happens only after complete success. An overlapping call waits for the running `use`/`unUse` call; setup and timeout failures reject and roll back newly owned Stores.

members.name: unUse
members.description: Remove one installed plugin by id. Its store, extension methods and probe listeners are withdrawn first, then PluginHost releases its resources in reverse order. Rejects with BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED for an unknown id, BACKEND_IN_USE while another plugin borrows the backend, and INVALID_CONFIG for a configured journal plugin, whose recording is bound to the backends installed with it.

members.description: Execute original checks in installation order; failure retains no result from this pass.

Encode a string suitable for the string-value channel.
Encode bytes for a backend providing binary storage.
Encode structured values for a record-capable backend.

Each field defaults to `undefined`. Concrete backends execute cancellation, timeouts and paging.

decode: Decodes raw persisted data into the domain representation; malformed data rejects rather than becoming a successful fallback.
decode.raw: Raw value produced by the matching codec or read from its persisted format.

symbols.name: IEntityQueryNarrowedCore
symbols.signature:
export interface IEntityQueryNarrowedCore<
  T,
  X extends Readonly<Record<string, IStorageKey>> = Readonly<
    Record<never, IStorageKey>
  >,
  C extends IOperationContext | undefined = IOperationContext,
  A extends object = {},
>
  extends
    IEntityQueryCore<T, C, A>,
    IQueryConditions<T, IEntityQueryNarrowed<T, X, C, A>>,
    IEntityQueryControls<T, IEntityQueryNarrowed<T, X, C, A>> {
  orderBy(
    selector: (row: T) => IStorageKey,
    direction?: 'asc' | 'desc',
  ): IEntityQueryOrdered<T, C, A>;
  orderByComparator(compare: IRecordComparator<T>): IEntityQueryNeedsLimit<T, C, A>;
}

query: Create an immutable entity query over the connected store and materialization pipeline.
A precisely typed IEntityQuery; construction performs no backend I/O. Leading canonical conditions can select a declared path index; explicit index or range takes priority. Explain reports candidate reasons and conservatively retains fullScan:true because the original reader may fall back.
get: Read one entity value and migrate older envelopes in memory without implicit writeback.

symbols.name: memoryBackendPlugin
symbols.purpose: Define an isolated memory backend without acquiring data before installation. Optional namespace-local capacity captures positive maxEntries/maxBytes and lru (default) or lfu once. Linked policy nodes and the original deadline radix select committed victims; native transactions and root writes share the original owner, budget and victim locks. onEvict reports only per-channel counts after commit. Explicit maxBytes requires a real canonical encoding; unsupported records reject before mutation. Omitted capacity and maxEntries preserve the original structuredClone domain.
symbols.core:
options: Caller-selected native memory options; no backend opens until installation.
features: Explicit named Feature record from defineFeature, passed as the separate final argument.
A literal-id memory plugin retaining selected Features from the separate final argument memoryBackendPlugin(options, features). Native RDF uses six fixed canonical-term radix indexes, fixed-org graphs and the original transaction draft. Pattern matching is native; traversal and paging retain the shared query reader. Records use the shared records query core. Native blob keeps independent fixed-org object entries, conditional final commits, snapshot ranges and prefix pages, sharing original capacity and content resources without transaction projection.
id: Caller-selected bounded backend id used by the host registry and backend lookup.
memory; multiple installations need distinct literal ids.
namespace: Configured physical target prefix captured before installation. Slash-UUID suffixes reject; a bare UUID is allowed.

lru: least recently used.
Evict the least recently used live entry.

orgId: Canonical UUID from the original fixed call context; every next retains it.
channel: Original invalidation channel filter; all accepts every matching-org business channel.
Only text/value invalidations and broad events.

key: Optional text key from the original backend; broad invalidations still wake the consumer.

ctx: Optional caller cancellation/timeout context, captured once for this iterator resource.
Omitted: no caller signal or timer is added.
execute: Optional original per-next pipeline callback receiving advance and the captured context; return the complete advance Promise.
Omitted: advance the original native iterator directly.
Preserve the backend’s existing per-next execution boundary and accepted-work drain.

symbols.name: createBackendJournalNamespace
symbols.purpose: Reuse the original private namespace resource lifetime; backend owners retain data and actual native terminal decisions.
symbols.core:
options: Original assertLive/closingSignal/report, native facts, reservation, authenticated private transaction and native transaction entry.
Promise of IStorageJournalNamespace. run and terminal subscriptions retain accepted work until actual onEnd; transactionInfo is a pure authenticated fact. No raw client, installer or backend close rights.
assertLive: Synchronous original backend admission check; a throw prevents namespace construction or subsequent private work.
Normal return permits work; the original coded admission error is thrown synchronously.
Keep namespace access within the native backend admission boundary.
closingSignal: Original backend closure signal initiating namespace release while accepted native work drains.
report: Receives asynchronous cleanup failures from closure or symbolic disposal without replacing a primary result.
report.error: Original asynchronous cleanup cause supplied by the namespace resource owner.
The original diagnostic observer receives the failure; no native retry or replacement commit is started.
Preserve cleanup diagnostics separately from an original primary transaction failure.
backend: Original backend diagnostic kind attached to namespace admission and disposal errors.
undefined; errors omit a backend-specific diagnostic value.
nativeAtomic: Backend fact about all-or-nothing native transaction semantics; resource reservation alone cannot grant atomic rollback.
The original native transaction supplies all-or-nothing mutation and rollback.
The native owner does not guarantee all-or-nothing rollback; WAL, undo and atomic-store combinations stay unsupported.
Declare the existing native guarantee accurately before selecting atomic journal combinations.
indexExclusive: Explicit false means logger indexes must reload from the native transaction each operation; it does not weaken or strengthen nativeAtomic.
Omitted retains the exclusive namespace index contract of the original backend.
Restore the current logger index inside each original native transaction; never retain it across operations.
Use false when independent handles share the physical namespace and no lifetime-exclusive index can be retained.
reserve: Original physical owner invokes hold after reservation is acquired and awaits it until release; acquisition rejection rejects namespace creation.
reserve.hold: Async callback invoked once the original reservation is acquired; its settlement releases that reservation.
Original reservation Promise, rejecting on native acquisition or retained-work failure.
Connect the private namespace lifetime to the existing physical owner reservation.
authenticate: Synchronously validate the exact live original scope and return its existing transaction identity and private journal port; foreign scopes reject.
authenticate.scope: Exact backend-issued original live transaction scope, without capability lookup authority.
The original transaction info and journal port; foreign or expired scopes throw before private I/O.
Borrow journal work from an already admitted authentic native transaction.
transaction: Run the callback on the original newly admitted native transaction port and settle only after the native owner settles; never create a second commit owner.
transaction.work: Async callback receiving the original native journal transaction port; callback rejection stays with its native owner.
Callback value only after original native transaction settlement; unknown outcomes remain failures.
Start one original native transaction when no caller transaction scope is supplied.

Declare the existing native guarantee accurately before selecting atomic journal combinations.
indexExclusive: Explicit false means logger indexes must reload from the native transaction each operation; it does not weaken or strengthen nativeAtomic.

Borrow journal work from an already admitted authentic native transaction.
transaction: Run the callback on the original newly admitted native transaction port and settle only after the native owner settles; never create a second commit owner.
transaction.work: Async callback receiving the original native journal transaction port; callback rejection stays with its native owner.

symbols.name: IStorageMmrOptions
symbols.signature: export type IStorageMmrOptions = { readonly lambda: number; readonly topN?: number };
symbols.purpose: Factory options for the independent pure MMR scorer; the helper never retrieves vectors or truncates the query result itself.
symbols.core:
lambda: Finite relevance weight in [0,1]. One uses engine relevance alone; zero uses diversity after the first engine candidate, with ties retaining engine order.
topN: Positive safe integer bounding the greedy prefix, capped by the actual hit count. Remaining candidates receive ranks in engine order, so the returned score array always matches the input length.
Omitted: compute the greedy order for all hits. Actual truncation belongs only to rerank options.topN.
parameters: This type declaration has no parameters.

symbols.name: mmr
symbols.purpose: Create a pure deterministic scorer for vector rerank. Engine scores provide relevance and cosine similarity between explicitly retrieved hit vectors provides diversity. The host root does not re-export this independent entry; it performs no retrieval or network work.
symbols.core:
An IVectorReranker accepting withVector hits and returning one finite rank per original hit. Equal objectives retain engine order; zero directions contribute neutral similarity. Invalid options reject with INVALID_ARGUMENT before creating the scorer.
lambda: Finite relevance weight in [0,1]. One uses engine relevance alone; zero uses diversity after the first engine candidate, with ties retaining engine order.
topN: Positive safe integer bounding the greedy prefix, capped by the actual hit count. Remaining candidates receive ranks in engine order, so the returned score array always matches the input length.
Omitted: compute the greedy order for all hits. Actual truncation belongs only to rerank options.topN.
parameters: options: IStorageMmrOptions
symbols.returns: IVectorReranker<unknown, true>

blocks.text: 注入的 Storage 端口须实现 `length`、`getItem`、`setItem`、`removeItem`、`key`、`clear`。安装时探测可用性并保留已有数据。宿主拒绝访问报 `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`，配置非法报 `INVALID_CONFIG`，原生配额失败报 `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`。能力中的 5 MiB 为估计值，不保证浏览器实际配额。
默认命名空间 codec 使用 UTF-8 长度前缀，例如 `sw1:3:app:theme`，解码跳过损坏或其他空间的条目。自定义 codec 自行负责避免碰撞与格式迁移。`clearValues` 先快照匹配物理键再删除；原生失败可能留下部分清理结果，并保留失败的键。
