members.name: storeDisposed
members.description: Store fields, snapshots, or subscriptions are accessed after disposal. * * Use `createStore()` or `createAsyncStore()` to create a new instance.

members.name: resourceDisposed
members.description: A resource is read, captured, or retained while closing or disposed, or its factory returns a * disposed value. * * Stop using the resource. The `disposed` state is terminal.

members.name: captureInvalid
members.description: A resource capture token is invalid or has already been consumed by `commit` or `discard`. * * Check the token lifecycle. A token is valid only before consumption and can be committed once.

members.name: unknownVersion
members.description: A retain or capture request names an unknown or no longer visible resource version. * * Read the version from the current snapshot instead of caching version IDs across reloads.

members.name: identityRequired
members.description: A resource factory with `dispose` returns a primitive value, so reference identity cannot track * ownership. * * Return an object or function for a resource with explicit disposal to provide `$dispose` or * reference identity.

members.name: noAsyncInit
members.description: `storeReady()` receives an object with no initialization Promise registered by this package * instance. Both synchronous `createStore()` and `createAsyncStore()` register readiness. * * Pass the actual constructed Store instead of an unrelated or foreign object.

members.name: storeNotReady
members.description: Asynchronous state is accessed while store initialization is pending or has failed. * * Await `storeReady()` before accessing asynchronous fields. Treat rejection as initialization * failure instead of retrying reads.

members.name: initAndCleanupFailed
members.description: Store initialization and its subsequent cleanup both fail and cannot be attached to the primary * Error. A coded `AggregateError` preserves both failures; mutable primaries keep their own * identity and receive cleanup through cause instead. * * The initialization and cleanup errors remain reachable through `cause` or `errors`. Treat this * as initialization failure and inspect the cleanup failure.

members.name: fieldDisposeFailed
members.description: A late FieldBuilder disposer fails after initialization is abandoned or the Store is disposed. * The owning Runtime receives the original native error when possible; non-extensible or * non-Error failures remain reachable through the coded fallback's cause/errors.

members.name: initializationFailed
members.description: A FieldBuilder fails during initialization without an existing package error identity. Native * mutable errors keep their object and stack; fallback errors retain the original cause. Treat * creation as failed and inspect the original builder failure before retrying.

members.name: syncFieldRequired
members.description: An asynchronous `IFieldBuilder` is passed to the synchronous `createStore()` contract. * * Use `createAsyncStore()` for asynchronous field builders.

members.name: actionBatchBoundary
members.description: A diagnostic reports that writes after the first `await` in an asynchronous action are outside * its batch. * * This code is reported through `Runtime.reportError`, not thrown. Wrap subsequent writes in * `$batch()`.

members.name: envUnsupported
members.description: The host lacks `WeakRef` or `FinalizationRegistry` required by `ResourceCaptureRegistry`. * * Enable these capabilities in the host sandbox. This is a deployment issue.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Input or field validation fails for reserved API keys, `keepAliveMs`, a non-writable `$set` * target, or an unknown `$hydrate` field. * * Correct the field or value named in the error message.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StoreLightErrorCode from @migaia/store-light, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StoreLightErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StoreLightErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
storeDisposed: `STORE_DISPOSED`: the store was used after `$dispose()`; create a new store.
resourceDisposed: `RESOURCE_DISPOSED`: the resource is closing or disposed; stop using it.
captureInvalid: `CAPTURE_INVALID`: the capture token is invalid or already used.
unknownVersion: UNKNOWN_VERSION: the version is unknown or already evicted; retaining or capturing it cannot revive it. Read a current snapshot instead.
identityRequired: `IDENTITY_REQUIRED`: a resource with `dispose` returned a primitive value.
noAsyncInit: NO_ASYNC_INIT: storeReady received an object without readiness registered by this package instance. Both synchronous and asynchronous stores created here are registered.
storeNotReady: `STORE_NOT_READY`: async fields read before the store was ready; await `storeReady()`.
initAndCleanupFailed: INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED: initialization and cleanup both fail and cleanup cannot attach to the primary Error. Aggregate errors retain the original first; writable primary errors retain identity and receive cleanup through cause instead.
fieldDisposeFailed: FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED: a late field disposer throws or rejects after initialization is abandoned or the store closes. The Runtime reports the original native error or a coded fallback retaining it.
initializationFailed: INITIALIZATION_FAILED: an unclassified field initialization fails; native mutable errors retain identity and stack, while fallback errors retain the original cause. Already classified foreign errors retain their owner.
syncFieldRequired: `SYNC_FIELD_REQUIRED`: an async field builder was passed to `createStore`.
actionBatchBoundary: `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`: diagnostic; writes after `await` in an action are not batched.
envUnsupported: `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`: the host lacks `WeakRef` or `FinalizationRegistry`.
invalidOption: INVALID_OPTION: an option, reserved built-in API key, $set target or $hydrate field is invalid; correct the named input.

guidance.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 第 6 节。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'store.light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: 'store.light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

blocks.text: Store 构造失败：`shape` 里任意字段处理阶段抛错（比如某个 `FieldBuilder.create()` 抛错），整个构造过程回滚——原生节点同步分段释放、外部资源由 lifecycle scope 释放，内部的 `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` 全部清空，原始错误继续向外抛出（清理阶段自身失败时，会尽量把清理错误挂到原错误的 `cause` 上，不会替换原始错误）。

异步字段初始化失败：`readyList` 中任一 Promise reject，Store 立即被标记为 `disposed = true`，中止其余在途初始化（`initAbort.abort()`），并回收已经创建的资源；这个转变发生在 `ready` Promise 的 reject 路径里，因此哪怕调用方没有 `await storeReady()`，Store 内部状态也已经正确收敛，不会有"部分字段可用"的僵尸状态。

`$dispose()` 时机：字段读写方法在闭包里直接引用底层节点（`node.value`），不经过任何"Store 对象本身"的代理层；因此 `$dispose()` 唯一要做的事就是把 `disposed` 标志位翻转、释放原生节点段与已有 scope、清空内部 Map。所有已经拿到 Store 引用的调用方，后续用户字段读写与受守卫方法调用会看到 `[store] store is disposed`。

`StoreResource` 的持有者概念：一份值被判定为"没有持有者"（可以被回收）需要同时满足：没有 `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` 产生的活跃 lease，也没有任何未提交的 capture。直接 `captureVersion()` 不设 4 秒过期；只有 pending generation 成功后转换的 provisional capture 才有 4000ms 放弃窗口。`keepAliveMs` 超时只在"当前没有任何持有者"时才开始计算，一旦有新的持有者出现，倒计时会被取消。

symbols.name: bindStoreMiddleware
symbols.purpose: Binds state subscriptions and Runtime action traces from an existing Store into a new host. Pair with createMutationPolicy when strict writes are required, passing the exact same object to Store construction and this binding. Disposal detaches observers without disposing the Store.
symbols.core:
store: Existing IReactiveStore<S> from @migaia/store-light createStore; its runtime, plain snapshots, hydrate and subscriptions are reused.
The same canonical frozen managed IStoreMiddlewareBinding with original store reference, live revision and fluent returns retaining store/domain members. Partial subscription failure rolls back; secondary rollback failures produce CLEANUP_FAILED aggregate with original primary first.
execution: Optional execution budgets, each defaulting to 5000 ms: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
`createMutationPolicy('off')`; strict binding must explicitly share the Store policy.
actionPrefix: Application string prefix for forwarded Runtime action names; state subscriptions are not filtered by it.
`undefined`: no prefix filter; all action traces are forwarded.
clone: Synchronous callback receiving the Store plain record on initial capture, reads and state changes. Return a snapshot record; throw aborts that capture and no async result is awaited.
clone.state: Fresh plain record supplied by store.$plain().
Record snapshot; independence depends on this chosen clone implementation.
`state => ClonePolicy.diagnostic(state)`, retaining unsupported subtree references when necessary.
Set a synchronous clone to redact or choose snapshot copying. It runs at binding, reads, and state changes. Without it, diagnostic cloning may retain unsupported values by reference and does not redact.
parameters: store: IReactiveStore<S>
options: IStoreMiddlewareBindingOptions
symbols.returns: IStoreMiddlewareBinding<S>
examples:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { bindStoreMiddleware, loggerMiddleware } from '@migaia/store-middleware'

const events: string[] = []
const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const execution = { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } as const
const host = bindStoreMiddleware(store, { execution })
await host.use(loggerMiddleware((event) => events.push(event.type)))
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
console.log(events.join(','))

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

symbols.name: IStoreMiddlewareBinding
symbols.purpose: Canonical frozen managed handle returned by bindStoreMiddleware, carrying all host capabilities plus the original light Store reference. Live revision/getters and fluent return identity preserve every Store member. Releasing this binding leaves the Store alive.
symbols.core:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Always sync: store event host construction overrides any supplied pipeline mode.
revision: Live revision getter from the same canonical managed host; plugin commits update it without replacing the Store domain or fluent handle identity.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
runPipelineSync: Runs original synchronous stages from the same canonical lane. Any visible async stage throws ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY before effects. Available on sync/async owner handles or as a protected subclass entry; generator hosts keep runPipeline.
runPipelineSync.value: Input value.
runPipelineSync.done: Terminal returning TResult.
TResult | undefined; halted stages return undefined. Empty lanes preserve the exact terminal value.
runPipelineAsync: Runs async forms of the same stage registrations, including lifted sync stages. Waits for the real terminal Promise and onion cleanup; uses the existing host cancellation and leases.
runPipelineAsync.value: Input value.
runPipelineAsync.done: Terminal returning Promise<TResult>.
Promise<TResult | undefined>. A halted stage resolves undefined; an empty lane returns the original terminal Promise by identity.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.
runAction: Emits isolated start, runs fn inside mutation policy and Runtime batch, then emits isolated end or error. Synchronous business failures retain native identity or remain reachable through cause/errors under the policy callback contract; observer failures are reported.
runAction.name: Application-selected action label propagated to all three action phases.
runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.
Exact fn return or policy-classified synchronous failure; foreign Reactive/pipeline errors keep their package identity. Action duration covers synchronous execution only.
recordState: Emits an isolated state observation without changing Store state. Middleware failures are reported rather than reaching the business caller.
recordState.name: Application-selected state observation label.
recordState.previous: Previous snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.next: Next snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.metadata: Optional diagnostic record, absent by default and retained by reference.
No result after isolated observation; state application is a separate capability.
recordError: Emits one isolated diagnostic-error event. Reentrant calls while handling an error report directly to Runtime without starting another middleware pipeline.
recordError.phase: Caller diagnostic phase identifying the failed subsystem or operation.
recordError.error: Original diagnostic failure value retained by identity.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Canonical frozen managed handle returned by bindStoreMiddleware, carrying all host capabilities plus the original light Store reference. Live revision/getters and fluent return identity preserve every Store member. Releasing this binding leaves the Store alive.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
identity: Immutable host identity `{ name, id }`: `name` from the `identity` option, `id` unique per host; used in errors and diagnostics.
plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Always sync: store event host construction overrides any supplied pipeline mode.
revision: Live revision getter from the same canonical managed host; plugin commits update it without replacing the Store domain or fluent handle identity.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
runPipelineSync: Runs original synchronous stages from the same canonical lane. Any visible async stage throws ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY before effects. Available on sync/async owner handles or as a protected subclass entry; generator hosts keep runPipeline.
runPipelineSync.value: Input value.
runPipelineSync.done: Terminal returning TResult.
TResult | undefined; halted stages return undefined. Empty lanes preserve the exact terminal value.
runPipelineAsync: Runs async forms of the same stage registrations, including lifted sync stages. Waits for the real terminal Promise and onion cleanup; uses the existing host cancellation and leases.
runPipelineAsync.value: Input value.
runPipelineAsync.done: Terminal returning Promise<TResult>.
Promise<TResult | undefined>. A halted stage resolves undefined; an empty lane returns the original terminal Promise by identity.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.

runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

rows: Host options 或 DevTools adapter 形状/读取失败
stage 遗漏 next，向 Runtime 报告
immutable 数据不受支持或克隆失败
没有已有身份的同步 action、初始 binding clone 或 binding disposer 失败
支持的 Redux 状态命令 JSON 无效，报告并跳过
绑定设置失败且同步回滚也失败

blocks.text: `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 是码值联合，`STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE='store.middleware'` 只标识本包创建的错误；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已有 source/code 保持实际 owner。能附码的原生错误保留原实例、类型、message、stack，不可附码或非 Error 值经 cause/errors 保留。不要把记录状态、业务失败与诊断失败混成一个控制流。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: The object returned by createStoreMiddlewareHost for sending store events and managing their plugins. It combines store event methods with [Plugin Host’s IHostHandle](/en/docs/plugin-host/api/IHostHandle) methods for installing and removing plugins, changing configuration, and closing the host. The returned object is frozen, so you cannot add or replace its properties. Its event pipeline, the sequence of steps that handles each event, always runs synchronously.

symbols.core:
identity: Readable host name `{ name }`; a unique id is added by the runtime.
Omitted; identity.name defaults to DEFAULT and the runtime issues a unique id.
identity.name: Readable host name used in errors and diagnostics.
Omission uses DEFAULT as the name. The generated id combines that name with a sequence number, allowing diagnostics to distinguish host instances.
execution.mutationTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds setup/install/update; expiry aborts the operation and rolls back with MUTATION_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. false removes this deadline; removal hooks and disposers use disposeStepTimeoutMs.
execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: Optional nonnegative finite milliseconds or false; defaults to 5000. Bounds pipeline draining during removal, replacement and host disposal; false waits until no leases remain.
execution: Optional execution budgets, each defaulting to 5000 ms: mutationTimeoutMs bounds setup/install/update; pipelineDrainTimeoutMs bounds pipeline draining and is a shared managed-removal cleanup deadline. Ordinary removal steps use disposeStepTimeoutMs. false disables the corresponding deadline.
pipeline: External pipeline options are captured once, including a non-enumerable pipeline getter, and excluded from the remaining option spread; mode is overwritten with sync before host construction.
A sync pipeline is installed even when this option is omitted.
pipeline.mode: Always overwritten with sync by the Store host constructor.
sync, regardless of caller omission or another supplied mode.
Store middleware executes synchronously; async and generator stage registration is unavailable.
Store hosts always force sync. Setting async, generator, or async-generator does not change their mode; omitting pipeline still installs a sync pipeline. Use synchronous usePipeline stages.
diagnostic: Receives notable events that are not errors (`PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE`, `EXTENSION_NON_ENUMERABLE_IGNORED`, rollback failures, queue waits) as `(message, code?, error?)`. Its own failures never affect the host.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped.
onDiagnosticFailure: Receives the error when `diagnostic` itself throws or rejects.
Not set: the failure goes to `globalThis.reportError` when it exists.
Set it to observe a diagnostic callback that throws or rejects. Without it, the failure goes to globalThis.reportError when available; host operations keep their own result.
scheduler: Clock and timers for queue and disposal timeouts; inject a manual scheduler in tests.
The system scheduler.
queueAdmissionTimeoutMs: How long a change may wait in the FIFO queue. A number rejects waiting work with `MUTATION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT` (running work is not interrupted); `false` disables queue timers and diagnostics.
Not set: long waits are only reported through `diagnostic`, never rejected.
queueAdmissionDiagnosticMs: Wait time after which a queued change is reported through `diagnostic` (only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is not set); `false` disables it.
`1000` milliseconds.
disposeStepTimeoutMs: Maximum wait for one cleanup step (a stage disposer, a plugin `dispose`, a resource). A timed-out step is recorded as `DISPOSE_STEP_TIMEOUT` and cleanup continues; `false` waits forever.
`5000` milliseconds per step.
runtime: External IRuntime supplied at construction or obtained from the bound Store.
getState: Required synchronous zero-argument getter invoked when plugins or adapters need state. Return S; throws propagate through the invoking API.
Current S; getter failures propagate and snapshot independence follows the caller clone policy.
Supply this required reader for an application-owned state source. It runs when a plugin or adapter requests state; it does not clone automatically.
applyState: Optional synchronous callback receiving a replacement state from jump/reset. Return nothing; callback throws propagate through command delivery.
applyState.state: Replacement S supplied by a normalized jump/reset command or a domain caller.
No result; missing applyState throws DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY and caller failures propagate.
Absent; applying a DevTools state command throws DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.

symbols.purpose: Creates a logging plugin named store-logger. Install it on a host from createStoreMiddlewareHost with host.use; creating the plugin alone prints nothing. import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { bindStoreMiddleware, loggerMiddleware } from '@migaia/store-middleware'

const events: string[] = []
const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const execution = { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } as const
const host = bindStoreMiddleware(store, { execution })
await host.use(loggerMiddleware((event) => events.push(event.type)))
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
console.log(events.join(','))
await host.dispose()
store.count = 2

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

blocks.text: `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 是码值联合，`STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE='store.middleware'` 只标识本包创建的错误；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已有 source/code 保持实际 owner。能附码的原生错误保留原实例、类型、message、stack，不可附码或非 Error 值经 cause/errors 保留。不要把记录状态、业务失败与诊断失败混成一个控制流。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

rows: Host options 或 DevTools adapter 形状/读取失败
stage 遗漏 next，向 Runtime 报告
immutable 数据不受支持或克隆失败
没有已有身份的同步 action、初始 binding clone 或 binding disposer 失败
支持的 Redux 状态命令 JSON 无效，报告并跳过
绑定设置失败且同步回滚也失败

blocks.text: `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 是码值联合，`STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE='store.middleware'` 只标识本包创建的错误；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已有 source/code 保持实际 owner。能附码的原生错误保留原实例、类型、message、stack，不可附码或非 Error 值经 cause/errors 保留。不要把记录状态、业务失败与诊断失败混成一个控制流。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。

examples:
import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host/plugins/memory'
import { defaultJsonCodec } from '@migaia/store-persist'
import { persistCollection } from '@migaia/store-persist/indexed'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] as const })
const storage = host.backend('memory')
const cart = new ObservableMap<string, number>()
const first = persistCollection(cart, { key: 'cart', storage })
await first.ready
cart.set('book', 2)
await first.flush()
first.dispose()
cart.dispose()
const restored = new ObservableMap<string, number>([['stale', 99]])
const second = persistCollection(restored, { key: 'cart', storage })
await second.ready
console.log('恢复：', restored.get('book'), restored.has('stale'))
const saved = (await defaultJsonCodec.decode(await storage.get('cart'))) as { state: unknown }
console.log('映射：', saved.state instanceof Map)
second.dispose()
restored.dispose()

symbols.name: IPersistHandle
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned hydration and serialized-write lifecycle from persistUnit or an adapter; it does not dispose the source state or injected backend.
symbols.core:
status: IReactiveComputed selecting disposed first, then loading, then hydration/write error, otherwise ready. A write can be active while overall status remains ready.
error: Computed current hydration or write failure; simultaneous failures form AggregateError preserving both originals.
hydrated: Computed true only after a successful hydration attempt; disposal does not convert an incomplete hydration into success.
hydrationStatus: Readonly .value projection reporting loading, success or error for the latest hydration attempt.
hydrationError: Readonly .value containing the latest hydration failure; cleared when another hydration attempt starts.
writeStatus: Readonly .value reporting idle, writing, error or disposed independently of hydration status.
writeError: Readonly .value retaining the latest failed write or removal; successful writes clear it and a final disposal write may update it later.
ready: Original first-hydration-attempt Promise: resolves only on success and rejects on failure or disposal before completion with AbortError/ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE. Retries do not replace this Promise.
settled: Barrier derived from the initial ready Promise that resolves after either success or failure; it does not await future retries.
disposed: Live terminal-disposal getter on the original IPersistHandle; becomes true once dispose is called.
retryHydrate: Retries storage reading after hydration failure. An ongoing recovery prevents another read but does not make every concurrent invocation wait for it; await the invocation that starts recovery. Success reopens automatic writes.
Promise of recovery; rejects on another failure or post-disposal invocation. Initial ready and settled remain their original Promises.
flush: Without tx, drains and writes the current snapshot. With an enlisted authentic tx, captures and starts encoding at invocation, then writes through that operation view in call order. Only outer persistTransaction success means commit.
flush.tx: Optional active view from this handle's persistTransaction.
Promise of this encoding and request. Direct flush rejects during participation; memory does not roll back with storage.
clear: Cancels the debounce window and queues archive removal after earlier writes; it neither resets memory nor unsubscribes the source.
Promise resolving after removal; hydration/removal failures or disposal reject. A later source change can recreate the archive.
disposeAsync: Stops scheduling like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot. It does not wait for borrowed reads or dispose the source, storage or runtime.
Promise resolving after the write chain settles. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects afterwards; final-write failures remain available on writeError.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Shares one cleanup with disposeAsync while caching a distinct Promise that reports cleanup failure and resolves.
The same reporting Promise on repeated symbol calls.
dispose: Idempotently stops persistence subscriptions, cancels the debounce timer and aborts active adapter operations. A pending debounce window starts one unawaited final snapshot write. It does not clear business values or dispose the source state.
Nothing; scheduling is terminal. An adapter ignoring abort can still complete, and final-write failure remains in writeError.

members.name: status
members.description: Disposed first, then loading/error, otherwise ready; ready also permits an in-flight write.

members.name: error
members.description: Latest hydration/write error, combining both in an AggregateError when both are present.

members.name: hydrated
members.description: Whether the latest hydration attempt succeeded; disposal does not reset this result.

members.name: hydrationStatus
members.description: Loading/success/error for hydration; a retry starts a new loading phase.

members.name: hydrationError
members.description: Hydration failure retained until another attempt starts; undefined initially and on success.

members.name: writeStatus
members.description: Idle/writing/error/disposed for serialized writes and removals.

members.name: writeError
members.description: Latest write failure, cleared by successful active writes; final disposal writes may update it.

members.name: ready
members.description: Initial hydration attempt only; rejects on failure/cancellation and is not replaced by retry.

members.name: settled
members.description: Always resolves after the initial ready attempt settles, including failure or cancellation.

members.name: retryHydrate
members.description: Starts another read when hydration has failed, without starting duplicate recovery reads. Await the invocation that starts recovery before resuming explicit writes; concurrent calls need not share its wait. The original ready/settled promises retain their initial results.

members.name: flush
members.description: Cancels debounce, waits for initial hydration and an observed in-flight write, then requests a current snapshot write. Hydration/write failures reject; disposal is AbortError cancellation. Completion depends on the adapter settling even when it ignores cancellation. With an enlisted authentic transaction view, captures and starts encoding now, then writes through that view in call order. Only the outer persistTransaction success means commit.

members.name: clear
members.description: Cancels debounce and queues removal of the codec's archive channel after initial hydration and earlier writes. Does not reset live state or disable future writes; hydration/removal failures reject, and disposal rejects with `AbortError`. Direct operations reject during participation.

members.name: disposed
members.description: Terminal marker set synchronously by dispose, including while adapter work is still pending.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Idempotently stops scheduling and aborts active operations without awaiting them. A pending debounce or an admitted, unfinished write snapshots one final unawaited write; inspect writeError for failure. Unsubscribe failures can throw after the handle is already terminal; borrowed resources remain owned by their caller. During transaction participation, aborts that transaction without a final side write.

members.name: disposeAsync
members.description: Stops synchronously like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final snapshot write to settle, including adapters that ignore abort. Final-write failures remain on writeError; existing flush/clear promises retain their original outcomes. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects after the write chain settles. Does not wait for borrowed adapter reads or dispose the borrowed store/runtime. Participation additionally waits for the actual native transaction to finish releasing work.

members.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
members.description: Reports cleanup failure then completes; owns a separate cached Promise for the same cleanup.

blocks.text: 非法配置同步抛本包 INVALID_OPTION TypeError，cause 保留 contract 计划错误。水合直接保留 contract ENVELOPE_INVALID、VERSION_UNSUPPORTED 与 MIGRATION_FAILED。失败水合使 flush/clear 阻塞至重试成功；写入错误查 writeError。handle 只拥有订阅和已接纳写入，store/runtime 始终借用。

symbols.name: PersistState
symbols.purpose: Shared lifecycle vocabulary used by overall, hydration and write status projections; each projection permits only its documented subset.
symbols.core:
idle: Write lane has no currently executing mutation.
loading: A hydration attempt is reading or restoring the archive.
writing: A serialized archive write or removal is executing.
ready: Aggregate state is hydrated without a current read/write failure.
success: The latest hydration attempt completed successfully.
error: The corresponding hydration or write lane retains a failure.
disposed: The persistence lifecycle is terminal and stops new scheduling.

members.description: Combined status after successful hydration without a retained hydration/write error.

symbols.name: persistTransaction
symbols.purpose: Drains authentic handles attached to the same complete store, then borrows one original transaction. Snapshot, entity, text and byte writes commit together; memory remains caller-owned and ordinary mirroring resumes after settlement.
symbols.core:
store: Original complete record store supporting transactions.
handles: Nonempty array of active handles attached to that exact store; duplicates enlist once.
run: Callback retaining the concrete backend scope and Awaited result.
ctx: Original backend options. concurrency overrides its default; fail rejects busy handles immediately, while wait alone enters FIFO. One deadline and wait budget continue into backend retries; extension and symbol values remain intact.
Resolves only after native commit; failure preserves storage errors and does not undo memory. IndexedDB external data must be read before starting.

symbols.name: persistUnit
symbols.purpose: Connects a caller-provided synchronous state unit to asynchronous hydration and serialized writes. Automatic writes stay gated after hydration failure until successful retry.
symbols.core:
unit: Application IPersistUnit with synchronous snapshot/restore and change subscription returning an unsubscribe function.
Complete caller-owned persistence handle. The engine captures recognized configuration once at entry; adapters first snapshot options using their original getter receiver. Inaccessible adapter options throw INVALID_OPTION with cause before construction. Hydration failures reject ready and remain observable through status.
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
runtime: Owning IRuntime from the source Store, collection or AtomStore; persistence status signals are created in that graph.
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
codec: ICodec from storage-contract encoding the complete version/state envelope. Text and binary routes are supported; structured writes reject.
defaultJsonCodec with strict portable values and Map/Set round trips.
codecStages: Optional store-bound observer from host.codecStages(storage). Each actual conversion emits once; observer failures only report and never delay conversion.
Omitted: no explicit codec-stage observer is installed.
transactionStages: Optional host.transactionStages(storage) observer. Emits before/afterPersistFlush using the actual operation view; after means request completion, and observer failures only report.
Omitted: no explicit transactional flush observer is installed.
version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.
0; older archives require reachable steps, and future archives are rejected.
migrations: A target-version step record or { reset: () => state }. Step context contains fromVersion/toVersion; known thenables are rejected.
Omitted: only the configured version is readable; other versions fail with storage-contract VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.
Upgrade reachable older archives with contiguous synchronous steps, or reset them once. Future archives are always rejected.
partialize: Synchronous callback before each write, receiving the latest unit snapshot and selecting its persisted portion. Throws and thenables become write failures.
partialize.state: Latest synchronous source snapshot taken when the write executes.
Synchronous complete or partial state placed inside the envelope.
Identity: persist the complete snapshot.
Use it to keep session-only or derived fields out of storage. It selects each write without changing live memory. Omission stores the complete snapshot. The callback must return synchronously.
merge: Synchronous hydration callback receiving persisted partial state and the latest current state; return the complete state to restore. Throws or thenables fail hydration.
merge.persisted: Decoded and optionally migrated partial archive state.
merge.current: Current source snapshot immediately before restoration.
Synchronous complete source state for restore.
Plain objects retain current fields changed since the original startup snapshot and accept persisted values for unchanged fields. Arrays, Map, Set and other shapes replace completely.
Set it when archived partial state needs shape-specific reconciliation with live state. Return a complete synchronous state. Default plain-object merging preserves edits since attachment; non-object shapes are replaced by the archive.
debounceMs: Quiet interval before requesting a serialized write; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. It does not bound storage latency.
0: enqueue a write without a debounce timer.
maxWaitMs: Maximum debounce window from the first post-hydration change; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. Relevant only when debounceMs is positive.
undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.
Canonical systemScheduler resolved through lifecycle scheduler admission.
parameters: unit: IPersistUnit<TState>
options: Omit<IPersistUnitOptions<TState>, 'migrations'> & { readonly migrations?: TSteps & ISyncMigrationSteps<NoInfer<TSteps>>; }
symbols.returns: IPersistHandle

declaredConfiguration.name: key
declaredConfiguration.description: Required archive identity passed unchanged to storage; any string is accepted.

declaredConfiguration.name: runtime
declaredConfiguration.description: Owns the status signals. Use the underlying store, collection, or `AtomStore` runtime to keep them in one graph.

declaredConfiguration.name: storage
declaredConfiguration.description: Borrowed text-capable adapter; binary routing additionally uses its byte capabilities/methods.

declaredConfiguration.name: codec
declaredConfiguration.description: Encodes and decodes the complete `{ version, state }` envelope. The codec does not specialize on the state type. Defaults to defaultJsonCodec; structured output is unsupported for writes.

declaredConfiguration.name: version
declaredConfiguration.description: Archive schema version, default 0; must be a nonnegative safe integer.

declaredConfiguration.name: codecStages
declaredConfiguration.description: Store-bound codec observations; failures report without controlling conversion or storage.

declaredConfiguration.name: transactionStages
declaredConfiguration.description: Store-bound transaction observations; only before/afterPersistFlush are emitted here.

declaredConfiguration.name: partialize
declaredConfiguration.description: Synchronously selects state for each write, default identity; does not change in-memory state.

declaredConfiguration.name: merge
declaredConfiguration.description: Synchronously reconciles an archive with current state. Default plain-object merging preserves fields changed since the attachment snapshot; other shapes use archived replacement. Supply a shape-specific merge when storing only part of an array, Map, Set or custom state.

declaredConfiguration.name: debounceMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Quiet interval before enqueueing a write, default 0; finite range 0 through 2147483647 ms.

declaredConfiguration.name: maxWaitMs
declaredConfiguration.description: Optional maximum from a window's first post-hydration change; same finite range as debounceMs. Omitted means no maximum; zero schedules a zero-delay task when debounce is enabled. Does not bound queue or adapter latency, and has no timer effect when debounceMs is zero.

declaredConfiguration.name: scheduler
declaredConfiguration.description: Monotonic clock and cancellable timer owner; defaults to the canonical system scheduler.

blocks.text: persistUnit(unit, options) 是三个适配器共用的引擎。unit 必须提供同步 snapshot()、同步 restore(state) 和 subscribe(onChange)，后者返回退订函数。核心 options 必填 key、runtime、storage；三个 facade 自动使用 Store / collection / AtomStore 自己的 Runtime。状态单位、Runtime 和 storage 均为借用资源。

rows: 必填字符串；决定存档键，字符串不被强制转型。
仅核心显式必填；持有状态信号，facade 自动提供。
必填，满足最小 KeyValueStore 投影；见后文选路。
defaultJsonCodec；编码完整的 version / state 信封，而不只编码 state。
连续目标版本步骤或 `{ reset: () => state }`，只允许同步。未来或不可升级版本报 VERSION_UNSUPPORTED；keyed 不公开此选项。
恒等函数；写入前从当前快照裁出需要保存的字段。
核心 / indexed / keyed 可自定义 merge(persisted, current)；缺省浅三向合并普通对象，其他形状整体替换。light 不公开 merge 选项。
0，不防抖；有限数，范围 0 到 2147483647，允许小数。
未设置；同一数值范围，限制防抖窗口，不是 I/O 期限。
canonical systemScheduler；提供单调 now 与可取消 schedule 任务。

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。
迁移步骤必须同步；类型拒绝已知 Promise/thenable，运行时 MIGRATION_FAILED 保留原始 cause。partialize 与 merge 保留同步 INVALID_OPTION 规则。

members.description: No codec resolves for a storage key. * * Provide `codec` to `persist` or `persistUnit`, or confirm that the default codec is available.

members.name: codecOutputMismatch
members.description: Codec output does not match the backend capabilities or contract. Examples include unsupported * structured output, non-byte binary output, and non-string text output. * * Check the codec `output` and backend `capabilities`. This is a configuration or implementation * mismatch, not a transient failure.

members.name: backendCapability
members.description: A binary read/write requires `getBytes` and `setBytes`, or archive removal requires * `removeBytes`, but the storage backend lacks the required operation. Atomic persistence also * requires the original complete record store with transaction support. * * Use a record-capable backend such as memory or IndexedDB, or use a text codec.

members.name: envelopeInvalid
members.description: The default JSON codec receives a non-string payload or cannot decode the supplied JSON. * * Inspect the payload and cause chain. Envelope structure and versions belong to * storage-contract.

members.name: encodeFailed
members.description: The JSON codec fails to serialize a value, or an uncoded snapshot, partialize or codec failure * occurs inside an admitted transactional flush. * * Check whether the value is JSON-serializable. The original exception remains in `cause`.

members.name: hydrateAndWriteFailed
members.description: The handle retains both a hydration error and a write error. Its combined error projection * returns an AggregateError containing them in hydration-then-write order; it does not reopen a * failed hydration's write gate. * * Inspect `error.errors` and handle each failure. This is a double failure, not one transient * error.

members.name: abortedByDispose
members.description: A persistence operation is aborted by `dispose()`. The error retains the name `AbortError`. * * Treat this as cancellation. Disposal stops scheduling new writes and requests cancellation of * active operations, including an enlisted transaction. An in-flight adapter may still complete.

members.name: invalidOption
members.description: Persistence options or transaction participation are invalid. This includes an invalid version, * a forged or mismatched handle/view, and a direct mutation during explicit participation. * * Correct the configuration before retrying. This is a permanent input error.

symbols.name: IPersistCollectionOptions
symbols.purpose: Collection adapter options; source runtime is inferred and custom shape reconciliation can use merge.
symbols.core:
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
codec: ICodec from storage-contract encoding the complete version/state envelope. Text and binary routes are supported; structured writes reject.
defaultJsonCodec with strict portable values and Map/Set round trips.
codecStages: Optional store-bound observer from host.codecStages(storage). Each actual conversion emits once; observer failures only report and never delay conversion.
Omitted: no explicit codec-stage observer is installed.
transactionStages: Optional host.transactionStages(storage) observer. Emits before/afterPersistFlush using the actual operation view; after means request completion, and observer failures only report.
Omitted: no explicit transactional flush observer is installed.
version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.
0; older archives require reachable steps, and future archives are rejected.
migrations: A target-version step record or { reset: () => state }. Step context contains fromVersion/toVersion; known thenables are rejected.
Omitted: only the configured version is readable; other versions fail with storage-contract VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.
Upgrade reachable older archives with contiguous synchronous steps, or reset them once. Future archives are always rejected.
partialize: Synchronous callback before each write, receiving the latest unit snapshot and selecting its persisted portion. Throws and thenables become write failures.
partialize.state: Latest synchronous source snapshot taken when the write executes.
Synchronous complete or partial state placed inside the envelope.
Identity: persist the complete snapshot.
Use it to keep session-only or derived fields out of storage. It selects each write without changing live memory. Omission stores the complete snapshot. The callback must return synchronously.
merge: Synchronous hydration callback receiving persisted partial state and the latest current state; return the complete state to restore. Throws or thenables fail hydration.
merge.persisted: Decoded and optionally migrated partial archive state.
merge.current: Current source snapshot immediately before restoration.
Synchronous complete source state for restore.
Plain objects retain current fields changed since the original startup snapshot and accept persisted values for unchanged fields. Arrays, Map, Set and other shapes replace completely.
Set it when archived partial state needs shape-specific reconciliation with live state. Return a complete synchronous state. Default plain-object merging preserves edits since attachment; non-object shapes are replaced by the archive.
debounceMs: Quiet interval before requesting a serialized write; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. It does not bound storage latency.
0: enqueue a write without a debounce timer.
maxWaitMs: Maximum debounce window from the first post-hydration change; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. Relevant only when debounceMs is positive.
undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.
Canonical systemScheduler resolved through lifecycle scheduler admission.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
key: Archive key selected by the application and reused for reading, writing and removal.
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
codec: ICodec from storage-contract encoding the complete version/state envelope. Text and binary routes are supported; structured writes reject.
defaultJsonCodec with strict portable values and Map/Set round trips.
codecStages: Optional store-bound observer from host.codecStages(storage). Each actual conversion emits once; observer failures only report and never delay conversion.
Omitted: no explicit codec-stage observer is installed.
transactionStages: Optional host.transactionStages(storage) observer. Emits before/afterPersistFlush using the actual operation view; after means request completion, and observer failures only report.
Omitted: no explicit transactional flush observer is installed.
version: Application schema version, a safe nonnegative integer compared with each saved envelope version.
0; older archives require reachable steps, and future archives are rejected.
migrations: A target-version step record or { reset: () => state }. Step context contains fromVersion/toVersion; known thenables are rejected.
Omitted: only the configured version is readable; other versions fail with storage-contract VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.
Upgrade reachable older archives with contiguous synchronous steps, or reset them once. Future archives are always rejected.
partialize: Synchronous callback before each write, receiving the latest unit snapshot and selecting its persisted portion. Throws and thenables become write failures.
partialize.state: Latest synchronous source snapshot taken when the write executes.
Synchronous complete or partial state placed inside the envelope.
Identity: persist the complete snapshot.
Use it to keep session-only or derived fields out of storage. It selects each write without changing live memory. Omission stores the complete snapshot. The callback must return synchronously.
merge: Synchronous hydration callback receiving persisted partial state and the latest current state; return the complete state to restore. Throws or thenables fail hydration.
merge.persisted: Decoded and optionally migrated partial archive state.
merge.current: Current source snapshot immediately before restoration.
Synchronous complete source state for restore.
Plain objects retain current fields changed since the original startup snapshot and accept persisted values for unchanged fields. Arrays, Map, Set and other shapes replace completely.
Set it when archived partial state needs shape-specific reconciliation with live state. Return a complete synchronous state. Default plain-object merging preserves edits since attachment; non-object shapes are replaced by the archive.
debounceMs: Quiet interval before requesting a serialized write; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. It does not bound storage latency.
0: enqueue a write without a debounce timer.
maxWaitMs: Maximum debounce window from the first post-hydration change; finite milliseconds in [0, 2147483647]. Relevant only when debounceMs is positive.
undefined: only the quiet interval controls enqueueing.
scheduler: Caller-selected IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; its monotonic now and cancellable schedule own the debounce window.
Canonical systemScheduler resolved through lifecycle scheduler admission.

import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host/plugins/memory'
import { defaultJsonCodec } from '@migaia/store-persist'
import { persistCollection } from '@migaia/store-persist/indexed'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] as const })
const storage = host.backend('memory')
const cart = new ObservableMap<string, number>()
const first = persistCollection(cart, { key: 'cart', storage })
await first.ready
cart.set('book', 2)
await first.flush()
first.dispose()
cart.dispose()
const restored = new ObservableMap<string, number>([['stale', 99]])
const second = persistCollection(restored, { key: 'cart', storage })
await second.ready
console.log('恢复：', restored.get('book'), restored.has('stale'))

console.log('映射：', saved.state instanceof Map)
second.dispose()
restored.dispose()

symbols.name: clearFamily
symbols.purpose: Enumerates backend keys and removes those starting with namespace plus a colon, sequentially. It does not inventory live definitions or alter their in-memory state.
symbols.core:
storage: Caller-injected storage-contract IKeyValueStore projection: capabilities, get, set, remove and keys. Binary output additionally requires getBytes and setBytes from IRecordStore.
namespace: Exact application-selected namespace used by persistKeyed; matching includes its trailing colon separator.
Number of matched records after all removals succeed; backend failure rejects and earlier removals remain applied.
parameters: storage: IPersistStorage
namespace: string
symbols.returns: Promise<number>
examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createAtomStore, familyDef } from '@migaia/store-keyed'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host/plugins/memory'
import { persistKeyed, clearFamily } from '@migaia/store-persist/keyed'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] as const })
const storage = host.backend('memory')
await storage.set('other:u1', 'keep')
const atoms = createAtomStore(createRuntime())
const counter = familyDef(() => 0)
const def = counter('u1')
const handle = persistKeyed(atoms, def, 'u1', { namespace: 'users', storage })
await handle.ready
atoms.set(def, 7)
await handle.flush()
console.log('匹配数：', await clearFamily(storage, 'users'))
console.log(
  '清理后：',
  await storage.get('users:u1'),
  atoms.peek(def),
  await storage.get('other:u1')
)
atoms.set(def, 8)
await handle.flush()
console.log('重新保存：', (await storage.get('users:u1')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
atoms.dispose()

symbols.name: IPersistKeyedHandle
symbols.purpose: The actual complete engine handle extended with value captured before initial hydration. Live status and disposed getters retain their original owner; read live business values through AtomStore.
symbols.core:
status: IReactiveComputed selecting disposed first, then loading, then hydration/write error, otherwise ready. A write can be active while overall status remains ready.
error: Computed current hydration or write failure; simultaneous failures form AggregateError preserving both originals.
hydrated: Computed true only after a successful hydration attempt; disposal does not convert an incomplete hydration into success.
hydrationStatus: Readonly .value projection reporting loading, success or error for the latest hydration attempt.
hydrationError: Readonly .value containing the latest hydration failure; cleared when another hydration attempt starts.
writeStatus: Readonly .value reporting idle, writing, error or disposed independently of hydration status.
writeError: Readonly .value retaining the latest failed write or removal; successful writes clear it and a final disposal write may update it later.
ready: Original first-hydration-attempt Promise: resolves only on success and rejects on failure or disposal before completion with AbortError/ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE. Retries do not replace this Promise.
settled: Barrier derived from the initial ready Promise that resolves after either success or failure; it does not await future retries.
disposed: Live terminal-disposal getter on the original IPersistHandle; becomes true once dispose is called.
retryHydrate: Retries storage reading after hydration failure. An ongoing recovery prevents another read but does not make every concurrent invocation wait for it; await the invocation that starts recovery. Success reopens automatic writes.
Promise of recovery; rejects on another failure or post-disposal invocation. Initial ready and settled remain their original Promises.
flush: Without tx, drains and writes the current snapshot. With an enlisted authentic tx, captures and starts encoding at invocation, then writes through that operation view in call order. Only outer persistTransaction success means commit.
flush.tx: Optional active view from this handle's persistTransaction.
Promise of this encoding and request. Direct flush rejects during participation; memory does not roll back with storage.
clear: Cancels the debounce window and queues archive removal after earlier writes; it neither resets memory nor unsubscribes the source.
Promise resolving after removal; hydration/removal failures or disposal reject. A later source change can recreate the archive.
disposeAsync: Stops scheduling like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot. It does not wait for borrowed reads or dispose the source, storage or runtime.
Promise resolving after the write chain settles. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects afterwards; final-write failures remain available on writeError.

status: IReactiveComputed selecting disposed first, then loading, then hydration/write error, otherwise ready. A write can be active while overall status remains ready.
error: Computed current hydration or write failure; simultaneous failures form AggregateError preserving both originals.
hydrated: Computed true only after a successful hydration attempt; disposal does not convert an incomplete hydration into success.
hydrationStatus: Readonly .value projection reporting loading, success or error for the latest hydration attempt.
hydrationError: Readonly .value containing the latest hydration failure; cleared when another hydration attempt starts.
writeStatus: Readonly .value reporting idle, writing, error or disposed independently of hydration status.
writeError: Readonly .value retaining the latest failed write or removal; successful writes clear it and a final disposal write may update it later.
ready: Original first-hydration-attempt Promise: resolves only on success and rejects on failure or disposal before completion with AbortError/ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE. Retries do not replace this Promise.
settled: Barrier derived from the initial ready Promise that resolves after either success or failure; it does not await future retries.
disposed: Live terminal-disposal getter on the original IPersistHandle; becomes true once dispose is called.
retryHydrate: Retries storage reading after hydration failure. An ongoing recovery prevents another read but does not make every concurrent invocation wait for it; await the invocation that starts recovery. Success reopens automatic writes.

flush: Without tx, drains and writes the current snapshot. With an enlisted authentic tx, captures and starts encoding at invocation, then writes through that operation view in call order. Only outer persistTransaction success means commit.
flush.tx: Optional active view from this handle's persistTransaction.

clear: Cancels the debounce window and queues archive removal after earlier writes; it neither resets memory nor unsubscribes the source.
Promise resolving after removal; hydration/removal failures or disposal reject. A later source change can recreate the archive.
disposeAsync: Stops scheduling like dispose, then waits for admitted writes/removals and any final debounce snapshot. It does not wait for borrowed reads or dispose the source, storage or runtime.
Promise resolving after the write chain settles. A synchronous cleanup failure rejects afterwards; final-write failures remain available on writeError.

examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createAtomStore, familyDef } from '@migaia/store-keyed'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host/plugins/memory'
import { persistKeyed, clearFamily } from '@migaia/store-persist/keyed'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] as const })
const storage = host.backend('memory')
await storage.set('other:u1', 'keep')
const atoms = createAtomStore(createRuntime())
const counter = familyDef(() => 0)
const def = counter('u1')
const handle = persistKeyed(atoms, def, 'u1', { namespace: 'users', storage })
await handle.ready
atoms.set(def, 7)
await handle.flush()
console.log('匹配数：', await clearFamily(storage, 'users'))
console.log(
  '清理后：',
  await storage.get('users:u1'),
  atoms.peek(def),
  await storage.get('other:u1')
)
atoms.set(def, 8)
await handle.flush()
console.log('重新保存：', (await storage.get('users:u1')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
atoms.dispose()

import { fromValueCodec } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { defineCollectionsJsonCodec } from '@migaia/serialize/codecs/collections-json'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host/plugins/memory'
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { persist } from '@migaia/store-persist/light'

const codec = fromValueCodec(defineCollectionsJsonCodec({ version: 1 }))
const text = await codec.encode({ roles: new Map([['Ada', new Set(['read'])]]) })
console.log(await codec.decode(text))

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] as const })
const storage = host.backend('memory')
const state = createStore({ count: 1 })
await using handle = persist(state, {
  key: 'counter',
  storage,
  codecStages: host.codecStages(storage)
})
await handle.ready
await handle.flush()
await handle.disposeAsync()
await state.$dispose()

import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { memoryBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-host/plugins/memory'
import { persist } from '@migaia/store-persist/light'

await using host = await createStorageHost({ plugins: [memoryBackendPlugin()] as const })
const storage = host.backend('memory')
const settings = createStore({ theme: 'light' })
const handle = persist(settings, { key: 'settings', storage })
await handle.ready
settings.theme = 'dark'
await handle.flush()
console.log('已保存：', (await storage.get('settings')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
await settings.$dispose()

blocks.text: persistUnit(unit, options) 是三个适配器共用的引擎。unit 必须提供同步 snapshot()、同步 restore(state) 和 subscribe(onChange)，后者返回退订函数。核心 options 必填 key、runtime、storage；三个 facade 自动使用 Store / collection / AtomStore 自己的 Runtime。状态单位、Runtime 和 storage 均为借用资源。

rows: 必填字符串；决定存档键，字符串不被强制转型。
