symbols.name: IProcessSupervisorOptions
symbols.purpose: Process profile construction with optional usage monitoring, output tails, registry and prewarm adoption.
symbols.core:
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
Supply a synchronous nonthrowing sink for contained failures. A failed drain is reported while retirement continues. Reporting does not retry work or complete shutdown; this callback is required.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
Set ready when creating a handle does not yet make its service usable. Resolve after the handshake; rejection fails startup and follows restart policy. Omit it to accept launch completion as readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
Use on-failure to retry crashes but stop after normal completion. never disables automatic retries; always also restarts normal exits. Omission selects on-failure. The task follows the configured backoff when a startup attempt fails.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
Choose stay when an operator must intervene after restart exhaustion. cooldown reopens admission after afterMs. Omitting terminalPolicy keeps the stay behavior. Disposal permanently closes either policy.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
Set beforeTerminate to drain pending application work before termination. Resolve after flushing; rejection is reported and retirement continues. drainTimeoutMs, exitTimeoutMs and reapTimeoutMs bound separate phases. Omit the callback to skip draining; omitted phase limits are 5000 ms.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force. Explicitly unsupported exit observation reports EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE immediately; abandoned leases remain held until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.
Absent: no health monitor is installed.
Set health for a service that can become unresponsive without exiting. check resolves on success; rejection or timeout counts toward failureThreshold. Reaching that threshold invalidates readiness. Omit health for no periodic checks; coroutine heartbeat cannot coexist with it.
health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.
`5000` milliseconds between checks.
health.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative deadline for one health check before recording failure.
`2000` milliseconds for one check.
health.failureThreshold: Nonnegative safe integer threshold of consecutive failed checks that invalidates readiness.
`3` consecutive failures invalidate the unit.
isolation: Required admission accepts enforced or monitored capabilities; best effort records weaker guarantees as degradation.
`required`; insufficient capabilities fail construction.
Keep required, the default, when requested capabilities must be enforced or monitored; weaker declarations fail construction. Choose best-effort only when weaker guarantees are acceptable. This coroutine cannot isolate faults, so its additional fault-isolation requirement appears in degraded diagnostics.
requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.
An empty list adds no capability requirements.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
usage: Native resource sampling policy used when process memory or CPU limits are monitored.
Absent: samples use interval and threshold defaults.
usage.intervalMs: Finite positive scheduler interval for native process resource samples. Both supervisor and prewarm pool reject zero/nonfinite intervals and nonpositive or unsafe failure thresholds as RangeError/INVALID_OPTION.
`1000` milliseconds between samples.
usage.failureThreshold: Positive safe-integer count of consecutive sampleUsage rejections before the process is unhealthy. A successful sample resets this count; a successful sample exceeding a monitored limit terminates immediately.
`3` consecutive sampleUsage rejections, not three successful over-limit samples.
output: Bounds diagnostic stdout and stderr tails while launchers continue draining regardless of observers.
Absent: retain bounded tails without a chunk observer.
Set output to keep smaller diagnostic tails, and onChunk to observe drained bytes as they arrive. The synchronous observer returns void; a throw is reported without stopping the drain. Omission keeps 65536 bytes per stream and installs no observer. The observer sees arriving bytes while the retained tail is bounded.
output.tailBytes: Positive safe-integer maximum bytes retained separately per output stream; zero is invalid and does not disable tail capture.
`65536` bytes for each stream.
output.onChunk: Synchronous observer receives stream label and drained bytes; returns void and does not own draining. Throws are reported.
Absent: only bounded diagnostic tails are retained.
registry: Application durable record port and namespace for recovering prior-run process identities.
Absent: no durable records or orphan recovery.
registry.port: Application storage implementing `IProcessRegistry`; add and removal follow actual process ownership.
registry.namespace: Application chosen isolation name; recovery lists only records in this namespace.
prewarm: Pool from createPrewarmPool with matching budget, launcher and spec; transfers the idle handle and lease. Matching id, registry port and namespace reuse the exact warm durable record and its actual-exit cleanup; different owners create their own records.
Absent: launch every admitted process cold.
wallClock: Epoch clock supplied by the application for durable launch timestamps; not used for deadlines.
`systemWallClock`; uses host epoch time.

options: Application registry, namespace, launcher with probe and terminateRecord, and synchronous nonthrowing report(error). Recovery awaits each adapter operation and retains failed records.

symbols.name: createThreadSupervisor
symbols.purpose: Supervises native workers through an injected launcher. Admission checks termination and requested heap limits; an adapter without enforced exit observation requires an explicit health policy.
symbols.core:
An `IThreadSupervisor`; invalid specification or unsupported isolation fails before native launch.
id: Nonempty stable name chosen by the application for diagnostics and durable process ownership.
report: Application callback receiving each contained launch, health, cleanup or late error; returns void synchronously and must not throw. Late health-check failure remains reported after monitor closure; only the exact abort reason is suppressed, and passive failures retain the original object.
Supply a synchronous nonthrowing sink for contained failures. A failed drain is reported while retirement continues. Reporting does not retry work or complete shutdown; this callback is required.
ready: Optional asynchronous handshake receiving the launched handle and attempt cancellation signal; resolve to admit readiness, reject or throw to fail startup.
Absent: launch completion is readiness.
Set ready when creating a handle does not yet make its service usable. Resolve after the handshake; rejection fails startup and follows restart policy. Omit it to accept launch completion as readiness.
startupTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative launch-plus-readiness deadline in scheduler milliseconds; zero expires immediately. Expiry retires the attempt and follows normal restart/terminal policy, publishing a stable outcome instead of leaving the supervisor starting.
`10000` milliseconds for each attempt.
restart: Automatic restart policy for classified exits; nested fields control mode, backoff and the failure window.
An empty policy uses the nested defaults below.
restart.mode: Chooses which actual exits schedule an automatic restart; manual restart remains available.
`on-failure`; normal completion stops.
Use on-failure to retry crashes but stop after normal completion. never disables automatic retries; always also restarts normal exits. Omission selects on-failure. The task follows the configured backoff when a startup attempt fails.
restart.initialDelayMs: Finite nonnegative first restart delay in scheduler milliseconds.
`250` milliseconds before the first retry.
restart.factor: Finite multiplier of successive restart delays; must be at least one.
`2`; each failure doubles the delay until its cap.
restart.maxDelayMs: Finite nonnegative upper bound of exponential retry delay in milliseconds.
`30000` milliseconds caps backoff.
restart.maxRestarts: Nonnegative safe integer controlling failures admitted in one sliding restart window.
`5` failures before exhaustion.
restart.windowMs: Finite nonnegative scheduler window for counting recent failures.
`60000` milliseconds of failure history.
terminalPolicy: After exhaustion, keeps terminal admission closed or schedules an explicit cooldown.
Absent: remain terminal until explicit restart.
terminalPolicy.mode: Selects a terminal wait until explicit restart or a timed cooldown retry after exhaustion; only disposal permanently closes the supervisor.
Choose stay when an operator must intervene after restart exhaustion. cooldown reopens admission after afterMs. Omitting terminalPolicy keeps the stay behavior. Disposal permanently closes either policy.
terminalPolicy.afterMs: Finite nonnegative cooldown duration required only for the cooldown policy.
stop: Ordered application drain, graceful exit and forced reap phases for each retiring unit.
Absent: each phase uses its nested default.
Set beforeTerminate to drain pending application work before termination. Resolve after flushing; rejection is reported and retirement continues. drainTimeoutMs, exitTimeoutMs and reapTimeoutMs bound separate phases. Omit the callback to skip draining; omitted phase limits are 5000 ms.
stop.beforeTerminate: Asynchronous application drain receiving handle, native cancellation signal and remainingMs getter; resolve when drained. Failure is reported and termination proceeds.
Absent: skip application draining work.
stop.drainTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative maximum application drain time; a command graceMs overrides this phase only.
`5000` milliseconds for application drain.
stop.exitTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative wait for actual graceful exit before requesting force.
`5000` milliseconds before force.
stop.reapTimeoutMs: Finite nonnegative recovery wait after force. Explicitly unsupported exit observation reports EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE immediately; abandoned leases remain held until actual exit.
`5000` milliseconds of forced recovery.
health: Serial periodic checks for ready handles; consecutive failures invalidate the generation.
Absent: no health monitor is installed.
Set health for a service that can become unresponsive without exiting. check resolves on success; rejection or timeout counts toward failureThreshold. Reaching that threshold invalidates readiness. Omit health for no periodic checks; coroutine heartbeat cannot coexist with it.
health.check: Application asynchronous check receiving the current handle and cancellation signal; resolve if healthy, reject or throw to count failure.
health.intervalMs: Finite positive interval between serial checks, measured by the scheduler.
`5000` milliseconds between checks.
health.timeoutMs: Finite nonnegative deadline for one health check before recording failure.
`2000` milliseconds for one check.
health.failureThreshold: Nonnegative safe integer threshold of consecutive failed checks that invalidates readiness.
`3` consecutive failures invalidate the unit.
isolation: Required admission accepts enforced or monitored capabilities; best effort records weaker guarantees as degradation.
`required`; insufficient capabilities fail construction.
Keep required, the default, when requested capabilities must be enforced or monitored; weaker declarations fail construction. Choose best-effort only when weaker guarantees are acceptable. This coroutine cannot isolate faults, so its additional fault-isolation requirement appears in degraded diagnostics.
requires: Additional capability names chosen by the application, merged with profile requirements before admission.
An empty list adds no capability requirements.
scheduler: Monotonic clock and timers supplied by the application; see `IScheduler` in `@migaia/utils/scheduler`.
`systemScheduler`; uses the host timers.
launcher: Runtime adapter supplied by the application; its launch result must settle exited only after execution and resources stop.
spec: Initial application specification validated by the selected unit profile before admission.
budget: Shared matching-kind budget returned by `createUnitBudget`; actual exit releases its occupied lease.
parameters: options: IThreadSupervisorOptions<THandle>
symbols.returns: IThreadSupervisor<THandle>

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Supervises native workers through an injected launcher. Admission checks termination and requested heap limits; an adapter without enforced exit observation requires an explicit health policy.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import createThreadSupervisor from @migaia/supervision/threads, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use createThreadSupervisor when its function contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when createThreadSupervisor does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained function example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

pending: Unresolved acquire calls including the active FIFO queue head.
closed: Whether admission has permanently closed; existing occupied leases remain valid.
close: Rejects waiting and future acquisitions; existing leases remain occupied until their owners release them.

members.name: state
members.description: Current lifecycle state; changes are also published as `state` events.

members.name: generation
members.description: Number of the latest start attempt; a successful start identifies the serving unit.

members.name: start
members.description: Starts the unit, retrying through backoff, and resolves with a stable answer: `ready` with the * unit, `stopped` (possibly with a budget rejection) or `terminal`. Unit failures never reject; * only a disposed supervisor rejects. Calling it while ready or starting joins the same answer.

members.name: whenReady
members.description: Waits for the next stable answer without starting anything; `signal` abandons the wait.

members.name: stop
members.description: Stops the current attempt and unit through the bounded drain, exit and reap phases, then * settles in `stopped`. It returns on time even if the unit ignores stop; that unit keeps its * budget slot until it actually exits. Concurrent calls share one promise; `graceMs` shortens the * drain phase.

members.name: kill
members.description: Immediately upgrades the original slot teardown; joiners retain the pending stop promise.

members.name: restart
members.description: Clears the failure window, stops the current unit and starts a fresh one, even from `terminal`.

members.name: replace
members.signature: replace(options?: { readonly strategy?: ReplaceStrategy; readonly spec?: TSpec; }): Promise<IReplaceOutcome>;
members.description: Replaces the serving unit, optionally with a new spec. `stop-then-start` (default) stops first; * `start-then-switch` switches only after the new unit is ready, then stops the old one. A failed * replacement resolves `failed` or `rejected` and leaves a still-serving old unit in place.

parameterDetails.type: { readonly strategy?: ReplaceStrategy; readonly spec?: TSpec; }

members.name: inspect
members.description: Reads state, last exit, failure window, health and degradation without side effects.

members.name: subscribe
members.description: Registers an event listener and returns its unsubscribe function; listener errors are reported.

members.name: dispose
members.description: Stops like `stop()` and closes the supervisor for good; later commands are rejected.

symbols.purpose: Any host definition, whatever its type parameters.
symbols.core:
entry: Required URL or nonempty entry string for thread and process hosts; coroutine hosts reject this field. The frozen definition stores its URL text for the runtime adapter.
Absent for coroutine; required for thread and process runtimes.
limits: Thread-only resource limits containing optional positive heapBytes; process and coroutine hosts reject this field.
Omitted: no explicit thread heap limit is supplied to the adapter.
sandbox: Process-only caller-owned ITraySandbox whose wrap method transforms the launch command; Tray supplies no sandbox implementation.
Omitted: the process launch command is not sandbox-wrapped.
name: Unique host name; `spawn(name, ...)` and `list({ host })` use it.
runtime: Where the instances of this host run.
`coroutine`: in the parent event loop.
config: Validator `(input) => config` run on every initialisation; it receives the `config` given to `spawn()` / `replace()` and its output reaches `plugins(instance)`. Throw to reject.
Not set: the input is passed through unchecked.
plugins: Factory `(instance, trayPlugin) => plugins` called on every initialisation. `instance` holds id, host, generation and config; `trayPlugin` is the plugin whose `tray` Feature gives `self()`, `to()`, `exit()`, `routing`, `publish()` and `subscribe()`.
plugins.instance: Identity and validated config of this initialisation (`ITrayInstanceInfo`).
plugins.trayPlugin: The client plugin; depend on it with `defineFeature(factory, { tray: trayPlugin.getFeature("tray") })`.
The plugin tuple installed into the instance host.
exposes: Feature paths `plugin.feature` that remote callers may use; methods are then called as `plugin.feature.method`.
supervisor: Restart policy and startup timeout of supervised instances; see `ITraySupervisorPolicy`.
Not set: the default policy of the runtime adapter.
routing: Routing policies the instance plugins may call through `deps.tray.routing`; the parent also registers them.
Not set: only `roundRobin` and `leastInFlight`.

symbols.name: ITray
symbols.purpose: The parent registry returned by `createTray()`.
symbols.core:
routing: Routing namespace: `tray.routing.roundRobin(host)` or `tray.routing("roundRobin", host)` returns a remote that picks a ready instance per call. Built-ins are `roundRobin` and `leastInFlight`; custom policies come from `createTray({ routing })` and host definitions.
publish: Publishes a business topic from the parent to current subscribers, at most once each, with `meta.from = { parent: true }`. Not persisted; subscribers that are not ready miss it.
publish.topic: Non-empty topic string; empty throws `TRAY_TOPIC_INVALID`.
publish.payload: Optional portable data.
Nothing; delivery failures are reported, never thrown.
subscribe: Subscribes the parent to a business topic.
subscribe.topic: Non-empty topic string.
subscribe.listener: `(payload, meta) => void`; `meta.from` names the authenticated sender.
A synchronous unsubscribe function.
spawn: Starts an instance of a registered host and waits until its plugins are installed and initialised (`ready`). A failed start removes the instance and rejects with `TRAY_INSTANCE_START_FAILED`.
spawn.host: Name of a host passed to `createTray({ hosts })`.
spawn.options: `{ id, config? }`: `id` is a new unique id chosen by the caller; `config` is portable input for the host validator (required when the validator output excludes `undefined`).
A typed remote bound to this admission.
instance: Returns a remote for an existing instance without starting anything.
instance.host: The same host definition object the instance was spawned from.
instance.id: Id given to `spawn()`; unknown ids throw `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`.
A typed remote; a different host throws `TRAY_HOST_MISMATCH`.
remove: Stops an instance and deletes its registry record; old remotes then fail with `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`, even if the id is spawned again.
remove.id: Id given to `spawn()`.
remove.options: `{ graceMs }`: time for plugin cleanup inside the instance; default 5000.
Resolves after removal.
list: Returns a frozen snapshot of the registered instances.
list.filter: Optional `{ host?, runtime?, state? }`; all given fields must match.
A read-only array of `ITrayInstance`.
get: Reads one instance with the connection details of the RPC layer.
get.id: Id given to `spawn()`.
An `ITrayInstanceDetail`.
stop: Stops an instance but keeps its record (state `stopped`); `restart()` can start it again. Operations on one instance run in call order.
stop.id: Id given to `spawn()`.
stop.options: `{ graceMs }`: time for plugin cleanup; default 5000.
Resolves once stopped.
restart: Starts a new generation of an instance with the same configuration.
restart.id: Id given to `spawn()`.
The new `ITrayInstance` snapshot.
replace: Starts a new generation with a new configuration; the configuration is committed only if the new generation initialises.
replace.id: Id given to `spawn()`.
replace.options: `{ config }`: portable input for the host validator.
on: Observes one lifecycle event of all instances.
on.event: A `TrayInstanceEvent` value such as `ready`.
on.listener: Receives a frozen `ITrayInstanceEventRecord`.
An unsubscribe function.
watch: Iterates over lifecycle events; keeps at most the latest 100 unread records (not a persistent log).
watch.options: `{ signal }` ends the iteration when it aborts.
An async iterator of `ITrayInstanceEventRecord`.
dispose: Removes every instance, then closes the registry; later calls fail with `TRAY_DISPOSED`. Concurrent calls share one Promise.
dispose.options: `{ graceMs }` for each instance cleanup; default 5000.
Resolves after everything stopped.
[Symbol.asyncDispose]: Supports await using by forwarding to registry disposal, with the same retained disposal promise and default per-instance grace.
The same `Promise<void>` returned by dispose; cleanup failures retain that operation’s failure semantics.

entry: Required URL or nonempty entry string for thread and process hosts; coroutine hosts reject this field. The frozen definition stores its URL text for the runtime adapter.

limits: Thread-only resource limits containing optional positive heapBytes; process and coroutine hosts reject this field.

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

rows: 没有 ready 路由候选。
policy 未注册或子端未声明。
policy 名称 / 回调 / 返回候选无效或执行抛错。
Host DSL 或 registry 构造输入无效。
remote 指向与当前接纳记录不同的 Host。
暴露路径使用保留内部插件名。
config 或 payload 不是支持的 portable 数据。
spawn 重用仍被接纳的 id。
lookup 或 remote 使用已结束接纳记录。
插件安装或 generation init 失败，原因留 cause。
调用路径不在声明暴露面。
child init 重复或引用其他 Host。
已关闭 registry 继续接纳操作。
Loader / result / release 外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 loader 执行失败。
Adapter 或插件返回外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 adapter 执行失败。
Runtime Host / 参数 / callback 或 self ticket 使用违约。
Runtime 关闭后继续接纳 run。
未归属的 callback throw / reject，使用权仍在结算后释放。
运行租用接纳失败的回退分类；完整外包身份保留，信号取消不强制 reject。
未归属的制品次要清理失败；不替换 mutation primary。
静态 entry、托管 factory 返回或 Host claim 非法。
静态 Graph 重复 key。
get / entryState 使用未接纳 key。
Graph 或 entry 未 ready、gate 失败或已终结。
readiness 属性或 state/error getter 失败。
绕开托管 facade 的 concrete Host 变更。

blocks.text: 旧四个托管类型辅助导出 IHostBaselinePlugins、IPluginWithSynchronousShared、ICanResolveReadyDefinitions、IResolveReadyTrayPlugins 已取消公开导出；外部标注使用 ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic 或 Runtime 推导。Runtime shutdown 只接收 mode，不再接收未使用的 quiescenceMs；对应预算在 managed Host 配置。Loader / Adapter 方法只读取一次，校验与执行复用同一函数。
包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build；清理失败需沿 cause / errors 与 physicalCompletion 记录。此命令清单不声明本页已运行门禁，也不把本地案例当成其他运行时、原生隔离或性能证据。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
methods: Method paths callable on the other side, from its accepted directory.
counters: The current native-member projection reports `{ status: "unavailable", reason: "canonical-counter-not-available" }`; it has no canonical pending-call counter input. A declared metric shape does not make a measurement available.
recent: Recent lifecycle records (`IRpcMemberRecent`), newest last.
identity: Identity `{ name, instanceId }` the other side announced, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
generation: Number of the current initialisation; it grows on every restart, replace or supervised restart.
kind: How the connection was configured: `spawn`, `connect` or `listen`.
The local source launched the remote native unit.
The local source initiated the connection.
The local source accepted the connection.
direction: Who started it: `spawned`, `spawned-by` (this side is the child), `connect` or `listen`.
This owner launched the remote unit.
This side is the child of its bootstrap parent.
This side initiated the connection.
This side accepted the connection.
carrier: Name of the physical carrier, such as a MessagePort or stdio.
connection: `{ status }`: `ready`, `closed`, `departed`, or unavailable.
unit: Supervised unit `{ kind, state, generation, degraded }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
health: Native health metric whose `value` is `{ state, failures }`, with explicit scope, unit and observation time; or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
restartCount: Number of restarts as a metric, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
resources: Sampled resources (pid or threadId, memory, CPU time, event-loop utilisation), or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
lastExit: Last exit `{ generation, reason, code, signal, error? }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
id: Instance id given to `spawn(host, { id })`.
host: Name of the host definition the instance runs.
config: Inside plugins(instance) and the child client self(), config is the validator output, or the input without a validator. Parent list/get snapshots instead retain the portable spawn/replace input; they do not publish the transformed child value.
runtime: How the instance runs: `coroutine`, `thread` or `process`.
state: Registry state of the instance.
inFlight: Business calls (`request`, `notify`, `stream`) sent to this admission and not finished; `leastInFlight` routing compares it.

symbols.name: TrayErrorCode
symbols.purpose: Table of the stable error codes of this package; values are the strings on `error.code`.
symbols.core:
hostUnavailable: `TRAY_HOST_UNAVAILABLE`: routing found no ready instance; wait for one.
routingUnknown: `TRAY_ROUTING_UNKNOWN`: the policy name is not registered or declared.
topicInvalid: `TRAY_TOPIC_INVALID`: the topic is not a non-empty string.
routingInvalid: `TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID`: bad policy name, or `pick` threw or returned a non-candidate.
hostInvalid: `TRAY_HOST_INVALID`: the host definition or spawn options are invalid.
hostUnknown: `TRAY_HOST_UNKNOWN`: `spawn()` names an unregistered host.
hostMismatch: `TRAY_HOST_MISMATCH`: `instance()` used a different host than the record.
reservedName: `TRAY_RESERVED_NAME`: `exposes` uses an internal plugin name.
valueNotPortable: `TRAY_VALUE_NOT_PORTABLE`: config or payload cannot cross realms.
instanceDuplicate: `TRAY_INSTANCE_DUPLICATE`: the id is already used.
instanceUnknown: `TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN`: no such instance, or it was removed.
instanceNotReady: `TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY`: the instance is not ready.
instanceStartFailed: `TRAY_INSTANCE_START_FAILED`: install or init failed; see `cause`.
pathNotExposed: `TRAY_PATH_NOT_EXPOSED`: the path is outside `exposes`.
childStateInvalid: `TRAY_CHILD_STATE_INVALID`: the child was initialised twice or for another host.
disposed: `TRAY_DISPOSED`: the registry is closing; create a new one.
loaderContractInvalid: `LOADER_CONTRACT_INVALID`: the loader or its result is malformed.
loaderExecutionFailed: `LOADER_EXECUTION_FAILED`: `load()` threw; see `cause`.
adapterContractInvalid: `ADAPTER_CONTRACT_INVALID`: the adapter or produced plugin is malformed.
adapterExecutionFailed: `ADAPTER_EXECUTION_FAILED`: `adapt()` threw; see `cause`.
runtimeContractInvalid: `RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID`: bad host, name, options or callback for the runtime.
runtimeDisposed: `RUNTIME_DISPOSED`: `run()` after `dispose()`.
runtimeExecutionFailed: `RUNTIME_EXECUTION_FAILED`: the callback threw; see `cause`.
runtimeAborted: `RUNTIME_ABORTED`: fallback classification for an unclassified generation-acquisition failure; an existing source/code is preserved. Caller cancellation and deadlines only abort the cooperative signal and do not force callback settlement.
artifactCleanupFailed: `ARTIFACT_CLEANUP_FAILED`: releasing an artifact failed; see `cleanupErrors`.
invalidEntry: `TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY`: an entry or start result breaks the contract.
duplicateEntry: `TRAY_DUPLICATE_ENTRY`: a key appears twice.
unknownEntry: `TRAY_UNKNOWN_ENTRY`: the key was not admitted.
unavailable: `TRAY_UNAVAILABLE`: not ready, gate failed or disposed.
gateReadFailed: `TRAY_GATE_READ_FAILED`: a readiness getter threw.
hostMutationBypass: `HOST_MUTATION_BYPASS`: the inner host was changed directly, bypassing the managed host.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.description: The mesh has no ready host candidate; await a ready instance before calling again.

members.name: routingUnknown
members.description: The routing policy is absent from registration or declaration; register its branded definition.

members.name: topicInvalid
members.description: The mesh requires a non-empty topic string; correct the topic before publishing or subscribing.

members.name: routingInvalid
members.description: Routing policy name or pick is invalid; provide a named synchronous policy.

members.name: hostInvalid
members.description: Host definition is invalid; provide an admitted host DSL.

members.name: hostUnknown
members.description: Spawn names an unregistered host; register the host before spawning.

members.name: hostMismatch
members.description: Remote host differs from the admission; select the record's host.

members.name: reservedName
members.description: Expose uses a reserved internal plugin; rename the business plugin.

members.name: valueNotPortable
members.description: Config or payload is not portable data; remove unsupported values.

members.name: instanceDuplicate
members.description: Spawn reuses an admitted id; choose a free id or remove the admission.

members.name: instanceUnknown
members.description: Lookup or remote uses an ended admission; obtain a fresh remote.

members.name: instanceNotReady
members.description: Call targets a non-ready instance; await its ready transition.

members.name: instanceStartFailed
members.description: Install or generation init fails; inspect the preserved cause.

members.name: pathNotExposed
members.description: Dispatcher receives a path outside the exposure; use an exposed Feature method.

members.name: childStateInvalid
members.description: Child init repeats or names another host; init once per generation.

members.name: disposed
members.description: Operation enters a closing registry; create a new Tray.

members.name: loaderContractInvalid
members.description: Loader shape or artifact descriptor is invalid; repair the loader contract before retrying.

members.name: loaderExecutionFailed
members.description: Loader execution failed; inspect the preserved source error before deciding whether to retry.

members.name: adapterContractInvalid
members.description: Adapter shape or produced plugin is invalid; repair adapter compatibility.

members.name: adapterExecutionFailed
members.description: Adapter execution failed; inspect the preserved artifact compatibility cause.

members.name: runtimeContractInvalid
members.description: Runtime host, name, options, or callback violates the Runtime boundary contract.

members.name: runtimeDisposed
members.description: Runtime admission was attempted after closing; create a fresh Runtime.

members.name: runtimeExecutionFailed
members.description: Runtime callback failed after exact lease admission; inspect the preserved callback cause.

members.name: runtimeAborted
members.description: Runtime could not acquire the target lease; inspect the retained admission failure or cause.

members.name: artifactCleanupFailed
members.description: An unclassified artifact cleanup failed; existing lifecycle identities remain unchanged. * Inspect cleanupErrors.

members.name: invalidEntry
members.description: An entry, managed factory result, or Host claim is invalid; provide a complete definition and * an unclaimed Host.

members.name: duplicateEntry
members.description: Duplicate key during factory admission; caller must provide unique keys.

members.name: unknownEntry
members.description: Unknown get()/entryState() key; caller must use an admitted key.

members.name: unavailable
members.description: Entry is not ready or gate failed; caller must await readiness or repair the gate.

members.name: gateReadFailed
members.description: Readiness getter failed; caller must inspect the preserved cause and fix the source.

members.name: hostMutationBypass
members.description: Managed reads detect a mutation made through the escaped concrete Host.

spawned: `spawned`: an instance was admitted.

members.name: ready
members.description: A current generation completed initialization.

members.name: restarting
members.description: An admitted unit entered replacement or supervised recovery.

members.name: failed
members.description: The current admission entered failed state.

members.name: stopped
members.description: The record remains admitted but its native unit stopped.

members.description: The admission was revoked and its removal cleanup was attempted.

symbols.name: TrayInstanceState
symbols.purpose: Registry states of an instance, shown in `list()` and `get()`.
symbols.core:
starting: `starting`: being spawned and initialised.
ready: `ready`: initialisation completed and the instance accepts business calls.
restarting: `restarting`: a new generation is starting.
failed: `failed`: start or run failed.
stopped: `stopped`: stopped by `stop()`; `restart()` can start it.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

members.name: starting
members.description: Initial admission is installing its RPC unit and running generation init.

members.name: ready
members.description: The current generation has completed business plugin initialization.

members.name: restarting
members.description: Native replacement or recovery is waiting for a new generation's initialization.

members.name: failed
members.description: Startup/init or terminal native recovery failed.

symbols.name: createHost
symbols.purpose: Creates a managed host around one PluginHost built by `create()`. Definitions are admitted and ready plugins install in Feature dependency order before resolution; missing required providers keep their consumers blocked. Rollback releases only the claim acquired by this call; rejecting an already claimed host leaves its existing managed session intact.
symbols.core:
The managed `ITrayHost`, supporting `await using`. Construction failures carry `detail` with the phase and rollback state. Safe native errors retain identity, type and stack; frozen errors or existing detail are preserved through cause rather than overwritten.
create: Builds the one PluginHost the managed host owns (a class instance or `defineHost()` handle).
Supply this required factory to construct the one PluginHost owned by the managed host. Return a real PluginHost instance or defineHost handle; the managed host releases it.
plugins: Initial plugin definitions, admitted and installed in order.
mutationAdmissionMs: Longest wait for a queued mutation to start running.
quiescenceMs: Longest wait for physical plugin cleanup in `bounded` shutdown.
shutdown: `{ mode }`: how `dispose()` waits.
shutdown.mode: Waiting strategy of disposal.
Return after `quiescenceMs`; unfinished cleanup continues in `physicalCompletion`.
Wait until every plugin release really completed.
Choose bounded to return after quiescenceMs while physical cleanup continues, or strict-drain to wait for real release. This required host option has no implicit mode.
report: Receives lifecycle and cleanup diagnostics.
Not set: diagnostics are dropped after classification.
Set a synchronous receiver for lifecycle and secondary cleanup diagnostics. Omission leaves no application diagnostic receiver; operation results still retain their own failures.
symbols.advanced: Install and remove plugins at runtime while dependants wait as `blocked`.
parameters: options: ICreateHostOptions<THost, TPlugins>
symbols.returns: Promise<ITrayResolvedHost<THost, TPlugins>>

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

rows: 没有 ready 路由候选。
policy 未注册或子端未声明。
policy 名称 / 回调 / 返回候选无效或执行抛错。
Host DSL 或 registry 构造输入无效。
remote 指向与当前接纳记录不同的 Host。
暴露路径使用保留内部插件名。
config 或 payload 不是支持的 portable 数据。
spawn 重用仍被接纳的 id。
lookup 或 remote 使用已结束接纳记录。
插件安装或 generation init 失败，原因留 cause。
调用路径不在声明暴露面。
child init 重复或引用其他 Host。
已关闭 registry 继续接纳操作。
Loader / result / release 外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 loader 执行失败。
Adapter 或插件返回外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 adapter 执行失败。
Runtime Host / 参数 / callback 或 self ticket 使用违约。
Runtime 关闭后继续接纳 run。
未归属的 callback throw / reject，使用权仍在结算后释放。
运行租用接纳失败的回退分类；完整外包身份保留，信号取消不强制 reject。
未归属的制品次要清理失败；不替换 mutation primary。
静态 entry、托管 factory 返回或 Host claim 非法。
静态 Graph 重复 key。
get / entryState 使用未接纳 key。
Graph 或 entry 未 ready、gate 失败或已终结。
readiness 属性或 state/error getter 失败。
绕开托管 facade 的 concrete Host 变更。

blocks.text: 旧四个托管类型辅助导出 IHostBaselinePlugins、IPluginWithSynchronousShared、ICanResolveReadyDefinitions、IResolveReadyTrayPlugins 已取消公开导出；外部标注使用 ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic 或 Runtime 推导。Runtime shutdown 只接收 mode，不再接收未使用的 quiescenceMs；对应预算在 managed Host 配置。Loader / Adapter 方法只读取一次，校验与执行复用同一函数。
包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build；清理失败需沿 cause / errors 与 physicalCompletion 记录。此命令清单不声明本页已运行门禁，也不把本地案例当成其他运行时、原生隔离或性能证据。

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

rows: 没有 ready 路由候选。
policy 未注册或子端未声明。
policy 名称 / 回调 / 返回候选无效或执行抛错。
Host DSL 或 registry 构造输入无效。
remote 指向与当前接纳记录不同的 Host。
暴露路径使用保留内部插件名。
config 或 payload 不是支持的 portable 数据。
spawn 重用仍被接纳的 id。
lookup 或 remote 使用已结束接纳记录。
插件安装或 generation init 失败，原因留 cause。
调用路径不在声明暴露面。
child init 重复或引用其他 Host。
已关闭 registry 继续接纳操作。
Loader / result / release 外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 loader 执行失败。
Adapter 或插件返回外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 adapter 执行失败。
Runtime Host / 参数 / callback 或 self ticket 使用违约。
Runtime 关闭后继续接纳 run。
未归属的 callback throw / reject，使用权仍在结算后释放。
运行租用接纳失败的回退分类；完整外包身份保留，信号取消不强制 reject。
未归属的制品次要清理失败；不替换 mutation primary。
静态 entry、托管 factory 返回或 Host claim 非法。
静态 Graph 重复 key。
get / entryState 使用未接纳 key。
Graph 或 entry 未 ready、gate 失败或已终结。
readiness 属性或 state/error getter 失败。
绕开托管 facade 的 concrete Host 变更。

blocks.text: 旧四个托管类型辅助导出 IHostBaselinePlugins、IPluginWithSynchronousShared、ICanResolveReadyDefinitions、IResolveReadyTrayPlugins 已取消公开导出；外部标注使用 ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic 或 Runtime 推导。Runtime shutdown 只接收 mode，不再接收未使用的 quiescenceMs；对应预算在 managed Host 配置。Loader / Adapter 方法只读取一次，校验与执行复用同一函数。
包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build；清理失败需沿 cause / errors 与 physicalCompletion 记录。此命令清单不声明本页已运行门禁，也不把本地案例当成其他运行时、原生隔离或性能证据。

symbols.name: ITrayPluginRemovalResult
symbols.purpose: Removal result distinguishing missing plugin, committed removal, precommit failure and cleanup failure after removal.
symbols.core:
ok: Whether the removal operation succeeded, including the successful no-op when the plugin was missing.

committed: Whether logical removal was published; committed failures retain the new view while cleanup errors remain observable.

removed: True exactly when a plugin was logically removed; false for missing-plugin no-op or precommit failure.
The target registration no longer belongs to the committed topology.
No registration was removed by this operation.
error: Original primary Error supplied only for failed removal branches, without discarding the committed fact.

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

rows: 没有 ready 路由候选。
policy 未注册或子端未声明。
policy 名称 / 回调 / 返回候选无效或执行抛错。
Host DSL 或 registry 构造输入无效。
remote 指向与当前接纳记录不同的 Host。
暴露路径使用保留内部插件名。
config 或 payload 不是支持的 portable 数据。
spawn 重用仍被接纳的 id。
lookup 或 remote 使用已结束接纳记录。
插件安装或 generation init 失败，原因留 cause。
调用路径不在声明暴露面。
child init 重复或引用其他 Host。
已关闭 registry 继续接纳操作。
Loader / result / release 外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 loader 执行失败。
Adapter 或插件返回外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 adapter 执行失败。
Runtime Host / 参数 / callback 或 self ticket 使用违约。
Runtime 关闭后继续接纳 run。
未归属的 callback throw / reject，使用权仍在结算后释放。
运行租用接纳失败的回退分类；完整外包身份保留，信号取消不强制 reject。
未归属的制品次要清理失败；不替换 mutation primary。
静态 entry、托管 factory 返回或 Host claim 非法。
静态 Graph 重复 key。
get / entryState 使用未接纳 key。
Graph 或 entry 未 ready、gate 失败或已终结。
readiness 属性或 state/error getter 失败。
绕开托管 facade 的 concrete Host 变更。

blocks.text: 旧四个托管类型辅助导出 IHostBaselinePlugins、IPluginWithSynchronousShared、ICanResolveReadyDefinitions、IResolveReadyTrayPlugins 已取消公开导出；外部标注使用 ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic 或 Runtime 推导。Runtime shutdown 只接收 mode，不再接收未使用的 quiescenceMs；对应预算在 managed Host 配置。Loader / Adapter 方法只读取一次，校验与执行复用同一函数。
包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build；清理失败需沿 cause / errors 与 physicalCompletion 记录。此命令清单不声明本页已运行门禁，也不把本地案例当成其他运行时、原生隔离或性能证据。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
signal: Transaction signal supplied by `loadIntoHost()`. Caller cancellation and deadline forwarding end when the transaction settles; a committed artifact remains owned by its definition generation.
deadlineAt: Absolute deadline on `systemScheduler.now()`, or `undefined` when the required `timeoutMs` is false.
report: Reports secondary failures without failing the load.

symbols.purpose: Decodes canonical RFC 4648 Base64 (with padding) into bytes. URL-safe or unpadded variants are rejected with `INVALID_ENCODING` instead of being decoded loosely.
symbols.core:
value: Base64 text.
target: Optional buffer to decode into, avoiding an allocation; must have exactly the decoded byte length; a mismatch throws `INVALID_ARGUMENT`.
The decoded bytes (the `target` view when given).
parameters: value: string
target: Uint8Array (optional)
symbols.returns: Uint8Array
examples:
bytesToBase64(new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3])) // 'AQID'
base64ToBytes('AQID') // Uint8Array [1, 2, 3]
base64ToBytes('AQID-_') // 抛 TypeError（URL-safe 字符不被接受）

const UtilsErrorCode = {
  invalidArgument: 'INVALID_ARGUMENT',
  nonErrorValue: 'NON_ERROR_VALUE',
  envUnsupported: 'ENV_UNSUPPORTED',
  aborted: 'ABORTED',
  deadlineExceeded: 'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED',
  schedulerRunaway: 'SCHEDULER_RUNAWAY',
  errorIdentityConflict: 'ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT',
  errorChainInvalid: 'ERROR_CHAIN_INVALID',
  cloneUnsupported: 'CLONE_UNSUPPORTED',
  invalidEncoding: 'INVALID_ENCODING',
  limiterClosed: 'LIMITER_CLOSED',
  reentrantCall: 'REENTRANT_CALL',
  configUnsupported: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED',
  configReadonly: 'CONFIG_READONLY',
  configConflict: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT',
  configLimitExceeded: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
  configPathInvalid: 'CONFIG_PATH_INVALID',
  objectPathInvalid: 'OBJECT_PATH_INVALID',
  formatInvalid: 'FORMAT_INVALID',
  formatValueMissing: 'FORMAT_VALUE_MISSING',
  numberFormatInvalid: 'NUMBER_FORMAT_INVALID'
} as const

blocks.text: 全包统一使用的稳定语义码，`IUtilsErrorCode` 是其取值的联合类型。除 `UtilsError` 子类外，`base64ToBytes`/`object-path`/`config` 等模块抛出的原生 `TypeError`/`RangeError` 也会通过 `Object.defineProperty` 挂上对应的 `code`（与 `source: 'foundation.utils'`），可用同一套判断逻辑识别。
按用途理解全部错误码：

items: `INVALID_ARGUMENT`：参数类型、范围或互斥组合错误；修正调用参数。
`NON_ERROR_VALUE`：非 `Error` 异常值已被 `toError()` 转换；从 `cause` 读取原始值。
`ENV_UNSUPPORTED`：宿主缺少 `structuredClone` 等必要能力；更换环境或实现。
`ABORTED`：外部信号请求取消；停止协作式工作并传播取消原因。
`DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`：操作、尝试或总流程超时；结合 `scope`、`timeoutMs` 选择重试或降级。
`SCHEDULER_RUNAWAY`：虚拟时钟一次推进超过 10000 个任务；排查同刻递归调度。
`ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT`：已有错误身份与新 `source`/`code` 冲突；保留原身份。
`ERROR_CHAIN_INVALID`：收到的序列化错误树或其 plain data 违反字段、标量、深度、数量或文本字节约束；修正输入或使用边界自己的处理策略。
`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`：值不能被 `structuredClone` 复制；先转换为可克隆数据。
`INVALID_ENCODING`：编码输入不是规范形式；按错误偏移修正输入。
`LIMITER_CLOSED`：并发限制器已关闭；停止提交或创建新实例。
`REENTRANT_CALL`：同一实例发生禁止的重入；等待当前回调结束。
`CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`：配置含不支持的数据形状或属性；改用普通数据。
`CONFIG_READONLY`：尝试修改只读配置；从所有者侧创建新配置。
`CONFIG_CONFLICT`：配置来源的所有权、profile 或描述符冲突；统一契约再合并。
`CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`：配置键数、深度等超过安全上限；缩小输入或调整明确限制。
`CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`：配置路径为空、危险或分段无效；改用安全路径。
`OBJECT_PATH_INVALID`：对象路径无法安全解析；修正字符串或分段元组。

blocks.code:
const ConfigProfile = { data: 'data', richRuntime: 'richRuntime' } as const
type IConfigProfile = 'data' | 'richRuntime'

blocks.text: `data`（默认）：只接受可移植的纯数据——普通对象、数组、`Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 等内置类型；拒绝函数。`richRuntime`：额外接受函数/可构造类（连同其自身属性与 `prototype` 一起深拷贝），用于确实需要在配置里携带回调或工厂的场景。

blocks.code: const CONFIG_DELETE: unique symbol

blocks.text: 在 `patchConfig`/`combineConfig` 的补丁对象中，把某个键的值设为这个符号，表示"删除该键"（而不是设为 `undefined`）。
深拷贝 `value` 得到一个独立的、被本包元数据标记为"已拥有"的图。要求根必须是普通对象（不能是数组）且不含 `symbol` 键。深拷贝过程中：

items: `Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 会被识别并对应构造新实例（而不是被当成普通对象递归展开字段）；
循环引用通过内部 `WeakMap` 保留同一图结构（不会无限递归，也不会拆散共享节点）；
`__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 键一律拒绝；
超过 `limits`（见下）中的深度/节点数/键数会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'` 的 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 若 `value` 已经是某次 `ownConfig` 的返回值（元数据匹配同一 `profile`/`limits`），直接原样返回（幂等）；若元数据不匹配（例如同一对象先后用不同 `profile` 调用），抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'` 的 `TypeError`。

调用方拿到结果后有三种明确路径：内部继续把它作为稳定配置根；通过 `readonlyConfig()` 暴露可读但不可写的递归 Proxy；通过 `patchConfig()` 或 `combineConfig()` 派生下一份已拥有配置。不要直接把原始外部对象交给这些 API，也不要把“已拥有”误解为冻结——所有权保证来自独立图与内部登记，运行时写保护由 `readonlyConfig()` 单独提供。

blocks.code:
type IConfigLimits = {
  readonly maxDepth: number // 默认 256
  readonly maxNodes: number // 默认 100_000
  readonly maxKeys: number // 默认 1_000_000
  readonly maxPathLength: number // 默认 4096
  readonly maxSegmentLength: number // 默认 512
}

blocks.text: `limits` 不得超过包级默认上限。`patchConfig` 相对输入基准只能收紧，放宽会抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT；`combineConfig` 取所有输入与请求上限的逐项最小值，放宽请求被自动收紧，不因此抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT。

blocks.code: function readonlyConfig<T extends IConfigRecord>(value: IOwnedConfig<T>): T

blocks.text: 返回一个带缓存的只读对象，内部通过 `Proxy` 拦截修改；同一输入对象重复调用会返回同一个只读对象。读取时仍然访问原配置，没有再复制一份数据。任何写操作（`set`/`defineProperty`/`deleteProperty`/`setPrototypeOf`/`preventExtensions`，以及 `Map`/`Set`/`Date` 上的变更方法如 `.set()`/`.add()`/`.setFullYear()`）都会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_READONLY'` 的 `TypeError`。嵌套对象、`Map`、`Set` 和函数字段也会受到同样的写入保护。`value` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`。

对根做写时复制式覆盖：`patch` 中每个键要么设为新值（会被递归深拷贝并纳入所有权），要么设为 `CONFIG_DELETE` 表示删除。只有被改动路径上的节点被复制，未涉及的子树按引用共享。`patch` 为空对象且 `reuseUnchangedRoot`（默认 `true`）时直接返回 `base` 本身，不做任何拷贝。`patch` 必须是普通对象、键不能是 `symbol`、不能是访问器属性，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`；键名撞上 `__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 抛 `code: 'CONFIG_PATH_INVALID'`。注意：`patchConfig` 只在根一层应用补丁——要修改嵌套字段，先用 `get`/`set`（`/object` 模块）在应用层算出新的嵌套子树，再作为整体值放进 `patch`。
在 `/object` 模块的 `parseObjectPath` 基础上叠加 config 专属限制（长度上限可自定义，默认取包级默认值）并强制所有段都是字符串（不支持数字下标简写形式在 config 路径里独立出现，统一按字符串段处理）。
读取配置内某条路径，区分"键不存在"（`missing`）与"值就是 `undefined`"（`value: undefined`）。返回的对象/函数类型的值会自动包一层只读 Proxy（与 `readonlyConfig` 相同的包装逻辑），保证读到的嵌套值也不可被外部修改。`config` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物。
按 `sources` 数组的顺序（后者覆盖前者）合并多个已拥有的配置根。只有一个来源且未提供任何合并选项时，直接返回该来源，保留根 identity；其他情形产出新的 owned 配置。全部来源必须共享同一个 `profile`，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`。
`strategies` 是全局默认策略；`pathRules` 是一组 `{ prefix, strategies }`，按 `prefix`（从根开始的键路径）匹配当前正在合并的键路径，`prefix` 更长（更具体）的规则优先生效，命中的规则会与全局 `strategies` 合并（规则内声明的字段覆盖全局同名字段，规则未声明的字段沿用全局值）。
每次 `combineConfig` 调用会在合并来源前读取每条规则的 `prefix` 和 `strategies` 一次并建立索引；相同前缀以输入中最先声明的规则为准。规则描述必须稳定：不支持依赖 getter 每次返回不同描述，或在合并过程中修改规则来影响后续属性。

当某个键在双方都存在、且不属于以上任何自动合并分支（例如两侧都是不可合并的原始值）时，若提供了 `onConflict`，会调用它并传入 `IConfigConflictContext`（`path`：当前键的完整路径；`left`：左侧/已有值；`right`：右侧/新值），其返回值 `IConfigConflictDecision` 决定最终结果：`{ kind: 'left' }` 保留左值、`{ kind: 'right' }` 采用右值、`{ kind: 'delete' }` 删除该键、`{ kind: 'value', value }` 采用自定义值。`onConflict` 必须同步返回（返回 Promise 会抛 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'`；返回值不是上述四种 `kind` 之一同样抛 `CONFIG_CONFLICT`）。未提供 `onConflict` 时右侧直接覆盖左侧（标准合并语义）。`right === CONFIG_DELETE` 会删除目标键（可用于合并阶段裁剪掉某个来源写入的默认值）。

数组采用 concat 或 mergeByIndex 时，同一次合并使用私有累计数组；`onConflict` 当场读取当前累计内容，保留的引用会随后续合并更新。回调只读取累计值并返回决策；直接修改累计数组（包括写入、delete、修改 length 或 freeze）属于不支持的用法。需要替换时返回 `{ kind: 'value', value }`。实现不为直接修改增加运行时检查或拒绝逻辑。

`ConfigOwner` 持有一份不可变的配置快照，把 `ownConfig` / `readConfigPath` / `patchConfig` / `combineConfig` / `readonlyConfig` 集中到一个可链式调用的类上。每次写入都会先完整构建并校验下一份快照，再提交；失败时旧快照不变。路径类型由 `IObjectPath` 推导，`get('server.port')` 的类型就是 `number | undefined`。

items: 读取：`get` / `getOr` / `require` / `read` / `has` / `view()`（深只读视图）/ `select(path)`（子树的新 owner）/ `diff` / `equals`。
写入（返回 `this`）：`set` / `delete` / `patch` / `combine` / `batch(fn)`（一次校验、一次通知，失败整体回滚）/ `reset()` / `lock()`。
监听：`watch(listener)` 或 `watch(path, listener)`；监听器异常交给 `report`（默认进入宿主未捕获错误队列），监听器内再写入会抛 `REENTRANT_CALL`。
序列化：`toJSON()` / `toString(space)`；Map、Set、函数等非 JSON 值抛 `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`。
静态：`from`、`fromAsync`（Promise、值或接收 `signal` 的工厂；支持 `signal` / `timeoutMs`）、`fromEnv`、`merge`、`is`。与 `@migaia/resource` 的 `createResource` 组合即可得到一份响应式的配置资源。

blocks.text: `diff` 按左侧自身字符串键优先、再追加右侧独有键的顺序，深度优先比较数据。每对对象只访问一次；共享分支的同一差异只出现在首次到达的路径上，不再为其他别名重复报告。循环上没有数据差异时，`equals` 返回 `true`。路径监听使用同样的数据比较规则；监听顺序、取消订阅和异常上报规则不变。

guidance.id: config-先接纳配置-再公开读取和派生新配置
guidance.heading: /config：先接纳配置，再公开读取和派生新配置

blocks.text: `ownConfig` 是接收外部配置的边界：复制输入并登记独立、可验证所有权。`WeakMap` 是不往配置上添加字段的元数据表，库用它保留 `profile` 与 `limits`；普通对象不能通过伪造字段变成已接纳的配置。默认 `data` 档位接纳数据，`richRuntime` 还允许回调或工厂。

`ownConfig` 返回对象没有被冻结；获得所有权和公开只读访问是两件事。`readonlyConfig` 给已有配置套上只读保护，正常读取仍访问原数据，没有复制第二份配置，不允许调用方修改任何层级。`Map.set()`、`Set.add()`、`Date.setFullYear()` 等修改方法都会报错。公开读取用它，更新用 `patchConfig()` 生成下一份受管理配置，不是写 `view`；需要区分路径缺失与值为 `undefined` 时用 `readConfigPath`。补丁只作用于根字段，嵌套修改先算出新子树，再整体放入补丁。携带函数的 `richRuntime` 是运行时配置，不应当作可序列化数据。
`combineConfig` 按输入顺序合并，后面的来源覆盖前面；对象默认递归合并，数组默认替换。下面明确改用数组拼接，展示两个输入、结果与调用方自己整理的变化记录。
`defaults` 与 `override` 没有被修改。这里的 `diff` 只是把结果变化写明，不是 `combineConfig` 的额外返回值。
需要持有快照并比较变化时，用 `ConfigOwner.diff(other)` / `equals(other)`。对比按左侧键优先、深度优先的固定顺序遍历，每对对象只比较一次；共享节点的同一差异只报告首次到达的路径，不再为每条别名重复输出。没有数据差异的循环引用视为相等。

guidance.id: 防止配置在传入之后被改掉
guidance.heading: 防止配置在传入之后被改掉

blocks.text: 库的重试次数莫名其妙变了，查到最后发现是调用方在传入配置之后又改了自己的对象。
库直接保存调用方传来的配置对象时，调用方事后的修改会影响库的行为；插件拿到配置后随手改一个字段，也会影响其他所有人。
`ownConfig` 在接收时复制一份归库所有；`readonlyConfig` 生成只读视图交给插件；`patchConfig` 生成新配置而不改旧配置，`CONFIG_DELETE` 用来删除字段。
输出：

blocks.code:
库内看到的重试次数: 3
只读视图拒绝修改: TypeError CONFIG_READONLY
https://staging.example.com | debug 还在吗: false | retry 复用: true

blocks.text: `库内看到的重试次数: 3`：调用方的修改没有影响到库。
往只读视图里写会抛出 `TypeError`，代码是 `CONFIG_READONLY`。新配置的 `endpoint` 已更新、`debug` 已删除，没改动的 `retry` 与旧配置共用同一个对象。
带所有权语义的配置对象：只有经 `ownConfig` 接纳的对象才能被 `readonlyConfig`/`patchConfig`/`readConfigPath`/`combineConfig` 处理，用运行时 `WeakMap` 元数据（而非可伪造的字段）标记"这是一个受本包管理的配置根"。

blocks.code:
const ConfigProfile = { data: 'data', richRuntime: 'richRuntime' } as const
type IConfigProfile = 'data' | 'richRuntime'

blocks.text: `data`（默认）：只接受可移植的纯数据——普通对象、数组、`Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 等内置类型；拒绝函数。`richRuntime`：额外接受函数/可构造类（连同其自身属性与 `prototype` 一起深拷贝），用于确实需要在配置里携带回调或工厂的场景。

blocks.code: const CONFIG_DELETE: unique symbol

blocks.text: 在 `patchConfig`/`combineConfig` 的补丁对象中，把某个键的值设为这个符号，表示"删除该键"（而不是设为 `undefined`）。
深拷贝 `value` 得到一个独立的、被本包元数据标记为"已拥有"的图。要求根必须是普通对象（不能是数组）且不含 `symbol` 键。深拷贝过程中：

items: `Date`/`RegExp`/`Map`/`Set` 会被识别并对应构造新实例（而不是被当成普通对象递归展开字段）；
循环引用通过内部 `WeakMap` 保留同一图结构（不会无限递归，也不会拆散共享节点）；
`__proto__`/`prototype`/`constructor` 键一律拒绝；
超过 `limits`（见下）中的深度/节点数/键数会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'` 的 `RangeError`。

blocks.text: 若 `value` 已经是某次 `ownConfig` 的返回值（元数据匹配同一 `profile`/`limits`），直接原样返回（幂等）；若元数据不匹配（例如同一对象先后用不同 `profile` 调用），抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_CONFLICT'` 的 `TypeError`。

调用方拿到结果后有三种明确路径：内部继续把它作为稳定配置根；通过 `readonlyConfig()` 暴露可读但不可写的递归 Proxy；通过 `patchConfig()` 或 `combineConfig()` 派生下一份已拥有配置。不要直接把原始外部对象交给这些 API，也不要把“已拥有”误解为冻结——所有权保证来自独立图与内部登记，运行时写保护由 `readonlyConfig()` 单独提供。

blocks.code:
type IConfigLimits = {
  readonly maxDepth: number // 默认 256
  readonly maxNodes: number // 默认 100_000
  readonly maxKeys: number // 默认 1_000_000
  readonly maxPathLength: number // 默认 4096
  readonly maxSegmentLength: number // 默认 512
}

blocks.text: `limits` 不得超过包级默认上限。`patchConfig` 相对输入基准只能收紧，放宽会抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT；`combineConfig` 取所有输入与请求上限的逐项最小值，放宽请求被自动收紧，不因此抛 CONFIG_CONFLICT。

blocks.code: function readonlyConfig<T extends IConfigRecord>(value: IOwnedConfig<T>): T

blocks.text: 返回一个带缓存的只读对象，内部通过 `Proxy` 拦截修改；同一输入对象重复调用会返回同一个只读对象。读取时仍然访问原配置，没有再复制一份数据。任何写操作（`set`/`defineProperty`/`deleteProperty`/`setPrototypeOf`/`preventExtensions`，以及 `Map`/`Set`/`Date` 上的变更方法如 `.set()`/`.add()`/`.setFullYear()`）都会抛出 `code: 'CONFIG_READONLY'` 的 `TypeError`。嵌套对象、`Map`、`Set` 和函数字段也会受到同样的写入保护。`value` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物，否则抛 `code: 'CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED'`。

读取配置内某条路径，区分"键不存在"（`missing`）与"值就是 `undefined`"（`value: undefined`）。返回的对象/函数类型的值会自动包一层只读 Proxy（与 `readonlyConfig` 相同的包装逻辑），保证读到的嵌套值也不可被外部修改。`config` 必须是 `ownConfig` 的产物。

guidance.id: 组合工作流示例-截止时间-配置
guidance.heading: 组合工作流示例：截止时间 + 配置

blocks.text: 该组合用于本仓测试验证，不是外部生产代码示例。外部测试应优先使用测试框架的 fake timers。

`createManualScheduler()` 让时间变为确定性，便于在单测中精确断言超时/重试行为。超时中止是协作式的：`retry`/业务代码必须读取传入的 `signal` 才能提前退出。`ownConfig` 拷贝并登记入参；`readonlyConfig` 返回带缓存、只能读取不能修改的对象；`patchConfig` 返回一份新的受管理配置，`CONFIG_DELETE` 只在根一层的补丁里生效。

symbols.name: ConfigOwner
symbols.purpose: Stateful owner of one immutable config snapshot, built on `ownConfig`, `patchConfig`, `combineConfig` and `readonlyConfig`. Every write builds and validates a complete next snapshot before committing it, so a failed write changes nothing; writes return the owner for chaining, reads return deep readonly views typed from the path, and watchers run once per commit. Statics `from`, `fromAsync`, `fromEnv` and `merge` build owners from JSON text, async sources, environment variables and several sources.
symbols.core:
value: Plain root record, copied and validated by `ownConfig`; arrays, symbol keys or unsupported values throw `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`.
A new `ConfigOwner`; a rejected initial value throws `CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED`.
locked: `true` after `lock()`: every later write throws `CONFIG_READONLY`.
get: Reads the value at a typed path as a deep readonly view; nested writes through the view throw `CONFIG_READONLY`.
get.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
The value typed from the path, or `undefined` when the path is missing.
getOr: Reads a path and falls back when it is missing; an own `undefined` value is returned as is, not replaced.
getOr.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
getOr.fallback: Value returned when the path is missing.
The stored value or `fallback`.
require: Reads a path that must exist; a missing path throws `CONFIG_VALUE_MISSING` naming the path.
require.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
The stored value, typed from the path.
read: Reads a path and tells a missing path apart from an own `undefined` value.
read.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
`{ kind: "missing" }` or `{ kind: "value", value }` (an `IConfigReadResult`).
has: Tells whether the path has an own value, which may be `undefined`.
has.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
`true` when the path exists.
view: Returns a deep readonly view of the current snapshot; structural writes through it throw `CONFIG_READONLY`.
The view typed as `IConfigView<T>`; it keeps showing the snapshot it was taken from after later writes.
select: Creates a new owner for a record subtree (for example `db`), sharing profile and limits but not listeners, validator or lock state.
select.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
A new `ConfigOwner`; a missing path throws `CONFIG_VALUE_MISSING`, a non-record value throws `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`.
diff: Lists the paths that differ between this snapshot and another owner or plain record, comparing records and arrays key by key.
diff.other: A `ConfigOwner` or plain record to compare with, for example a freshly loaded config.
A frozen array of `IConfigDiffEntry`; `added` means only in `other`, `removed` only in this snapshot.
equals: Tells whether another owner or plain record holds the same data (deep, own keys).
equals.other: A `ConfigOwner` or plain record to compare with.
`true` when `diff(other)` is empty.
set: Writes one path with copy-on-write; missing intermediate records are created, and an intermediate that is neither a record nor an array throws `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
set.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
set.value: New value; its type is checked against the path, with literal leaves widened (`8080` is accepted for a `number`).
This owner, for chaining. The write is all-or-nothing: on any error (validation, locked, reentrant) the previous snapshot stays committed.
delete: Removes one path; deleting a missing path does nothing, and an array item is removed by index.
delete.path: Dot/bracket path typed from the config shape (`server.port`, `items.[0]`), or a pre-split segment list (`["server", "port"]`); dangerous keys such as `__proto__` throw `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`.
patch: Applies a root-level overlay through `patchConfig`; `CONFIG_DELETE` as a value removes that root key.
patch.patch: Plain record of root keys to replace or delete.
patch.options: Optional `IConfigPatchOptions` forwarded to `patchConfig`; omitted keeps the owner’s profile and limits.
combine: Merges sources into this owner through `combineConfig`, later sources winning and records merging deeply. Pass a list plus `IConfigCombineOptions` to choose merge strategies. The owner is retyped with the merged shape.
combine.sources: Plain records or other owners, merged left to right; or, in the list form, an array of them.
combine.options: List form only: `IConfigCombineOptions` (`strategies`, `pathRules`, `onConflict`).
This owner retyped as `ConfigOwner<T & merged>`, for chaining; failures leave the previous snapshot.
batch: Runs several writes as one commit: the validator and watchers run once at the end. If the callback throws or validation fails, every write of the batch is rolled back. Nested batches join the outer one.
batch.fn: Synchronous callback that receives this owner and performs the writes.
reset: Restores the snapshot captured at construction; watchers fire when it differs from the current one.
lock: Rejects every later write with `CONFIG_READONLY`; reads keep working. It cannot be undone; use `clone()` for a writable copy.
This owner, now locked.
watch: Watches the whole snapshot, or one path (called only when data under that path changed). Listeners run after each commit in registration order; a throw goes to `report`, and a write from inside a listener throws `REENTRANT_CALL`.
watch.path: Optional path to watch, typed like `get()`; omit it to watch the whole snapshot.
watch.listener: Callback `(next, prev)` receiving readonly views of the new and old value (or of the whole snapshot).
An idempotent unsubscribe function.
clone: Creates a new owner with the same snapshot, options and validator; listeners and lock state are not copied.
An independent `ConfigOwner` of the same type.
toJSON: Converts the current snapshot into JSON data: dates become ISO strings, and values JSON cannot represent (Map, Set, functions) throw `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`.
A plain JSON record; `JSON.stringify(config)` uses it.
toString: Formats the current snapshot as JSON text.
toString.space: Optional indentation forwarded to `JSON.stringify`.
The JSON text of the snapshot.
from: Parses JSON text into an owner. Non-string input or invalid JSON throws `CONFIG_PARSE_FAILED` with the parser error on `cause`; a non-record root throws `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`.
from.text: JSON text, for example the content of `config.json`.
from.options: Optional `IConfigOwnerParseOptions`.
A new `ConfigOwner` typed by the generic argument.
fromAsync: Builds an owner from an async source: a Promise, a value, or a factory that receives an abort signal; strings are parsed as JSON. Source rejections and factory throws become `CONFIG_SOURCE_FAILED`, retaining the original source failure on `cause`; `signal` and `timeoutMs` reject with the standard abort and timeout errors. Pair it with `createResource` from `@migaia/resource` to get a reactive config resource.
fromAsync.source: `IConfigAsyncSource`: value, Promise or factory.
fromAsync.options: Optional `IConfigOwnerAsyncOptions`.
A Promise of a new `ConfigOwner`.
fromEnv: Builds a nested config from flat environment variables (`process.env`, `Deno.env.toObject()` or any record). Values stay strings unless `coerce` converts them; conflicting keys such as `APP__DB` and `APP__DB__PORT` throw `CONFIG_CONFLICT`.
fromEnv.env: Record of variable names to string values.
fromEnv.options: Optional `IConfigOwnerEnvOptions`.
A new `ConfigOwner` of the nested record.
merge: Merges sources left to right into a new owner, later sources winning and records merging deeply; the result is typed with the merged shape.
merge.sources: One or more plain records or owners.
A new `ConfigOwner`; the inputs are not changed.
is: Brand check that is `true` only for real `ConfigOwner` instances; objects created from its prototype fail.
is.value: Any value.
`true` for an owner.
validate: Validator `(view) => boolean | void` run on construction and before every commit (once per `batch`). Throwing or returning `false` rejects the change with `CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED`, the validator error on `cause`.
Not set: every structurally valid snapshot is accepted.
Set a validator when structurally valid settings can still violate a business rule. It runs on construction and once per commit; false or a throw rejects the change. Omission accepts structurally valid snapshots.
report: Receives errors thrown by `watch()` listeners, so a failing listener is never swallowed and never stops the others.
Not set: the error is rethrown from a microtask so the host reports it as uncaught.
Set this callback to route watcher failures to application diagnostics. Other watchers continue when the reporter returns normally. Omission rethrows on a microtask. A reporter throw propagates and stops the notification loop.
profile: Validation profile forwarded to `ownConfig`: which values the config may contain.
`data`: portable plain data only.
Choose data for portable settings or richRuntime for in-process functions and classes. Omission uses data.
limits: Partial `IConfigLimits` forwarded to `ownConfig` (depth, node, key and path bounds).
Not set: the package default limits apply.
symbols.advanced:
Keep one application config that many modules read, change it in place with validated, all-or-nothing writes, and notify only the modules whose path changed.
Build the config from JSON text, a remote source or environment variables with `from()`, `fromAsync()` and `fromEnv()`.
A config that is read once at startup and never changes: `readonlyConfig(ownConfig(value))` is simpler.

options: IConfigOwnerOptions<T> (optional)

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stateful owner of one immutable config snapshot, built on `ownConfig`, `patchConfig`, `combineConfig` and `readonlyConfig`. Every write builds and validates a complete next snapshot before committing it, so a failed write changes nothing; writes return the owner for chaining, reads return deep readonly views typed from the path, and watchers run once per commit. Statics `from`, `fromAsync`, `fromEnv` and `merge` build owners from JSON text, async sources, environment variables and several sources.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import ConfigOwner from @migaia/utils/config, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use ConfigOwner when its class contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when ConfigOwner does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained class example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

A plain JSON record; `JSON.stringify(config)` uses it.
toString: Formats the current snapshot as JSON text.
toString.space: Optional indentation forwarded to `JSON.stringify`.
The JSON text of the snapshot.

from.text: JSON text, for example the content of `config.json`.
from.options: Optional `IConfigOwnerParseOptions`.
A new `ConfigOwner` typed by the generic argument.
fromAsync: Builds an owner from an async source: a Promise, a value, or a factory that receives an abort signal; strings are parsed as JSON. Source rejections and factory throws become `CONFIG_SOURCE_FAILED`, retaining the original source failure on `cause`; `signal` and `timeoutMs` reject with the standard abort and timeout errors. Pair it with `createResource` from `@migaia/resource` to get a reactive config resource.
fromAsync.source: `IConfigAsyncSource`: value, Promise or factory.
fromAsync.options: Optional `IConfigOwnerAsyncOptions`.
A Promise of a new `ConfigOwner`.
fromEnv: Builds a nested config from flat environment variables (`process.env`, `Deno.env.toObject()` or any record). Values stay strings unless `coerce` converts them; conflicting keys such as `APP__DB` and `APP__DB__PORT` throw `CONFIG_CONFLICT`.
fromEnv.env: Record of variable names to string values.
fromEnv.options: Optional `IConfigOwnerEnvOptions`.
A new `ConfigOwner` of the nested record.
merge: Merges sources left to right into a new owner, later sources winning and records merging deeply; the result is typed with the merged shape.
merge.sources: One or more plain records or owners.
A new `ConfigOwner`; the inputs are not changed.
is: Brand check that is `true` only for real `ConfigOwner` instances; objects created from its prototype fail.
is.value: Any value.
`true` for an owner.
validate: Validator `(view) => boolean | void` run on construction and before every commit (once per `batch`). Throwing or returning `false` rejects the change with `CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED`, the validator error on `cause`.
Not set: every structurally valid snapshot is accepted.
Set a validator when structurally valid settings can still violate a business rule. It runs on construction and once per commit; false or a throw rejects the change. Omission accepts structurally valid snapshots.
report: Receives errors thrown by `watch()` listeners, so a failing listener is never swallowed and never stops the others.
Not set: the error is rethrown from a microtask so the host reports it as uncaught.
Set this callback to route watcher failures to application diagnostics. Other watchers continue when the reporter returns normally. Omission rethrows on a microtask. A reporter throw propagates and stops the notification loop.
profile: Validation profile forwarded to `ownConfig`: which values the config may contain.
`data`: portable plain data only.
Choose data for portable settings or richRuntime for in-process functions and classes. Omission uses data.
limits: Partial `IConfigLimits` forwarded to `ownConfig` (depth, node, key and path bounds).
Not set: the package default limits apply.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Keep one application config that many modules read, change it in place with validated, all-or-nothing writes, and notify only the modules whose path changed.
Build the config from JSON text, a remote source or environment variables with `from()`, `fromAsync()` and `fromEnv()`.
A config that is read once at startup and never changes: `readonlyConfig(ownConfig(value))` is simpler.

blocks.text: `ConfigOwner` 持有一份不可变的配置快照，把 `ownConfig` / `readConfigPath` / `patchConfig` / `combineConfig` / `readonlyConfig` 集中到一个可链式调用的类上。每次写入都会先完整构建并校验下一份快照，再提交；失败时旧快照不变。路径类型由 `IObjectPath` 推导，`get('server.port')` 的类型就是 `number | undefined`。

items: 读取：`get` / `getOr` / `require` / `read` / `has` / `view()`（深只读视图）/ `select(path)`（子树的新 owner）/ `diff` / `equals`。
写入（返回 `this`）：`set` / `delete` / `patch` / `combine` / `batch(fn)`（一次校验、一次通知，失败整体回滚）/ `reset()` / `lock()`。
监听：`watch(listener)` 或 `watch(path, listener)`；监听器异常交给 `report`（默认进入宿主未捕获错误队列），监听器内再写入会抛 `REENTRANT_CALL`。
序列化：`toJSON()` / `toString(space)`；Map、Set、函数等非 JSON 值抛 `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`。
静态：`from`、`fromAsync`（Promise、值或接收 `signal` 的工厂；支持 `signal` / `timeoutMs`）、`fromEnv`、`merge`、`is`。与 `@migaia/resource` 的 `createResource` 组合即可得到一份响应式的配置资源。

blocks.text: `diff` 按左侧自身字符串键优先、再追加右侧独有键的顺序，深度优先比较数据。每对对象只访问一次；共享分支的同一差异只出现在首次到达的路径上，不再为其他别名重复报告。循环上没有数据差异时，`equals` 返回 `true`。路径监听使用同样的数据比较规则；监听顺序、取消订阅和异常上报规则不变。

guidance.id: error-按代码决定怎样处理失败
guidance.heading: /error：按代码决定怎样处理失败

blocks.text: 错误上的 `source` 表示来源，`code` 表示这个来源内的失败种类。 本包稳定领域为 `UTILS_SOURCE === 'foundation.utils'`，npm 导入仍使用 `@migaia/utils` 及其公开子路径。`UtilsErrorCode` 的键与值如下；原生 `TypeError`、`RangeError` 等加码后仍保留原类型，不能只看消息文本。

items: `invalidArgument` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT`：参数类型或范围不合法，修正参数后再调用。
`nonErrorValue` / `NON_ERROR_VALUE`：`toError()` 包装了非错误的抛出值，原值在 `cause`。
`envUnsupported` / `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`：宿主缺少必要能力，换用支持它的环境或注入实现。
`aborted` / `ABORTED`：操作收到协作式取消，原取消原因在错误链上。
`deadlineExceeded` / `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`：操作、单次尝试或总流程超时；检查 `scope` 与 `timeoutMs` 再决定是否重试。
`schedulerRunaway` / `SCHEDULER_RUNAWAY`：虚拟时钟一次推进执行超过 10000 个回调，检查同一时刻不断排入任务的循环。
`errorIdentityConflict` / `ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT`：已有身份与新字段冲突，保留原错误身份，由调用方选择冲突策略。
`errorChainInvalid` / `ERROR_CHAIN_INVALID`：序列化错误树不符合字段、深度、数量或字节约束，修正边界输入。
`cloneUnsupported` / `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`：结构化克隆拒绝该值，先转换为可克隆数据。
`invalidEncoding` / `INVALID_ENCODING`：字节或文本编码输入不合法，根据错误中的位置修正输入。
`limiterClosed` / `LIMITER_CLOSED`：关闭后的并发限制器拒绝新任务，需要创建新限制器。
`reentrantCall` / `REENTRANT_CALL`：不允许重入的操作在自身执行期间再次被调用，把嵌套调用移出当前执行过程。
`configUnsupported` / `CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED`：配置的根、字段或值不在支持范围内，按所选配置档位提供数据。
`configReadonly` / `CONFIG_READONLY`：尝试修改只读配置，改用补丁或合并生成下一份配置。
`configConflict` / `CONFIG_CONFLICT`：配置来源、档位或所有权不一致，先统一来源约束。
`configLimitExceeded` / `CONFIG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`：配置图超过上限，或上限选项不合法，缩小输入并检查限制设置。
`configPathInvalid` / `CONFIG_PATH_INVALID`：配置路径格式或键名不安全，修正路径。
`configParseFailed` / `CONFIG_PARSE_FAILED`：`ConfigOwner.from()` 收到非字符串或非法 JSON，原解析错误保留在 `cause`。
`configSourceFailed` / `CONFIG_SOURCE_FAILED`：`ConfigOwner.fromAsync()` 的来源失败，原拒绝保留在 `cause`，由调用方选择重试或默认配置。
`configValueMissing` / `CONFIG_VALUE_MISSING`：`ConfigOwner.require()` 没找到路径值，补充配置或用 `getOr()` 明确提供默认值。
`configValidationFailed` / `CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED`：校验器拒绝下一份配置，上一份保持不变，校验错误保留在 `cause`。
`objectPathInvalid` / `OBJECT_PATH_INVALID`：对象路径或其中一段不合法，修正路径输入。
`formatInvalid` / `FORMAT_INVALID`：模板语法或插值不合法，检查模板与值。
`formatValueMissing` / `FORMAT_VALUE_MISSING`：严格模板模式缺少占位符的值，补充对应数据。
`numberFormatInvalid` / `NUMBER_FORMAT_INVALID`：`Intl.NumberFormat` 拒绝地区、货币、选项或数值，修正格式化参数。

guidance.heading: /config：先接纳配置，再公开读取和派生新配置

blocks.text: `ownConfig` 是接收外部配置的边界：复制输入并登记独立、可验证所有权。`WeakMap` 是不往配置上添加字段的元数据表，库用它保留 `profile` 与 `limits`；普通对象不能通过伪造字段变成已接纳的配置。默认 `data` 档位接纳数据，`richRuntime` 还允许回调或工厂。

`ownConfig` 返回对象没有被冻结；获得所有权和公开只读访问是两件事。`readonlyConfig` 给已有配置套上只读保护，正常读取仍访问原数据，没有复制第二份配置，不允许调用方修改任何层级。`Map.set()`、`Set.add()`、`Date.setFullYear()` 等修改方法都会报错。公开读取用它，更新用 `patchConfig()` 生成下一份受管理配置，不是写 `view`；需要区分路径缺失与值为 `undefined` 时用 `readConfigPath`。补丁只作用于根字段，嵌套修改先算出新子树，再整体放入补丁。携带函数的 `richRuntime` 是运行时配置，不应当作可序列化数据。
`combineConfig` 按输入顺序合并，后面的来源覆盖前面；对象默认递归合并，数组默认替换。下面明确改用数组拼接，展示两个输入、结果与调用方自己整理的变化记录。
`defaults` 与 `override` 没有被修改。这里的 `diff` 只是把结果变化写明，不是 `combineConfig` 的额外返回值。
需要持有快照并比较变化时，用 `ConfigOwner.diff(other)` / `equals(other)`。对比按左侧键优先、深度优先的固定顺序遍历，每对对象只比较一次；共享节点的同一差异只报告首次到达的路径，不再为每条别名重复输出。没有数据差异的循环引用视为相等。
